en: Every {$cd}s, fires a Gravity Shot at the densest enemy cluster within {$range} range: deals Arts damage in a {$aoe} radius at the impact point, and pulls enemies within a {$pull_r} radius toward the impact point by {$pull} (halved on Elites, ×0.3 on heavy enemies, Bosses excepted; 'knockback taken' bonuses also apply to pull distance).
_zh: 每 {$cd} 秒向射程 {$range} 内敌群最密处射一枚重力弹：落点半径 {$aoe} 法术伤害，并把半径 {$pull_r} 内的敌人向落点拉拢 {$pull}（精英减半、重型 ×0.3，Boss 除外；「受到的击退」加成同样作用于拉拢距离）

en: For the next {$s1_n} Gravity Shots: pull distance ×{$s1_pull}, impact radius ×{$s1_r}; enemies at the impact point Halt for {$s1_pause}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).
_zh: 接下来 {$s1_n} 发重力弹：拉拢距离 ×{$s1_pull}、落点范围 ×{$s1_r}，落点敌人停顿 {$s1_pause} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）
_note: 校对：统一状态动词为 Halt，与其他文本保持一致

en: Activates after 1 charge and remains active permanently: creates a permanent gravity field (radius {$s2_r}) around the Leader. Every {$s2_every}s, pushes and pulls enemies within the field toward a ring of {$s2_ring} radius, gathering them in a circle; Leader movement speed +{$s2_speed*100}%.
_zh: 充能一次后永久生效：队长周围常驻重力场（半径 {$s2_r}），每 {$s2_every} 秒把场内敌人推拉向半径 {$s2_ring} 的环带，束成一圈；队长移速 +{$s2_speed*100}%

en: For {$s3_dur}s: enemies within a {$s3_r} radius of the Leader Levitate (cannot move or attack; Elites land for {$s3_elite_down}s every {$s3_elite_up+$s3_elite_down}s, Bosses are only Slowed) and are drawn toward the center of the field; squad ATK speed +{$s3_aspd*$k_pow*100:1}%, Leader recovers {$s3_heal*$k_pow*100:2}% Max HP per second, movement speed +{$s3_speed*100}%, and pickup range ×{$s3_pickup}.
_zh: {$s3_dur} 秒：队长周围半径 {$s3_r} 内的敌人悬浮（不能移动和攻击；精英每 {$s3_elite_up+$s3_elite_down} 秒落地 {$s3_elite_down} 秒，Boss 只减速）并向场心汇聚；全队攻击速度 +{$s3_aspd*$k_pow*100:1}%，队长每秒回复 {$s3_heal*$k_pow*100:2}% 最大生命、移速 +{$s3_speed*100}%、拾取范围 ×{$s3_pickup}

en: Enemies pulled by her become Weightless for {$grav_dur}s: knockback and pull taken +{$grav_kb*100}% (also applies to knockback dealt by other Operators); enemies within the Light Radius are pulled further by her (+{$talent_lit*100}%).
_zh: 被她拉动过的敌人 {$grav_dur} 秒内失重：受到的击退与拉拽 +{$grav_kb*100}%（对其他干员造成的击退同样生效）；照亮范围内的敌人被她拉得更远（+{$talent_lit*100}%）

en: {$pull2_delay}s after a Gravity Shot lands, pulls again at the impact point (pull and damage at {$pull2_mult*100}%).
_zh: 重力弹落地 {$pull2_delay} 秒后在落点再拉一次（拉拢与伤害各 {$pull2_mult*100}%）

en: While gravity projectiles are in flight, enemies within {$lens_r} on both sides of the trajectory are pulled toward the center line (up to {$lens_pull} per projectile, halved on Elites, less for heavy enemies, Bosses excepted); if there are {$dense_n} or more enemies at the impact point, hit enemies are stacked toward the center, collapsing and exploding after {$dense_delay}s (radius {$dense_r}, {$dense_mult*100}% Arts damage)
_zh: 重力弹飞行途中，弹道两侧 {$lens_r} 内的敌人被吸向弹道中线（每发至多 {$lens_pull}，精英减半，重型更小，Boss 除外）；落点内有 {$dense_n} 名以上敌人时，被命中的敌人叠向中心，{$dense_delay} 秒后坍缩爆开（半径 {$dense_r}，{$dense_mult*100}% 法术伤害）

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Arcane Staff - Particle Mode'; unlocks Talent 'Accelerator Field': Pulled enemies become Weightless for {$grav_dur}s, taking +{$grav_kb*100}% knockback and pull, enemies within the Light Radius are pulled further (+{$talent_lit*100}%); Normal Attack 'Gravity Halt': Enemies at the gravity projectile's impact point Halt for {$halt}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: 解锁二技能「秘杖·微粒模式」；解锁天赋「加速力场」：被拉过的敌人 {$grav_dur} 秒内失重，受到的击退与拉拽 +{$grav_kb*100}%，照亮范围内的敌人拉得更远（+{$talent_lit*100}%）；普攻「重力停顿」：重力弹落点的敌人停顿 {$halt} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）

en: Enemies within radius {$aoe} of the gravity projectile's impact point Halt for {$halt}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), with a purple ring shrinking at their feet
_zh: 重力弹落点半径 {$aoe} 内的敌人停顿 {$halt} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），脚下一圈紫环收缩

en: {$pull2_delay}s after a Gravity Shot lands, pulls again at the impact point (pull and damage at {$pull2_mult*100}%).
_zh: 重力弹落地 {$pull2_delay} 秒后在落点再拉一次（拉拢与伤害各 {$pull2_mult*100}%）

en: The gravity projectile's impact point pulls a third time {$pull2_delay}s after the double gravity (pull and damage are {$pull3_mult*100}% each); gravity projectile damage ×{$route_dmg}
_zh: 重力弹落点在双重引力之后 {$pull2_delay} 秒再拉第三次（拉拢与伤害各 {$pull3_mult*100}%）；重力弹伤害 ×{$route_dmg}

en: Enemies on the ring of 'Arcane Staff - Particle Mode' take {$lock_mult*100}% of the gravity projectile's Arts damage every {$lock_tick}s; gravity projectile damage ×{$route_dmg}
_zh: 「秘杖·微粒模式」的环带上的敌人每 {$lock_tick} 秒受到重力弹 {$lock_mult*100}% 的法术伤害；重力弹伤害 ×{$route_dmg}

en: 'Triple Gravity' increases the number of pulls at the gravity projectile's impact point; 'Tidal Lock' continuously deals Arts damage to enemies on the ring
_zh: 「三重引力」增加重力弹落点的拉拽次数；「潮汐锁」对环带上的敌人持续造成法术伤害

en: Enemies staying within the ring of 'Arcane Staff - Particle Mode' for {$lock2_t}s are locked on and Levitate for {$lock2_air}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); at most once every {$lock2_cd}s per enemy
_zh: 「秘杖·微粒模式」环带内停留满 {$lock2_t} 秒的敌人被锁定，悬浮 {$lock2_air} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）；每名敌人 {$lock2_cd} 秒内至多一次

en: {$pull4_delay}s after the gravity projectile lands, enemies within {$pull_r} of the impact point Halt for {$pull4_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); gravity projectile damage ×{$route_dmg}
_zh: 重力弹落地 {$pull4_delay} 秒后，落点 {$pull_r} 内的敌人停顿 {$pull4_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）；重力弹伤害 ×{$route_dmg}

en: Enemies staying within the ring of 'Arcane Staff - Particle Mode' for {$lock2_t}s are locked on and Levitate for {$lock2_air}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); at most once every {$lock2_cd}s per enemy
_zh: 「秘杖·微粒模式」环带内停留满 {$lock2_t} 秒的敌人被锁定，悬浮 {$lock2_air} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）；每名敌人 {$lock2_cd} 秒内至多一次

en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Arcane Staff - Anti-Gravity Mode'; Normal Attack upgrade 'Weightless Well': The gravity projectile leaves a Weightless well for {$well_dur}s after landing (radius {$well_r}), continuously pulling surrounding enemies toward the center, enemies at the center Levitate; Weightless or Levitating enemies inside the well take {$well_mult*100}% Arts damage every {$well_every}s (halved during 'Arcane Staff - Anti-Gravity Mode'). Max {$well_cap} wells at a time (Bosses excepted)
_zh: 解锁三技能「秘杖·反重力模式」；普通攻击强化「失重井」：重力弹落地后留下一口失重井 {$well_dur} 秒（半径 {$well_r}），持续把周围的敌人拉向井心，井心的敌人悬浮；井内失重或悬浮的敌人每 {$well_every} 秒受到 {$well_mult*100}% 法术伤害（「秘杖·反重力模式」期间减半）。最多同时 {$well_cap} 口（Boss 除外）

en: The gravity projectile leaves a Weightless well for {$well_dur}s after landing (radius {$well_r}): Pulls surrounding enemies toward the center every {$well_every}s, enemies at the center Levitate; Weightless or Levitating enemies inside the well take {$well_mult*100}% Arts damage every {$well_every}s (halved during 'Arcane Staff - Anti-Gravity Mode'). Max {$well_cap} wells at a time (Bosses excepted)
_zh: 重力弹落地后留下一口失重井 {$well_dur} 秒（半径 {$well_r}）：每 {$well_every} 秒把周围的敌人拉向井心，井心的敌人悬浮；井内失重或悬浮的敌人每 {$well_every} 秒受到 {$well_mult*100}% 法术伤害（「秘杖·反重力模式」期间减半）。最多同时 {$well_cap} 口（Boss 除外）

en: Supporter Operator, uses Originium Arts for pulling and Levitating. Normal attacks fire gravity projectiles that pull and lift enemies, skills deploy a gravity field that causes enemies within range to Levitate, unable to move or attack
_zh: 辅助干员，源石技艺用于牵引与悬浮。普攻重力弹把敌人拉拢并托起，技能展开重力场使范围内敌人悬浮、无法移动与攻击

en: Angelina, Supporter Operator and Messenger of Rhodes Island, helps you out with her amazing Originium Arts.
_zh: 罗德岛辅助干员、信使安洁莉娜，用自己奇妙的源石技艺为你提供协助
_note: 改写自官方招聘合同 char_291_aglina.itemUsage（原句是 would like to provide help）；候选2：Angelina, Supporter Operator and Messenger of Rhodes Island, here to help with her amazing Originium Arts.

en: Upon returning to the squad, she pushes away enemies around the Leader, then the Leader's movement speed +15% for 3s
_zh: 归队集合完毕时，她以队长为中心推开周围的敌人，之后 3 秒队长移动速度 +15%

en: Fires {$shots} Physical projectiles at the nearest enemy (prioritizes Elites) every {$cd}s (range {$range}, disappears upon hitting the first enemy, slight knockback); the number of projectiles per attack can grow, multiple projectiles aim at different enemies, if the nearest is a Boss, all hit the Boss
_zh: 每 {$cd} 秒向最近的敌人（精英优先）射出 {$shots} 发物理弹（射程 {$range}，命中第一名敌人即消失，轻微击退）；每次射击的子弹数可以成长，多发时各自瞄准不同的敌人，最近的是 Boss 时全部打 Boss

en: Loads {$s1_ammo} enhanced rounds: Subsequent projectiles deal damage ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2} and pierce {$s1_pierce} enemies until depleted (consumes enhanced rounds based on the number of projectiles per attack)
_zh: 装填 {$s1_ammo} 发强力弹：之后的子弹每发伤害 ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2}、穿透 {$s1_pierce} 名敌人，打完为止（每次射击按子弹数消耗强力弹）

en: {$s2_dur}s: Attack interval {$cd} -> {$s2_cd}s, projectile damage ×{$s2_mult}; upon ending, the barrel overheats, unable to attack for {$s2_overheat}s
_zh: {$s2_dur} 秒：射击间隔 {$cd} → {$s2_cd} 秒，每发伤害 ×{$s2_mult}；结束时枪管过热，{$s2_overheat} 秒不能射击

en: {$s3_dur}s: Each attack becomes a {$s3_burst}-hit burst (projectile damage ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}), range +{$s3_range*100}%, prioritizes Elites and Bosses; burst hits multiply with the number of projectiles; the last projectile of each burst Halts non-Elites for {$s3_pause}s
_zh: {$s3_dur} 秒：每次射击改为 {$s3_burst} 连射（每发伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}），射程 +{$s3_range*100}%，优先瞄准精英与 Boss；连射与子弹数相乘；每轮最后一发让非精英停顿 {$s3_pause} 秒

en: Cartridge: Cartridge +1 for every 1 enemy she defeats (Limit {$mag_cap}, {$e2_mag_cap} from Elite 2), +{$mag_lit_bonus} if the enemy falls within the Leader's Light Radius; when Cartridge is full, the next attack unloads {$mag_shots} shots in a frontal cone (Damage ×{$mag_mult} per shot, pierces {$mag_pierce} enemies), then empties Cartridge
_zh: 弹匣：她每击杀 1 名敌人弹匣 +1（上限 {$mag_cap}，精英二起 {$e2_mag_cap}），敌人倒在队长照亮范围内时 +{$mag_lit_bonus}；弹匣满时下一次射击改为一次倾泻：{$mag_shots} 发扇形散射（每发伤害 ×{$mag_mult}，穿透 {$mag_pierce} 名敌人），然后清空

en: 1 in every {$prefer_stun_every} bullets is a Stun bullet, Stunning the target for {$prefer_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); bullets prioritize crowd-controlled targets (enemies that are Stunned, Levitated, or Weightless); when hitting a crowd-controlled target, the bullet stops upon impact and immobilizes them for {$prefer_pin}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted; at most once per second per enemy); damage ×{$grow_dmg_twin}.
_zh: 每 {$prefer_stun_every} 发子弹中有 1 发眩晕弹，使目标眩晕 {$prefer_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）；子弹优先瞄准受控目标（眩晕、浮空、失重中的敌人）；打中受控目标时命中即停，并使其定身 {$prefer_pin} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外；同一敌人 1 秒内至多一次）；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_twin}

en: When {$escort_n} or more enemies are within a radius of {$escort_r} around the Leader, bullets prioritize the enemy closest to the Leader, and deal {$escort_kb} knockback; Damage ×{$grow_dmg_power}
_zh: 队长身边半径 {$escort_r} 内有 {$escort_n} 名及以上敌人时，子弹改为优先射击离队长最近的敌人，并附带 {$escort_kb} 击退；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_power}

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Shooting Mode'; unlocks Talent 'Fast Cartridge': Unloads {$mag_shots} shots after filling Cartridge via defeats; Normal attack 'Armor-Piercing Burst': When consecutively hitting the same enemy, Damage +{$e1_per*100}% per shot (up to +{$e1_per*$e1_max*100}%), resets if the enemy is not hit for {$e1_decay}s
_zh: 解锁二技能「扫射模式」；解锁天赋「快速弹匣」：击杀攒满弹匣后倾泻 {$mag_shots} 发；普攻「穿甲连射」：连续命中同一名敌人时每发伤害 +{$e1_per*100}%（最多 +{$e1_per*$e1_max*100}%），{$e1_decay} 秒未命中该敌人则清零

en: When rapid shots consecutively hit the same enemy, Damage +{$e1_per*100}% per shot (up to +{$e1_per*$e1_max*100}%), bullets turn from white to gold, emitting golden sparks upon hit at max stacks; resets if the enemy is not hit for {$e1_decay}s
_zh: 速射连续命中同一名敌人时每发伤害 +{$e1_per*100}%（最多 +{$e1_per*$e1_max*100}%），子弹由白转金，叠满时命中迸出金色火花；{$e1_decay} 秒未命中该敌人则清零

en: Every {$tracer_every} shot is a Tracer Round: Hitting an enemy marks them for {$tracer_secs}s, other Operators deal +{$tracer_bonus*100}% damage to the marked target
_zh: 每第 {$tracer_every} 发为曳光弹：命中的敌人被标记 {$tracer_secs} 秒，其他干员对标记目标造成的伤害 +{$tracer_bonus*100}%

en: Every {$tracer_every} shot is a Tracer Round: Hitting an enemy marks them for {$tracer_secs}s, other Operators deal +{$tracer_bonus*100}% damage to the marked target
_zh: 每第 {$tracer_every} 发为曳光弹：命中的敌人被标记 {$tracer_secs} 秒，其他干员对标记目标造成的伤害 +{$tracer_bonus*100}%

en: Bullets have a {$ricochet_chance*100}% chance to ricochet to another enemy within {$ricochet_r} upon hit (Damage {$ricochet_mult*100}%)
_zh: 子弹命中后有 {$ricochet_chance*100}% 概率跳向 {$ricochet_r} 内另一名敌人（伤害 {$ricochet_mult*100}%）

en: 'Tracer Rounds' marks targets, the squad deals increased damage to them; 'Ricochet' gives bullets a chance to bounce to another enemy upon hit
_zh: 「曳光弹」标记目标，全队对其增伤；「跳弹」使子弹命中后有概率弹向另一名敌人

en: Bullets have a {$ricochet_chance*100}% chance to ricochet to another enemy within {$ricochet_r} upon hit (Damage {$ricochet_mult*100}%)
_zh: 子弹命中后有 {$ricochet_chance*100}% 概率跳向 {$ricochet_r} 内另一名敌人（伤害 {$ricochet_mult*100}%）

en: When an enemy marked by Tracer Rounds falls (regardless of who defeated them), Cartridge +{$reap_mag} additionally; up to {$reap_max} marks can exist simultaneously
_zh: 被曳光弹标记的敌人倒下时（无论谁击杀），弹匣额外 +{$reap_mag}；标记同时最多 {$reap_max} 个

en: Enemies she defeats emit shrapnel, dealing {$frag_mult*100}% damage to enemies within a radius of {$frag_r}
_zh: 她击杀的敌人处迸出弹片，半径 {$frag_r} 内的敌人受到 {$frag_mult*100}% 伤害

en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Overloading Mode'; Normal attack upgrade 'Angel's Blessings': Halos appear above 2 other Operators in the squad, ATK speed +{$e2_aspd*100}%; Cartridge limit {$mag_cap} → {$e2_mag_cap}
_zh: 解锁三技能「过载模式」；普通攻击强化「天使的祝福」：编队中另外两名干员头顶浮现光环，攻击速度 +{$e2_aspd*100}%；弹匣上限 {$mag_cap} → {$e2_mag_cap}

en: Golden halos appear above 2 other Operators in the squad: ATK speed +{$e2_aspd*100}%, each attack carries a golden flash; the halos light up when she fires. Cartridge limit {$mag_cap} → {$e2_mag_cap}
_zh: 编队中另外两名干员头顶浮现金色光环：攻击速度 +{$e2_aspd*100}%，每次攻击带一道金色闪光；她开火时光环随之一亮。弹匣上限 {$mag_cap} → {$e2_mag_cap}

en: Sniper Operator, dual-wielding rapid fire, three shots per second; Cartridge fills upon defeats, unloads a frontal cone barrage when full
_zh: 狙击干员，双枪连射，每秒三发；弹匣随击杀增长，攒满后倾泻一轮扇形射击

en: Exusiai, employee of Penguin Logistics, will clear out everything in the way using her guns.
_zh: 企鹅物流职员能天使，将用铳枪为小队扫平前路

en: Whenever the Leader starts a dash, she fires a volley at the nearest enemy behind the Leader (same number of shots as normal attacks, each dealing 80% damage) to cover the Leader's retreat; enemies defeated by this volley fill the Cartridge as usual
_zh: 队长每次冲刺起步，她朝队长身后最近的敌人补射一轮（发数同普攻，每发 80% 伤害），掩护队长撤出；补射击倒的敌人照常填充弹匣
_note: 校对：统一“弹匣”的翻译为 Cartridge

en: Throws a Magma Orb at the nearest enemy within {$range} range every {$cd}s, exploding in a {$aoe} radius upon landing (Arts) and slightly knocking back enemies around the explosion (reduced on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: 每 {$cd} 秒向射程 {$range} 内最近的敌人投出熔岩弹，落点半径 {$aoe} 爆炸（法术），并小幅击退爆点周围的敌人（精英减弱，Boss 除外）
_note: 校对：修正 Elite 的单复数和介词搭配，使其与“精英减半”的翻译风格一致

en: The next 3 Magma Orbs have explosion radius ×{$s1_aoe} and ignite targets hit: take {$burn_dps*100}% of this attack's Arts damage per second for {$burn_dur}s ({$burn_dur_e1}s at Elite 1 or above)
_zh: 接下来 3 发熔岩弹爆炸范围 ×{$s1_aoe}，并点燃命中的敌人：每秒受到这一发 {$burn_dps*100}% 的法术伤害，持续 {$burn_dur} 秒（精英一及以上 {$burn_dur_e1} 秒）

en: Throws a Magma Orb dealing ×{$s2_mult*$k_pow:2} damage at the nearest enemy (explosion radius ×{$s2_aoe}): ignites targets hit (same as 'Duetto'), and damage taken by them +10% for {$s2_weak}s
_zh: 向最近的敌人投出一发 ×{$s2_mult*$k_pow:2} 的熔岩弹（爆炸范围 ×{$s2_aoe}）：点燃命中的敌人（同「二重咏唱」），并让它们 {$s2_weak} 秒内受到的伤害 +10%

en: Levitates and throws {$s3_count} volleys of flaming orbs at enemies (damage ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}), leaving magma for {$lava_dur}s at each location ({$lava_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% Arts damage every {$lava_every}s)
_zh: 浮空向敌群投射 {$s3_count} 轮火焰弹（伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}），每处留下 {$lava_dur} 秒熔岩（每 {$lava_every} 秒 {$lava_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 法术伤害）

en: Magma Orb explosion radius +{$talent_aoe*100-100}%; ignite duration of 'Duetto' and 'Ignition' {$burn_dur}s → {$burn_dur_e1}s
_zh: 熔岩弹爆炸范围 +{$talent_aoe*100-100}%；「二重咏唱」「点燃」的点燃持续时间 {$burn_dur} → {$burn_dur_e1} 秒
_note: 校对：修正箭头符号，使其与中文原文及其他文本保持一致

en: Normal attacks throw 2 Magma Orbs, the second dealing {$twin_mult*100}% damage: before Promotion, attacks the same enemy; from Elite 1, attacks a different enemy (if none, veers off to the side); from Elite 2, replaced by 'Tercet'.
_zh: 普攻投出 2 发熔岩弹，第二发伤害 {$twin_mult*100}%：精英化前打同一名敌人，精英一起打另一名敌人（没有则在旁边偏开）；精英二起由「三重咏唱」取代

en: When a Magma Orb explodes, it scatters {$ember_n} pieces of magma that hit nearby enemies and explode in a small area ({$ember_mult*100}% damage of this attack)
_zh: 熔岩弹爆炸时迸出 {$ember_n} 块熔岩，砸到附近的敌人身上小范围爆炸（这一发 {$ember_mult*100}% 的伤害）

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Ignition'; unlocks Talent 'Pyrobreath': Magma Orb explosion radius +{$talent_aoe*100-100}%, ignite duration +{$burn_dur_e1-$burn_dur}s; normal attack 'Melt': enemies hit by Magma Orbs take +{$melt_v*100}% Arts damage for {$melt_dur}s
_zh: 解锁二技能「点燃」；解锁天赋「炎息」：熔岩弹爆炸范围 +{$talent_aoe*100-100}%，点燃持续时间 +{$burn_dur_e1-$burn_dur} 秒；普攻「熔蚀」：熔岩弹命中的敌人 {$melt_dur} 秒内受到的法术伤害 +{$melt_v*100}%

en: Enemies hit by Magma Orbs take +{$melt_v*100}% Arts damage for {$melt_dur}s (does not stack, hitting again refreshes duration; also applies to Bosses), leaving a ring of dark red cracks beneath them
_zh: 熔岩弹命中的敌人 {$melt_dur} 秒内受到的法术伤害 +{$melt_v*100}%（不叠层，再命中刷新时间；Boss 同样生效），脚下留一圈暗红裂纹

en: Magma Orbs from 'Ignition' scatter {$blob_n} magma blobs around after exploding, which explode upon landing ({$blob_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% damage of a normal attack Magma Orb)
_zh: 「点燃」的熔岩弹爆炸后向四周抛出 {$blob_n} 团熔岩，落地各自爆炸（普攻熔岩弹的 {$blob_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 伤害）

en: Magma Orbs from 'Ignition' scatter {$blob_n} magma blobs around after exploding, which explode upon landing ({$blob_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% damage of a normal attack Magma Orb)
_zh: 「点燃」的熔岩弹爆炸后向四周抛出 {$blob_n} 团熔岩，落地各自爆炸（普攻熔岩弹的 {$blob_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 伤害）

en: When Magma Orbs enhanced by 'Duetto' explode, throws a Magma Orb high at {$meteor_n} random nearby enemies ({$meteor_mult*100}% damage of this attack); after Elite 2, each volley of 'Volcano' also adds this effect
_zh: 「二重咏唱」强化的熔岩弹炸开时，向附近 {$meteor_n} 名随机敌人高抛一颗熔岩弹（这发伤害的 {$meteor_mult*100}%）；精英二后「火山」每轮投弹同样追加

en: 'Spreading Sparks' causes Magma Orbs from 'Ignition' to scatter magma around after exploding; 'Falling Magma' adds Magma Orbs to 'Duetto' and 'Volcano' after Elite 2
_zh: 「星火燎原」使「点燃」的熔岩弹爆炸后向周围抛出熔岩；「熔岩天降」为「二重咏唱」及精英二后的「火山」追加熔岩弹

en: When Magma Orbs enhanced by 'Duetto' explode, throws a Magma Orb high at {$meteor_n} random nearby enemies ({$meteor_mult*100}% damage of this attack); after Elite 2, each volley of 'Volcano' also adds this effect
_zh: 「二重咏唱」强化的熔岩弹炸开时，向附近 {$meteor_n} 名随机敌人高抛一颗熔岩弹（这发伤害的 {$meteor_mult*100}%）；精英二后「火山」每轮投弹同样追加

en: When Magma Orbs from 'Ignition' explode, throws an additional magma blob at the {$blob2_n} nearest enemies outside the explosion radius ({$blob2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% damage)
_zh: 「点燃」的熔岩弹爆炸时，再向爆炸范围外最近的 {$blob2_n} 名敌人各抛一团熔岩（{$blob2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 伤害）

en: Magma pieces from 'Falling Magma' prioritize ignited enemies; upon hitting, immediately deals {$ign_k*100}% of their remaining burn damage, and spreads the ignite to up to {$ign_n} enemies within a {$ign_r} radius
_zh: 「熔岩天降」的熔岩块优先砸向已点燃的敌人；砸中时立刻结算其剩余灼烧伤害的 {$ign_k*100}%，并把点燃扩散给半径 {$ign_r} 内至多 {$ign_n} 名敌人

en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Volcano': Levitates and throws {$s3_count} volleys of flaming orbs at enemies (damage ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}), leaving magma for {$lava_dur}s at each location; normal attack enhanced to 'Tercet' (replaces 'Echo'): Magma Orbs are thrown in a low arc, dropping 3 orbs in a triangle around the target each time (last 2 orbs deal ×{$tri_mult} damage), leaving a magma pool in the center for {$pool_dur}s upon landing, dealing {$pool_mult*100}% Arts damage of the first orb every {$pool_every}s
_zh: 解锁三技能「火山」：浮空向敌群投射 {$s3_count} 轮火焰弹（伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}），每处留下 {$lava_dur} 秒熔岩；普通攻击强化「三重咏唱」（取代「复咏」）：熔岩弹改为低弧抛射，每次 3 发在目标周围呈三角落下（后 2 发伤害 ×{$tri_mult}），落地后中心留下熔池 {$pool_dur} 秒，每 {$pool_every} 秒造成第一发 {$pool_mult*100}% 的法术伤害

en: Magma Orbs are thrown in a low arc: drops 3 orbs in a triangle around the target each time (last 2 orbs deal ×{$tri_mult} damage), each exploding; after all 3 orbs land, leaves a magma pool in the center of the triangle for {$pool_dur}s, dealing {$pool_mult*100}% Arts damage of the first orb to enemies in the pool every {$pool_every}s
_zh: 熔岩弹改为低弧抛射：每次 3 发在目标周围呈三角落下（后 2 发伤害 ×{$tri_mult}），各自爆炸；3 发都落地后，三角中心留下熔池 {$pool_dur} 秒，每 {$pool_every} 秒对池内敌人造成第一发 {$pool_mult*100}% 的法术伤害

en: Caster Operator. Normal attacks throw Magma Orbs to clear enemy groups, skills erupt volcanoes and leave burning magma pools.
_zh: 术师干员，普攻熔岩弹清理敌群，技能喷发火山并留下灼烧熔池

en: Volcanologist and Catastrophe Messenger. On the battlefield, her Arts are the force you can count on to win.
_zh: 火山学家，天灾信使。在战场上，她的法术是最可靠的决战力量
_note: 候选2：Volcanologist and Catastrophe Messenger. On the battlefield, her Arts are your most reliable trump card.

en: When Leader is stationary, her Lava Ball explosion range gradually expands: +15% each at 0.6s, 1.6s, and 2.6s stationary; resets when Leader moves
_zh: 队长站定不动时，她的熔岩弹爆炸范围逐渐扩大：站定满 0.6、1.6、2.6 秒各 +15%；队长移动就恢复

en: Every {$cd}s, throws a Grappling Hook at the furthest enemy within {$range} (ignores enemies within {$hook_min}): deals Physical damage within a radius of {$hook_r} upon landing, then drags enemies in a line between the Grappling Hook and herself (up to {$hook_n}, Bosses excepted) to {$hook_front} in front of her (to {$hook_front_leader} when she is Leader; distance halved for Elites and exploding enemies). Upon arrival, they take {$hook_back*100}% damage and are Stunned for {$arrive_stun}s (halved on Elites)
_zh: 每 {$cd} 秒把钩索掷向 {$range} 内离她最远的敌人（{$hook_min} 以内的不选）：落地半径 {$hook_r} 内造成物理伤害，随后把钩索与她之间一线的敌人（至多 {$hook_n} 名，Boss 除外）拖到身前 {$hook_front} 处（她当队长时拖到 {$hook_front_leader} 处，精英与自爆怪只拖半程），到位再受 {$hook_back*100}% 伤害并眩晕 {$arrive_stun} 秒（精英减半）
_note: 校对：统一术语：钩索应译为Grappling Hook

en: Waterless Parting of the Great Ocean

Immediately throws a heavy hook: deals ×{$s1_mult} damage within a radius of {$s1_r} at the furthest enemy within {$s1_range}, and drags up to {$s1_n} enemies in a line to {$hook_front} in front of her (to {$hook_front_leader} when she is Leader; distance halved for Elites and exploding enemies). Upon arrival, they take ×{$s1_back} damage and are Stunned for {$arrive_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: 立刻掷出重钩：{$s1_range} 内最远的敌人处半径 {$s1_r} 内 ×{$s1_mult} 伤害，把一线上至多 {$s1_n} 名敌人拖到身前 {$hook_front} 处（她当队长时 {$hook_front_leader} 处，精英与自爆怪只拖半程），到位再受 ×{$s1_back} 伤害并眩晕 {$arrive_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）

en: Waterless Grasp of the Raging Seas

For {$s2_dur}s, damage ×{$s2_dmg}, attack interval ×{$s2_interval}, Grappling Hook range +{$s2_range*100}%; each hook throw also pulls enemies within {$s2_pull_r} around her closer by {$s2_pull} (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: {$s2_dur} 秒内伤害 ×{$s2_dmg}、攻击间隔 ×{$s2_interval}、钩索射程 +{$s2_range*100}%；每次掷钩同时把身边 {$s2_pull_r} 内的敌人拉近 {$s2_pull}（精英减半，Boss 除外）
_note: 校对：统一术语：钩索应译为Grappling Hook

en: Waterless Dance of the Shattered Maelstrom

Generates a radius {$s3_r} whirlpool at the last hooked enemy, lasting {$s3_dur}s: every {$s3_every}s, deals {$s3_mult*100}% Arts damage to enemies inside, Slows them for {$s3_slow}s, and pulls them towards the center by {$s3_pull}; when it ends, pulls enemies within a radius of {$s3_end_r} towards the center by {$s3_end_pull} and Stuns them for {$s3_end_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: 在最近一次钩中的敌人处生成半径 {$s3_r} 的漩涡，持续 {$s3_dur} 秒：每 {$s3_every} 秒对涡内敌人造成 {$s3_mult*100}% 法术伤害、减速 {$s3_slow} 秒并拉向中心 {$s3_pull}；结束时把半径 {$s3_end_r} 内的敌人拽向中心 {$s3_end_pull} 并眩晕 {$s3_end_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）

en: Leader recovers {$heal_pct*100}% Max HP per second (effective upon joining the squad); after promotion to Elite 1, for each other Abyssal Hunter in the squad (Skadi, Skadi the Corrupting Heart, Ulpianus, Specter the Unchained), Leader recovers an additional {$mate_heal*100}% Max HP per second and takes -{$mate_dr*100}% damage (up to {$mate_cap} operators)
_zh: 队长每秒回复 {$heal_pct*100} % 最大生命（入队即生效）；晋升至精英一后，编队里每名其他深海猎人（斯卡蒂、浊心斯卡蒂、乌尔比安、归溟幽灵鲨），队长每秒再回复 {$mate_heal*100} % 最大生命、受到的伤害 -{$mate_dr*100}%（最多 {$mate_cap} 人）
_note: 校对：语法修正：加入编队应为joining the squad

en: Enemies dragged by the Grappling Hook take Arts damage equal to {$barb_pct*100}% of ATK for every {$barb_per} distance dragged (up to {$barb_max} stacks), emitting sparks along the drag path
_zh: 被钩索拖拽的敌人，每被拖过 {$barb_per} 距离，受到攻击力 {$barb_pct*100}% 的法术伤害（至多 {$barb_max} 层），拖拽路径上迸出火星
_note: 校对：统一术语：钩索应译为Grappling Hook

en: At the same moment the Grappling Hook drags enemies in front of her, she performs a forward sweep: {$slash_half*2}° frontal sector, radius {$slash_r}, deals {$slash_mult*100}% damage and {$slash_kb} knockback
_zh: 钩索把敌人拖到身前的同一刻，她向前挥出一记横扫：前方 {$slash_half*2}° 扇形，半径 {$slash_r}，{$slash_mult*100}% 伤害，击退 {$slash_kb}
_note: 校对：统一术语：钩索应译为Grappling Hook

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Waterless Grasp of the Raging Seas'; unlocks Talent 'Waves of Ægir': for each other Abyssal Hunter in the squad, Leader recovers an additional {$mate_heal*100}% Max HP per second and takes -{$mate_dr*100}% damage; Normal Attack 'Anchoring': Stun upon arrival {$arrive_stun}s -> {$arrive_stun_e1}s
_zh: 解锁二技能「缺水的掌握怒海」；解锁天赋「阿戈尔的波涛」：编队里每名其他深海猎人，队长每秒再回复 {$mate_heal*100} % 最大生命、受到的伤害 -{$mate_dr*100}%；普攻「锚定」：拖回到位的眩晕 {$arrive_stun} → {$arrive_stun_e1} 秒

en: Enemies dragged by the Grappling Hook are Stunned for {$arrive_stun}s -> {$arrive_stun_e1}s upon arrival (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: 钩索拖回到位的敌人眩晕 {$arrive_stun} → {$arrive_stun_e1} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）
_note: 校对：统一术语：钩索应译为Grappling Hook

en: Each time a hook is thrown, Leader gains a Shield equal to {$shield_pct*100}% of Max HP (up to {$shield_cap*100}%, disappears after {$shield_dur}s)
_zh: 每次掷钩，队长获得 {$shield_pct*100} % 最大生命的护盾（总量至多 {$shield_cap*100} %，{$shield_dur} 秒后消失）

en: Each time a hook is thrown, Leader gains a Shield equal to {$shield_pct*100}% of Max HP (up to {$shield_cap*100}%, disappears after {$shield_dur}s)
_zh: 每次掷钩，队长获得 {$shield_pct*100} % 最大生命的护盾（总量至多 {$shield_cap*100} %，{$shield_dur} 秒后消失）

en: After dragging with the hookline, the chain is not retracted and sinks into the ground for {$chain_dur}s: enemies stepping on the chain have movement speed -{$chain_slow*100}% (Bosses excepted), and take Arts damage equal to {$chain_mult*100}% of ATK every {$chain_every}s
_zh: 钩索拖拽后，锁链不收回，沉在地面 {$chain_dur} 秒：踩上锁链的敌人移速 -{$chain_slow*100}%（Boss 除外），每 {$chain_every} 秒受到攻击力 {$chain_mult*100}% 的法术伤害

en: 'Abyssal Sanctuary' provides a Shield to Leader when throwing a hook; 'Raging Seas' leaves the chain on the ground after dragging, Slowing and continuously damaging enemies stepping on it
_zh: 「深海的庇护」在掷钩时为队长提供护盾；「怒海」让拖拽后的锁链沉在地面，减速并持续伤害踩上的敌人

en: After dragging with the hookline, the chain is not retracted and sinks into the ground for {$chain_dur}s: enemies stepping on the chain have movement speed -{$chain_slow*100}% (Bosses excepted), and take Arts damage equal to {$chain_mult*100}% of ATK every {$chain_every}s
_zh: 钩索拖拽后，锁链不收回，沉在地面 {$chain_dur} 秒：踩上锁链的敌人移速 -{$chain_slow*100}%（Boss 除外），每 {$chain_every} 秒受到攻击力 {$chain_mult*100}% 的法术伤害

en: When the Shield is broken or expires after {$shield_dur}s, a water ripple bursts centered on Leader: radius {$pop_r}, deals {$pop_mult*100}% damage and {$pop_kb} knockback; at most once every {$pop_cd}s
_zh: 护盾被打破或 {$shield_dur} 秒到期时，以队长为中心迸出一圈水波：半径 {$pop_r}，{$pop_mult*100}% 伤害，击退 {$pop_kb}；{$pop_cd} 秒内至多一次

en: When the chain sinks (expires after {$chain_dur}s), a water column erupts every {$geyser_gap} along the hook line; enemies hit Levitate for {$geyser_air}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: 锁链沉没（{$chain_dur} 秒到期）时，沿钩线每隔 {$geyser_gap} 冒出一根水柱，被冲中的敌人浮空 {$geyser_air} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）

en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Waterless Dance of the Shattered Maelstrom'; Normal attack upgraded to 'Ram': When the hook pulls an enemy into position, causes a shockwave in a radius of {$ram_r} ahead: deals {$ram_mult*100}% damage and knocks back nearby enemies
_zh: 解锁三技能「缺水的碎漩狂舞」；普通攻击强化「冲撞」：钩索把敌人拖回到位时，身前半径 {$ram_r} 掀起一圈冲击：{$ram_mult*100}% 伤害并击退周围敌人

en: When the hook pulls an enemy into position, causes a shockwave in a radius of {$ram_r} ahead: deals {$ram_mult*100}% damage and knocks back nearby enemies
_zh: 钩索把敌人拖回到位时，身前半径 {$ram_r} 掀起一圈冲击：{$ram_mult*100}% 伤害，击退周围敌人

en: Specialist Operator, member of the Abyssal Hunters. Pulls enemies toward herself after a hook hit; for each additional Abyssal Hunter in the squad, Leader's HP recovery and damage reduction increase by one tier
_zh: 特种干员，深海猎人成员，钩索命中后把敌人拖到身前；队内每多一名深海猎人，队长回复与减伤各加一档

en: Ægir Consul of Technology, Honorary Legion Commander, and one of the chief war designers of the Ægir military group, the Abyssal Hunters.
_zh: 阿戈尔技术执政官、荣誉军团长，阿戈尔军事团体“深海猎人”总战争设计师之一
_note: 头衔词序未在官方英文档案里逐一核对，第二步核 handbook_info_table；候选2：Consul of Technology of Ægir, honorary Legion Commander, one of the chief war architects of the Abyssal Hunters.
可能偏长：20 字母 / 中文 4 字
可能偏长：32 字母 / 中文 4 字

en: When her hook pulls an enemy into position, if Ulpianus is within range, he performs an additional anchor strike at the landing point (at most once every 2s; does not consume his normal attack cooldown)
_zh: 她的钩索把敌人拖回到位时，乌尔比安在射程内就朝落点补一次锚击（每 2 秒至多一次，不占他的普攻冷却）

en: Every {$cd}s, sweeps forward {$half_deg*2}° (radius {$reach}) with the sharp edge of the shield 'Hannya'; hits cause knockback
_zh: 每 {$cd} 秒用盾「般若」的锋利盾沿向前横扫 {$half_deg*2}°（半径 {$reach}），命中击退

en: Performs a heavy backhand slash to the surroundings (radius {$s1_r}, ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2}) and causes significant knockback; within {$s1_window}s after hitting, melee enemies within a radius of {$s1_taunt_r} switch to chasing Hoshiguma (duration halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: 向周围反手重斩（半径 {$s1_r}，×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2}）并大幅击退；命中后 {$s1_window} 秒内，半径 {$s1_taunt_r} 内的近战敌人改追星熊（精英只吸引一半时间，首领不受影响）

en: For {$s2_dur}s: ATK +{$s2_atk*$k_pow*100:1}%, damage taken by the Leader -{$s2_dr*100}%, 'Tactical Armor' block chance ×{$s2_block_x}; Shield Axe Slash leaves hot sand at the landing point for {$sand_dur}s (radius {$sand_r}), enemies stepping in take {$sand_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% of ATK as damage per second
_zh: {$s2_dur} 秒：攻击 +{$s2_atk*$k_pow*100:1}%，队长受到的伤害 -{$s2_dr*100}%，「战术装甲」格挡概率 ×{$s2_block_x}；盾斧斩落点留下 {$sand_dur} 秒热砂（半径 {$sand_r}），踩进的敌人每秒受到 {$sand_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 攻击力的伤害

en: For {$s3_dur}s: ATK +{$s3_atk*$k_pow*100:1}%, Shield Axe Slash becomes a straight slash (length {$s3_len}, width {$s3_w}, hits all along the line, knockback ×{$s3_kb}); damage taken by the Leader -{$s3_dr*100}%, every time the Leader is attacked (including blocked attacks), knocks back enemies within a radius of {$s3_quake_r} around the Leader
_zh: {$s3_dur} 秒：攻击 +{$s3_atk*$k_pow*100:1}%，盾斧斩改为直线斩（长 {$s3_len}、宽 {$s3_w}，命中沿线全部，击退 ×{$s3_kb}）；队长受到的伤害 -{$s3_dr*100}%，每次受击（含被格挡的）震退队长身边半径 {$s3_quake_r} 内的敌人

en: Every time the Leader is attacked, has a {$block_chance*100}% chance to completely block it ({$block_chance_boss*100}% for Boss attacks): prevents HP and Light loss, and pushes away enemies within a radius of {$block_kb_r} around the Leader; chance +{$beacon_bonus*100}% while the Leader performs Ignition on a Guiding Beacon
_zh: 队长每次受到攻击有 {$block_chance*100}% 概率完全格挡（Boss 的攻击 {$block_chance_boss*100}%）：不损失生命与灯火，并推开队长身边半径 {$block_kb_r} 内的敌人；队长点燃引航灯标期间概率 +{$beacon_bonus*100}%

en: Among enemies hit by Shield Axe Slash, the closest {$block_n} to her are blocked for {$block_dur}s: movement speed -{$block_slow*100}%, normal melee enemies switch to chasing her and cannot bypass her; hitting already blocked enemies does not refresh the duration (effect halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); damage ×{$grow_dmg_reach}
_zh: 盾斧斩命中的敌人中，离她最近的 {$block_n} 名被阻挡 {$block_dur} 秒：移速 -{$block_slow*100}%，近战杂兵改追她、无法绕过；已被阻挡者再受击不刷新（精英效果减半，Boss 除外）；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_reach}

en: When Shield Axe Slash hits {$heavy_n} or more enemies at once, the shield slams the ground: enemies within a radius of {$heavy_r} take {$heavy_mult*100}% damage; the Leader's next received attack is guaranteed to be blocked (valid for {$heavy_force_dur}s, at most once every {$heavy_force_cd}s); damage ×{$grow_dmg_heavy}
_zh: 盾斧斩一次命中 {$heavy_n} 名及以上敌人时，盾面压地：半径 {$heavy_r} 内受到 {$heavy_mult*100}% 伤害；队长的下一次受击必定被格挡（{$heavy_force_dur} 秒内有效，{$heavy_force_cd} 秒内至多一次）；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_heavy}

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Thorns'; unlocks Talent 'Tactical Armor': When the Leader is attacked, has a {$block_chance*100}% chance to completely block it, blocked attacks do not reduce Light; Normal attack 'Counter Stance': Within {$stance_dur}s after blocking, Shield Axe Slash damage +{$stance_dmg*100}%
_zh: 解锁二技能「荆棘」；解锁天赋「战术装甲」：队长受到攻击时有 {$block_chance*100}% 概率完全格挡，挡下的不掉灯火；普攻「反击架势」：格挡后 {$stance_dur} 秒内盾斧斩伤害 +{$stance_dmg*100}%

en: Within {$stance_dur}s after a successful 'Tactical Armor' block, Shield Axe Slash damage +{$stance_dmg*100}%, the slash turns dark red, and the shield edge glows red (does not stack, blocking again refreshes the duration)
_zh: 「战术装甲」格挡成功后 {$stance_dur} 秒内，盾斧斩伤害 +{$stance_dmg*100}%，刀光转为暗红，盾沿亮起红光（不叠加，再次格挡刷新时间）

en: Every time an attack is blocked, enemies within a radius of {$block_kb_r} around the Leader are Stunned for {$wall_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses immune)
_zh: 每次格挡时，队长身边半径 {$block_kb_r} 内的敌人眩晕 {$wall_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 免疫）

en: Every time an attack is blocked, enemies within a radius of {$block_kb_r} around the Leader are Stunned for {$wall_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses immune)
_zh: 每次格挡时，队长身边半径 {$block_kb_r} 内的敌人眩晕 {$wall_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 免疫）

en: When Shield Axe Slash hits {$blade_n} or more enemies at once, leaves hot sand at the landing point for {$blade_dur}s (radius {$blade_r}, deals {$blade_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% of ATK per second); during 'Thorns', every slash leaves hot sand, radius ×{$blade_s2_r}
_zh: 盾斧斩一次命中 {$blade_n} 名及以上敌人时，落点留下 {$blade_dur} 秒热砂（半径 {$blade_r}，每秒 {$blade_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 攻击力）；「荆棘」期间每一斩都留，半径 ×{$blade_s2_r}

en: 'Shield Wall' Stuns enemies around the Leader when blocking; 'Hot Sand: Falling Blade' leaves hot sand at the target location when a Shield Axe Slash hits multiple enemies
_zh: 「盾墙」在格挡时眩晕队长周围的敌人；「热砂·落刃」使盾斧斩命中多个敌人时在落点留下热砂
_note: 校对：统一技能名称（Shield Axe Slash）大小写，移除多余的句号

en: When Shield Axe Slash hits {$blade_n} or more enemies at once, leaves hot sand at the landing point for {$blade_dur}s (radius {$blade_r}, deals {$blade_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% of ATK per second); during 'Thorns', every slash leaves hot sand, radius ×{$blade_s2_r}
_zh: 盾斧斩一次命中 {$blade_n} 名及以上敌人时，落点留下 {$blade_dur} 秒热砂（半径 {$blade_r}，每秒 {$blade_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 攻击力）；「荆棘」期间每一斩都留，半径 ×{$blade_s2_r}

en: After each block, enemies within a {$block_kb_r} radius around the Leader take {$wall2_mult*100}% damage and are knocked back; the Leader takes -{$wall2_guard*100}% damage for {$wall2_guard_dur}s
_zh: 每次格挡后，队长周围半径 {$block_kb_r} 内的敌人受到 {$wall2_mult*100}% 伤害并被击退；队长 {$wall2_guard_dur} 秒内受到的伤害 -{$wall2_guard*100}%

en: When a Shield Axe Slash hits an enemy standing in hot sand, the hot sand immediately deals {$boil_frac*100}% of its remaining damage and extinguishes, scattering sparks in a {$boil_r} radius ({$boil_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% damage)
_zh: 盾斧斩命中站在热砂里的敌人时，该处热砂立即结算剩余伤害的 {$boil_frac*100}% 并熄灭，溅出半径 {$boil_r} 的火星（{$boil_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 伤害）
_note: 校对：统一技能名称（Shield Axe Slash）大小写，移除多余的句号

en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Saw of Strength'; Normal attack upgraded to 'Hannya Whirlwind': Every {$saw_every} shield-axe slashes, throws the shield instead. It flies in a straight line for {$saw_len} before returning, dealing ×{$saw_out} damage and knockback on the way out, and ×{$saw_back} damage on the way back.
_zh: 解锁三技能「力之锯」；普通攻击强化「般若回旋」：每第 {$saw_every} 次盾斧斩改为掷出盾牌，沿直线飞出 {$saw_len} 后飞回，去程造成 ×{$saw_out} 伤害并击退，回程造成 ×{$saw_back} 伤害

en: Every {$saw_every} shield-axe slashes, throws the shield 'Hannya' horizontally instead: flies in a straight line for {$saw_len} before returning to hand, dealing ×{$saw_out} damage and knockback on the way out, and ×{$saw_back} damage on the way back; cannot perform shield-axe slashes while the shield is out.
_zh: 每第 {$saw_every} 次盾斧斩改为把盾「般若」横转着掷出：沿直线飞出 {$saw_len} 再飞回手里，去程 ×{$saw_out} 并击退，回程 ×{$saw_back}；盾在外面时不出盾斧斩

_note: 官方 Block 是「阻挡」，这里是格挡
校对：术语不一致：击退应为 knockback

en: Defender Operator, wields a shield-axe. Has a chance to completely block attacks (does not lose Light) and counterattack surrounding enemies with a slash; Warpath initiates with a heavy counter-slash, then raises shield to Steadfast and attracts surrounding enemies; under Saw of Strength, attacks can pierce an entire column.
_zh: 重装干员，持盾斧，一定概率完全格挡攻击（不掉灯火）并反手斩击周遭敌人；战意起手反手重斩，随后举盾坚守并吸引周遭敌人；力之锯状态下攻击可贯穿一整列

en: Elite Operator of the Special Service of the Lungmen Guard Department. Stand by her side when you are scared. It really helps.
_zh: 龙门近卫局特别任务组精英干员，害怕的时候可以站在她身边壮胆
_note: 第二句是官方 char_136_hsguma.itemDesc 原文

en: After promotion to Elite 1: When the Leader stands still, she raises her shield to protect the Leader, increasing the block chance of 'Tactical Armor' by half; lowers the shield when the Leader moves.
_zh: 晋升至精英一后：队长站定不动时，她举盾护住队长，「战术装甲」的格挡概率提高一半；队长移动就收盾
_note: 校对：大小写错误：moves 不应大写

en: Every {$cd}s, thrusts in a straight line toward the nearest enemy (length {$len}, width {$width}, pierces), dealing 2 hits each time (Guard - Swordmaster Trait).
_zh: 每 {$cd} 秒朝最近的敌人直线穿刺（长 {$len}、宽 {$width}，穿透），每次 2 段（近卫·剑豪特性）

en: The first enemy hit by the next thrust Levitates for {$s1_lift}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), followed immediately by another thrust (2 hits, ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2} each).
_zh: 下一次刺击命中的第一个敌人浮空 {$s1_lift} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），随即再补一刺（2 段各 ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2}）

en: Slashes in a frontal cone, dealing ×{$s2_mult*$k_pow:2} damage to up to {$s2_n} enemies and Levitating them for {$s2_lift}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).
_zh: 向前方锥形斩击，最多 {$s2_n} 名敌人 ×{$s2_mult*$k_pow:2}，浮空 {$s2_lift} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）

en: A shockwave launches all enemies within a {$s3_r} radius of herself (×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}) and Levitates them for {$s3_lift}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), then turns around and fires {$s3_strikes} rapid shots with her hand cannon in all directions, each shot dealing ×{$s3_strike_mult*$k_pow:2} damage in a small area around the target, prioritizing Levitated targets.
_zh: 冲击波掀起自身半径 {$s3_r} 内全部敌人（×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}）并浮空 {$s3_lift} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），随后转身用手炮向四周连射 {$s3_strikes} 发，每发 ×{$s3_strike_mult*$k_pow:2} 打目标周围小范围，优先打浮空目标

en: Damage dealt by herself to Levitated / Stunned / Bound enemies +{$talent_bonus*100}%.
_zh: 自身对浮空 / 眩晕 / 束缚中的敌人伤害 +{$talent_bonus*100}%

en: Thrust becomes 3 hits (the third hit deals {$retrial_mult*100}% damage).
_zh: 刺击变为 3 段（第三段刺击 {$retrial_mult*100}% 伤害）

en: The first enemy hit by the 1st hit of the thrust Halts for {$strict_halt}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), and the 2nd hit is guaranteed to hit that enemy; damage ×{$grow_dmg_strict}.
_zh: 刺击第 1 段命中的第一个敌人停顿 {$strict_halt} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），第 2 段必中该敌人；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_strict}
_note: 校对：术语不一致：停顿应为 Halt (Halts)

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Shattertide'; unlocks Talent 'Flames of Castigation': Deals +{$talent_bonus*100}% damage to enemies under crowd control; Normal attack 'Upward Thrust': Levitates the first enemy hit by the 2nd hit of the thrust for {$pick_lift}s (at most once every {$pick_cd}s; halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: 解锁二技能「裂潮」；解锁天赋「审判之火」：自身对受控敌人伤害 +{$talent_bonus*100}%；普攻「挑刺」：刺击第 2 段命中的第一个敌人浮空 {$pick_lift} 秒（每 {$pick_cd} 秒至多一次，精英减半，Boss 除外）

en: Levitates the first enemy hit by the 2nd hit of the thrust for {$pick_lift}s (at most once every {$pick_cd}s; halved on Elites, Bosses excepted). The enemy receives the damage bonus from 'Flames of Castigation' while Levitated
_zh: 刺击第 2 段命中的第一个敌人被挑起浮空 {$pick_lift} 秒（每 {$pick_cd} 秒至多一次；精英减半，Boss 除外），浮空期间受到「审判之火」的伤害加成

en: The target Levitated by 'Gust' sweeps up enemies within a radius of {$gale_r} to be Levitated together for {$gale_lift}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: 「起风」浮空的目标卷起身边 {$gale_r} 内的敌人一起浮空 {$gale_lift} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）

en: The target Levitated by 'Gust' sweeps up enemies within a radius of {$gale_r} to be Levitated together for {$gale_lift}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
_zh: 「起风」浮空的目标卷起身边 {$gale_r} 内的敌人一起浮空 {$gale_lift} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）
「裂潮」{$tide2_delay} 秒后再斩一次（{$tide2_mult*100}% 伤害，重新瞄准）

en: 'Whirlwind' causes the Levitate effect of 'Gust' to spread to enemies around the target; 'Second Shattertide' adds an additional slash to 'Shattertide'
_zh: 「卷风」使「起风」的浮空效果波及目标周围的敌人；「二度裂潮」使「裂潮」追加一次斩击
「裂潮」{$tide2_delay} 秒后再斩一次（{$tide2_mult*100}% 伤害，重新瞄准）

en: {$gale2_delay}s after 'Gust', enemies within a radius of {$gale_r*$gale2_r_k:0} around herself (mostly those swept up) take an additional {$gale2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% damage from a thrust
_zh: 「起风」{$gale2_delay} 秒后，自身周围 {$gale_r*$gale2_r_k:0} 内（多为被卷起的）敌人再受刺击 {$gale2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 伤害

en: A third slash {$tide2_delay*2}s after 'Shattertide': Deals {$tide3_mult*100}% damage within a radius of {$tide_r} around herself
_zh: 「裂潮」{$tide2_delay*2} 秒后第三次斩击：以自身为中心半径 {$tide_r}，裂潮 {$tide3_mult*100}% 伤害

en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Judgment': A shockwave knocks up enemies in an area, followed by {$s3_strikes} consecutive hand cannon shots; Normal attack upgrade 'Shattertide Aftermath': Every 3rd thrust ends with a frontal cone slash (×{$tide_mult}), Levitating hit enemies for {$tide_lift}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), followed by hand cannon pursuit on {$tide_shots} of them (deals {$pursue_mult*100}% damage of a hand cannon shot); hitting a Levitated enemy adds a hand cannon shot (deals {$pursue_mult*100}% damage, at most once every {$pursue_cd}s)
_zh: 解锁三技能「判决」：冲击波掀起一片，随后转身手炮连射 {$s3_strikes} 发；普通攻击强化「裂潮余波」：每第 3 次刺击收尾改为前方锥形斩（×{$tide_mult}），被斩中的敌人浮空 {$tide_lift} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），随后手炮追击其中 {$tide_shots} 名（手炮一发的 {$pursue_mult*100}%）；刺中浮空的敌人时追加一发手炮（{$pursue_mult*100}%，每 {$pursue_cd} 秒至多一次）

en: Every 3rd thrust ends with a frontal 90° crescent slash (radius {$tide_r}, ×{$tide_mult}), Levitating hit enemies for {$tide_lift}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), followed by hand cannon pursuit on {$tide_shots} Levitated enemies among them (deals {$pursue_mult*100}% damage of a hand cannon shot); hitting a Levitated enemy adds a hand cannon shot (at most once every {$pursue_cd}s)
_zh: 每第 3 次刺击，收尾改为前方 90° 新月斩（半径 {$tide_r}，×{$tide_mult}），斩中的敌人浮空 {$tide_lift} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），随后手炮追击其中浮空的 {$tide_shots} 名（手炮一发的 {$pursue_mult*100}%）；刺中浮空的敌人时追加一发手炮（每 {$pursue_cd} 秒至多一次）

en: Guard Operator, thrusts with a greatsword. Normal attacks hit twice and pierce enemies in a straight line, Levitating them upon skill hit; deals +{$talent_bonus*100}% damage to enemies under crowd control such as Levitate and Stun
_zh: 近卫干员，持重剑直刺。普攻两段穿透直线敌人，技能命中后浮空；对浮空、眩晕等受控敌人伤害 +{$talent_bonus*100}%

en: Against cultists and Seaborn, the rapier in her hand spares no one.
_zh: 面对邪教徒和海嗣时，她手中细剑绝对不会姑息任何一个敌人
_note: 候选2：When she faces cultists and Seaborn, her rapier shows no mercy to a single enemy.

en: When switching to regroup, she kicks up a gust of wind around herself, Levitating nearby enemies for 0.8s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted) to cover the squad's retreat
_zh: 切到归队时，她在身边扬起一阵风，周围的敌人浮空 0.8 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），掩护队伍收拢

en: Heals once every {$heal_cd}s: Heals the Leader when they are in danger, otherwise heals the one with a lower HP percentage (the Leader recovers {$heal_pct*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP); the Follow Mon3tr automatically bites enemies around the Leader (Physical), causing about {$m3_aggro_share*100}% of melee enemies within a radius of {$m3_aggro_r} to pursue it instead. It collapses when HP reaches 0, and revives next to the Leader after {$m3_revive_secs}s
_zh: 每 {$heal_cd} 秒治疗一次：队长危险时治疗队长，否则治疗生命比例更低的一方（队长回复 {$heal_pct*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命）；随行的 Mon3tr 自动撕咬队长身边的敌人（物理），身边 {$m3_aggro_r} 内约 {$m3_aggro_share*100}% 的近战敌人改为追击它，血空倒地，{$m3_revive_secs} 秒后在队长身边复活

en: Immediately restores {$s1_heal*$k_atk*$k_pow*100:2}% Max HP to the Leader and clears Nervous Impairment
_zh: 立即为队长回复 {$s1_heal*$k_atk*$k_pow*100:2}% 最大生命并清除神经损伤

en: Permanently takes effect after 1 charge: Mon3tr ATK speed +{$s2_aspd*100-100}%, claw strike range +{$s2_reach*100-100}%, Kal'tsit's healing frequency +{$s2_heal*100-100}%
_zh: 充能一次后永久生效：Mon3tr 攻击速度 +{$s2_aspd*100-100}%、爪击范围 +{$s2_reach*100-100}%，凯尔希的治疗频率 +{$s2_heal*100-100}%

en: Mon3tr's claw strikes deal True damage and damage ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2} for {$s3_dur}s; Meltdown upon ending: Deals {$melt_mult*$k_pow:2} times True damage within a radius of {$melt_r} (if 'Non-Damaging Restructuring' is not selected, additionally Stuns for {$melt_stun_lo}s and causes knockback)
_zh: Mon3tr {$s3_dur} 秒内爪击改为真实伤害且伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}；结束时熔毁：周围 {$melt_r} 内造成 {$melt_mult*$k_pow:2} 倍真实伤害（未选「不毁重构」时另眩晕 {$melt_stun_lo} 秒并击退）

en: Healing +{$e1_heal*100-100}% (Elite 2 +{$e2_heal*100-100}%); Mon3tr damage +{$e1_dmg*100-100}%, claw strike range +{$e1_reach*100-100}%
Mon3tr strikes twice with every claw strike: A second claw slashes across after {$claw2_delay}s (deals {$claw2_mult*100}% damage)
_zh: Mon3tr 每次爪击挥出两爪：{$claw2_delay} 秒后第二爪交叉划过（{$claw2_mult*100}% 伤害）

en: After Mon3tr's claw attacks hit the same enemy {$clear_n} times, an explosion occurs on that enemy (radius {$clear_r}, deals True damage equal to {$clear_mult*100}% of Mon3tr's ATK) and clears the hit count; the count is cleared if the enemy is not hit by a claw attack again within {$clear_win}s.
_zh: Mon3tr 的爪击在同一名敌人身上累积 {$clear_n} 次后，该敌人身上爆开一圈（半径 {$clear_r}，Mon3tr 攻击 {$clear_mult*100}% 的真实伤害）并清空累积；{$clear_win} 秒内没有再被爪击则清空

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Command: Tactical Coordination'; unlocks Talent 'Command': Healing +{$e1_heal*100-100}%; Mon3tr damage +{$e1_dmg*100-100}%, claw strike range +{$e1_reach*100-100}%; Normal attack 'Pounce': When Mon3tr's target is outside its claw strike range (and further than {$lunge_min}), it pounces first, dealing {$lunge_mult*100}% damage upon landing (at most once every {$lunge_cd}s).
_zh: 解锁二技能「指令：战术协同」；解锁天赋「指挥」：治疗量 +{$e1_heal*100-100}%；Mon3tr 伤害 +{$e1_dmg*100-100}%，爪击范围 +{$e1_reach*100-100}%；普攻「扑击」：Mon3tr 的目标在爪击范围外（且远于 {$lunge_min}）时先扑过去，落地造成 {$lunge_mult*100}% 伤害（每 {$lunge_cd} 秒至多一次）
_note: 校对：统一“爪击”为“claw strike”；统一“Mon3tr 伤害”为“Mon3tr damage”。

en: When Mon3tr's target is outside its claw strike range (and further than {$lunge_min}), it pounces first, dealing {$lunge_mult*100}% damage to enemies within a radius of {$lunge_r} upon landing, then attacks with its claws (at most once every {$lunge_cd}s).
_zh: Mon3tr 盯上的目标在爪击范围外（且远于 {$lunge_min}）时先扑过去，落地对半径 {$lunge_r} 内的敌人造成 {$lunge_mult*100}% 伤害，再出爪（每 {$lunge_cd} 秒至多一次）
_note: 校对：统一“爪击范围”为“claw strike range”。

en: 'Command: Structural Fortification' also reduces damage taken by the Leader by {$shell_red*100}%, lasting for {$shell_dur}s.
_zh: 「指令：结构加固」同时使队长受到的伤害 -{$shell_red*100}%，持续 {$shell_dur} 秒

en: 'Command: Structural Fortification' also reduces damage taken by the Leader by {$shell_red*100}%, lasting for {$shell_dur}s.
_zh: 「指令：结构加固」同时使队长受到的伤害 -{$shell_red*100}%，持续 {$shell_dur} 秒

en: When 'Command: Structural Fortification' is used, Mon3tr restructures its outer shell on the spot: explodes 3 times consecutively (radius expands each time, deals True damage equal to {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% / {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*50:1}% / {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*50:1}% of Mon3tr's ATK) and Stuns for {$rebuild_stun}s; after Elite 2, when 'Command: Meltdown' ends, it also explodes 3 times consecutively (interval of {$melt_echo_gap}s, the last 2 times deal {$melt_echo_mult*100}% damage) and Stuns for {$melt_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses immune).
_zh: 「指令：结构加固」施放时 Mon3tr 就地重构外壳：连续爆炸三次（半径逐次扩大，Mon3tr 攻击 {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% / {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*50:1}% / {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*50:1}% 真实伤害）并眩晕 {$rebuild_stun} 秒；精英二后「指令：熔毁」结束时同样连续爆炸三次（间隔 {$melt_echo_gap} 秒、后 2 次 {$melt_echo_mult*100}% 伤害）并眩晕 {$melt_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 免疫）
_note: 校对：“Boss 免疫”误译为“Bosses excepted”，应为“Bosses immune”。

en: 'Structural Fortification' makes Skill 1 also protect the Leader; 'Non-Damaging Restructuring' makes Mon3tr explode 3 times consecutively when Skill 1 is used and when Skill 3 ends after Elite 2.
_zh: 「结构加固」使一技能同时保护队长；「不毁重构」使 Mon3tr 在一技能释放时及精英二后三技能结束时连续爆炸三次

en: When 'Command: Structural Fortification' is used, Mon3tr restructures its outer shell on the spot: explodes 3 times consecutively (radius expands each time, deals True damage equal to {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% / {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*50:1}% / {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*50:1}% of Mon3tr's ATK) and Stuns for {$rebuild_stun}s; after Elite 2, when 'Command: Meltdown' ends, it also explodes 3 times consecutively (interval of {$melt_echo_gap}s, the last 2 times deal {$melt_echo_mult*100}% damage) and Stuns for {$melt_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses immune).
_zh: 「指令：结构加固」施放时 Mon3tr 就地重构外壳：连续爆炸三次（半径逐次扩大，Mon3tr 攻击 {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% / {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*50:1}% / {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*50:1}% 真实伤害）并眩晕 {$rebuild_stun} 秒；精英二后「指令：熔毁」结束时同样连续爆炸三次（间隔 {$melt_echo_gap} 秒、后 2 次 {$melt_echo_mult*100}% 伤害）并眩晕 {$melt_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 免疫）
_note: 校对：“Boss 免疫”误译为“Bosses excepted”，应为“Bosses immune”。

en: When 'Command: Structural Fortification' is used, restores {$shell2_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP to the Leader and clears Nervous Impairment.
_zh: 「指令：结构加固」施放时，队长回复 {$shell2_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命并清除神经损伤

en: After the 3 consecutive explosions from Mon3tr's restructuring when 'Command: Structural Fortification' is used, leaves slag at the explosion center for {$melt4_dur}s: deals True damage equal to {$melt4_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% of Mon3tr's ATK to enemies within a radius of {$rebuild_r*1.5:0} every {$melt4_every}s; after Elite 2, the 3 consecutive explosions from 'Command: Meltdown' also leave slag (radius {$melt_r}).
_zh: 「指令：结构加固」施放时 Mon3tr 重构后的三连爆之后，爆心留下 {$melt4_dur} 秒熔渣：每 {$melt4_every} 秒对半径 {$rebuild_r*1.5:0} 内的敌人造成 Mon3tr 攻击 {$melt4_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 真实伤害；精英二后「指令：熔毁」三连爆之后同样留下熔渣（半径 {$melt_r}）

en: Talent 'Command' healing increased to +{$e2_heal*100-100}%; unlocks Skill 3 'Command: Meltdown': Mon3tr's claw attacks deal True damage and damage is multiplied by {$s3_mult*$k_pow:2} for {$s3_dur}s; upon ending, melts down: deals True damage equal to {$melt_mult*$k_pow:2} times ATK to enemies within a radius of {$melt_r}; Normal attack enhancement 'Omnidirectional Deployment': Mon3tr attacks with claws to the front and back simultaneously (the backward claw deals {$m_back_mult*100}% damage); 'Fall Back': When the Leader is attacked, Mon3tr leaps back to the Leader, dealing {$leap_mult} times damage to enemies within a radius of {$leap_r} and causing knockback (at most once every {$guard_cd}s); 'Non-Damaging Restructuring': When Mon3tr falls, it explodes on the spot, dealing True damage equal to {$rebuild_mult} times ATK to enemies within a radius of {$rebuild_r} and Stuns them for {$rebuild_stun}s.
_zh: 天赋「指挥」治疗量提升至 +{$e2_heal*100-100}%；解锁三技能「指令：熔毁」：Mon3tr {$s3_dur} 秒内爪击改为真实伤害且伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}；结束时熔毁：周围 {$melt_r} 内造成 {$melt_mult*$k_pow:2} 倍真实伤害；普通攻击强化「八面展开」：Mon3tr 前后同时出爪（身后一爪 {$m_back_mult*100}%）；「回防」：队长受到攻击时，Mon3tr 跃回队长身边，对周围半径 {$leap_r} 内的敌人造成 ×{$leap_mult} 伤害并击退（每 {$guard_cd} 秒至多一次）；「不毁重构」：Mon3tr 倒下时就地爆炸，对周围半径 {$rebuild_r} 内的敌人造成 ×{$rebuild_mult} 倍真实伤害并眩晕 {$rebuild_stun} 秒

en: When the Leader is attacked, Mon3tr leaps back to the Leader, dealing {$leap_mult} times damage to enemies within a radius of {$leap_r} upon landing and causing knockback (at most once every {$guard_cd}s); 'Omnidirectional Deployment' continues to attack with claws to the front and back simultaneously (the backward claw deals {$m_back_mult*100}% damage).
_zh: 队长受到攻击时，Mon3tr 跃回队长身边，落地对周围半径 {$leap_r} 内的敌人造成 ×{$leap_mult} 伤害并击退（每 {$guard_cd} 秒至多一次）；「八面展开」前后同时出爪照旧（身后一爪 {$m_back_mult*100}%）

_note: 可能偏长：12 字母 / 中文 3 字

en: Medic Operator, head of the Rhodes Island medical project, restores HP to the Leader and Mon3tr; the Follow Mon3tr tears apart approaching enemies and draws away some melee enemies for the Leader, reviving {$m3_revive_secs}s after falling.
_zh: 医疗干员，罗德岛医疗项目负责人，为队长与 Mon3tr 回复生命；随行的 Mon3tr 撕碎靠近的敌人并替队长引走一部分近战敌人，倒下后 {$m3_revive_secs} 秒复活

en: The voice of this land (crossed out)
_zh: 这片大地的代言人（划掉）

en: Command: Tactical Coordination — Mon3tr permanently enhanced
_zh: 指令：战术协同 —— Mon3tr 永久强化

en: Every time the Leader uses a skill, Mon3tr leaps back to the Leader, pouncing on surrounding enemies upon landing and causing knockback (at most once every 3s).
_zh: 队长每次开技能，Mon3tr 跃回队长身边，落地扑击周围的敌人并将其击退（每 3 秒至多一次）

en: Every {$cd}s, swings twin blades around the Leader (Physical, approx. 150° fan, radius {$reach}); Guard - Lord trait: When enemies are far away (outside swing reach), instead throws a sword aura at the nearest enemy within {$blade_aim} every {$far_every}s, dealing {$far_mult*100}% of ATK as damage, traveling {$blade_dist} and disappearing upon hitting the first enemy; Ranged attacks no longer deal reduced damage during 'Wolf Spirit'.
_zh: 每 {$cd} 秒在队长身边挥出双刃横扫（物理，扇形约 150°，半径 {$reach}）；近卫·领主特性：敌人离得远（超出横扫触及）时，改为每 {$far_every} 秒朝 {$blade_aim} 内最近的敌人掷出一道剑气，造成攻击 {$far_mult*100}% 的伤害，飞出 {$blade_dist}，命中第一名敌人即消失；「狼魂」期间远程不再削弱
_note: 校对：术语“物理”应为“Physical”，而非“Physical damage”。

en: Permanent effect after 1 charge: ATK +{$s1_atk*100-100}%; Attacks taken by the Leader have a {$s1_resist*100}% chance to be blocked by her (completely negating the hit).
_zh: 充能一次后永久生效：攻击 +{$s1_atk*100-100}%；队长受到的攻击有 {$s1_resist*100}% 概率被她格挡（完全抵消这一下）

en: ATK +{$s2_atk*100-100}% for {$s2_dur}s. Every swing additionally throws an Arts sword aura ({$s2_mult*100}% of swing damage, travels {$blade_dist}, pierces).
_zh: {$s2_dur} 秒内攻击 +{$s2_atk*100-100}%，每次横扫额外掷出一道法术剑气（横扫 {$s2_mult*100}% 伤害，飞出 {$blade_dist}，穿透）

en: ATK +{$s3_atk*100-100}% for {$s3_dur}s. Every hit inflicts 1 stack of 'Observation' on the enemy; when the same enemy reaches {$s3_mark_n} stacks within {$s3_keep}s, lockdown is complete: performs a cross slash dealing {$s3_cut_mult*100}% of ATK as damage, seals them for {$s3_seal}s (halved on Elites, {$s3_seal*$seal_boss:2}s on Bosses), Stuns them for {$s3_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), and increases damage taken by 10% for {$s3_fragile}s.
_zh: {$s3_dur} 秒内攻击力 +{$s3_atk*100-100}%，每次命中在敌人身上刻下一道「观察」；同一名敌人 {$s3_keep} 秒内被刻满 {$s3_mark_n} 道即封锁完成：十字斩造成攻击力 {$s3_cut_mult*100}% 的伤害，封印 {$s3_seal} 秒（精英减半，Boss {$s3_seal*$seal_boss:2} 秒）、眩晕 {$s3_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），并在 {$s3_fragile} 秒内受到的伤害 +10%

en: Enemies hit by swings are sealed for {$seal_dur}s: cannot use new special moves, cannot fire ranged attacks, and shell/tide shields are disabled (halved on Elites; Bosses only have their moves delayed by {$seal_dur*$seal_boss:2}s, then become immune for {$seal_boss_imm}s).
_zh: 横扫命中的敌人被封印 {$seal_dur} 秒：不起新的特殊招式、不远程开火、甲壳 / 潮盾失效（精英减半；Boss 只推迟出招 {$seal_dur*$seal_boss:2} 秒，之后 {$seal_boss_imm} 秒免疫）

en: Every swing becomes a double slash: performs an additional slash after {$twin_delay}s ({$twin_mult*100}% damage).
_zh: 每次横扫变为两连斩：{$twin_delay} 秒后再补一刀（{$twin_mult*100}% 伤害）

en: Sword auras now track targets: prioritizes the enemy with the lowest HP percentage within {$blade_aim} (instead of the nearest), turning along an arc ({$far_turn} rad/s).
_zh: 剑气改为追踪：优先飞向 {$blade_aim} 内生命比例最低的敌人（不再取最近的），沿弧线转向（{$far_turn} 弧度/秒）

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Wolf Spirit'; unlocks Talent 'Spiritual Destruction': Enemies hit by swings are sealed for {$seal_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses only have their moves delayed by {$seal_dur*$seal_boss:2}s); Normal attack 'Wolf Dance': Every {$dance_n}th swing becomes a spinning slash: deals ×{$dance_mult} damage within a radius of {$dance_r} around herself, inflicts knockback and seals for {$dance_seal}s.
_zh: 解锁二技能「狼魂」；解锁天赋「精神摧毁」：横扫命中的敌人被封印 {$seal_dur} 秒（精英减半，Boss 只推迟出招 {$seal_dur*$seal_boss:2} 秒）；普攻「狼之舞」：每第 {$dance_n} 次横扫改为旋身斩：以自身为中心半径 {$dance_r} 内 ×{$dance_mult} 伤害、击退并封印 {$dance_seal} 秒

en: Every {$dance_n}th swing becomes a spinning slash: deals ×{$dance_mult} damage within a radius of {$dance_r} around herself, inflicts knockback, and seals hit enemies for {$dance_seal}s.
_zh: 每第 {$dance_n} 次横扫改为旋身斩：以自身为中心半径 {$dance_r} 内 ×{$dance_mult} 伤害，击退，命中的敌人封印 {$dance_seal} 秒

en: Every {$bark_n}th swing releases a shockwave: deals {$bark_mult*100}% of swing damage within a radius of {$bark_r}, inflicts knockback and seals for {$bark_seal}s.
_zh: 每第 {$bark_n} 次横扫放出一圈冲击：半径 {$bark_r} 内横扫 {$bark_mult*100}% 伤害，击退并封印 {$bark_seal} 秒

en: Every {$bark_n}th swing releases a shockwave: deals {$bark_mult*100}% of swing damage within a radius of {$bark_r}, inflicts knockback and seals for {$bark_seal}s.
_zh: 每第 {$bark_n} 次横扫放出一圈冲击：半径 {$bark_r} 内横扫 {$bark_mult*100}% 伤害，击退并封印 {$bark_seal} 秒

en: After a successful 'Sundial' block, the next sword aura becomes a large sword aura: width ×{$dial_w_mult}, pierces all enemies; if the next swing has no sword aura, additionally throws one ({$dial_mult*100}% damage); Damage ×{$grow_dmg_rage}.
_zh: 「日晷」格挡成功后，下一道剑气变为大剑气：宽度 ×{$dial_w_mult}，穿透全部敌人；下一次横扫没有剑气时，额外掷出一道（{$dial_mult*100}% 伤害）；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_rage}

en: 'Bark' triggers a sealing shockwave every {$bark_n}th swing; 'Sundial - Counter Slash' turns the next sword aura into a large sword aura after a successful block.
_zh: 「断喝」每 {$bark_n} 次横扫触发封印冲击；「日晷·反斩」格挡成功后下一道剑气变为大剑气

en: After a successful 'Sundial' block, the next sword aura becomes a large sword aura: width ×{$dial_w_mult}, pierces all enemies; if the next swing has no sword aura, additionally throws one ({$dial_mult*100}% damage); Damage ×{$grow_dmg_rage}.
_zh: 「日晷」格挡成功后，下一道剑气变为大剑气：宽度 ×{$dial_w_mult}，穿透全部敌人；下一次横扫没有剑气时，额外掷出一道（{$dial_mult*100}% 伤害）；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_rage}

en: When an enemy sealed by her dies, the seal spreads along a radius of {$spread_r}: up to {$spread_n} surrounding enemies are sealed for {$spread_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), erupting a sealing ring at the location of death.
_zh: 被她封印的敌人死亡时，封印沿半径 {$spread_r} 扩散：至多 {$spread_n} 名周围敌人被封印 {$spread_dur} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），死亡处炸出一圈封印环

en: Upon a successful 'Sundial' block, performs a counterattack in place towards the nearest enemy: {$riposte_half*2}° frontal fan, radius {$riposte_r}, {$riposte_mult*100}% damage, inflicts knockback of {$riposte_kb}; at most once every {$riposte_cd}s.
_zh: 「日晷」格挡成功时，朝最近的敌人原地斩出一记反击：前方 {$riposte_half*2}° 扇形，半径 {$riposte_r}，{$riposte_mult*100}% 伤害，击退 {$riposte_kb}；{$riposte_cd} 秒内至多一次

en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Hush': Hits inflict 'Observation' stacks for {$s3_dur}s, performs a cross slash and seals the enemy when reaching {$s3_mark_n} stacks; Normal attack upgrade 'Twinborn Blades': Every swing throws two crossing sword auras (each dealing {$twin_blade_mult*100}% damage, ±{$twin_fan}°, each enemy takes only one per round), the single sword aura thrown when far away remains unchanged.
_zh: 解锁三技能「噤声」：{$s3_dur} 秒内命中叠「观察」，叠满 {$s3_mark_n} 道时十字斩并封印敌人；普通攻击强化「双生刃」：每次横扫都掷出两道交叉剑气（各 {$twin_blade_mult*100}% 伤害，±{$twin_fan}°，每名敌人每轮只受一道），离得远时掷出的单道剑气照旧

en: Every swing throws two crossing sword auras (each dealing {$twin_blade_mult*100}% of swing damage, ±{$twin_fan}°, traveling {$blade_dist} and disappearing upon hitting the first enemy; each enemy takes only one per round).
_zh: 每次横扫都掷出两道交叉剑气（各横扫 {$twin_blade_mult*100}% 伤害，±{$twin_fan}°，飞出 {$blade_dist}，命中第一名敌人即消失；每名敌人每轮只受一道）

en: Guard Operator. Sweeps with twin blades when enemies are close, and throws sword auras from afar (Guard - Lord Trait). After promoting to Elite 1, each slash seals the enemy's special abilities. Skill 3 'Hush' locks down the enemy after applying three observation marks.
_zh: 近卫干员，敌人贴近时双刃横扫，离得远则掷出剑气（近卫·领主特性）；晋升至精英一后每次斩击封印敌人的特殊招式，三技能「噤声」刻满三道观察即封锁敌人

en: A lone wolf. Now a Guard Operator, she shows full annihilation capability in tactical assaults and mop-up operations.
_zh: 她是落单的狼，现作为近卫干员，于战术攻坚与肃清作战中展现出十足的歼灭能力
_note: 候选2：She is a wolf without a pack. As a Guard Operator, she excels at breaching and clearing operations.
校对：与 p14 的「日晷·回敬」(Sundial - Riposte) 保持术语一致

en: Every {$cd}s, a spell drifts from the pen tip, flying slowly toward an enemy. Deals Arts damage upon hit (single target, splashes {$aoe_mult*100}% in a small area around the target) and inflicts 'Requiem' for {$requiem_dur}s: Arts damage taken +{$requiem_bonus*100}% (benefits all allied Arts damage).
_zh: 每 {$cd} 秒从笔尖飘出一枚咒文，缓慢飞向一名敌人，命中造成法术伤害（单体，命中处小范围溅射 {$aoe_mult*100}%），并附加「安魂」{$requiem_dur} 秒：受到的法术伤害 +{$requiem_bonus*100}%（全队的法术伤害都受益）

en: Locks onto an enemy for {$s1_dur}s (prioritizes Elites / Bosses), dealing Arts damage every {$s1_tick}s. Damage against the same target gradually increases up to ×{$s1_max}, and Slow effect deepens.
_zh: {$s1_dur} 秒内锁定一名敌人（优先精英 / Boss），每 {$s1_tick} 秒造成法术伤害，对同一目标伤害逐步升到 ×{$s1_max}、减速加深

en: Activates permanently after 1 charge: Attack Range +{$s2_range*100}%, ATK +{$s2_atk*100}%. Normal attacks instantly execute non-Elite enemies with HP lower than ATK ×{$s2_exec}; excess damage is transferred to another random enemy.
_zh: 充能一次后永久生效：攻击范围 +{$s2_range*100}%、攻击 +{$s2_atk*100}%；普攻直接处决生命低于其攻击 ×{$s2_exec} 的非精英敌人，溢出伤害转给随机另一名敌人

en: Expands a {$s3_fan_deg}° fan-shaped spell domain for {$s3_dur}s (automatically faces the direction with the most enemies and rotates slowly): Enemies within the area take Arts damage every {$s3_tick}s and are inflicted with 'Requiem'. Enemy projectile speed -{(1-$s3_bullet_slow)*100}%. All projectiles within the area disappear when the skill ends. During this time, normal attacks only target enemies within the area.
_zh: 展开 {$s3_fan_deg}° 扇形咒域 {$s3_dur} 秒（自动朝向敌人最多的方向并缓慢转动）：区域内敌人每 {$s3_tick} 秒受到法术伤害并附加「安魂」，敌方弹幕速度 -{(1-$s3_bullet_slow)*100}%，结束时区域内弹幕全部消失；期间普攻只打区域内的敌人

en: {$talent_chance*100}% chance to additionally attack a random enemy (deals {$talent_mult*100}% damage) and Slow them for {$talent_slow}s.
_zh: {$talent_chance*100}% 概率额外攻击随机一名敌人（{$talent_mult*100}% 伤害）并减速 {$talent_slow} 秒

en: Leaves a glowing spell at the hit location of 'Word' for {$glyph_dur}s, dealing {$glyph_mult*100}% damage to enemies within {$glyph_r} every {$glyph_tick}s (max {$glyph_max} spells).
_zh: 「言」命中处留下一枚发光咒文 {$glyph_dur} 秒，每 {$glyph_tick} 秒对 {$glyph_r} 内敌人造成 {$glyph_mult*100}% 伤害（最多 {$glyph_max} 枚）

en: Each 'Word' attacks 2 targets simultaneously (the second deals {$second_mult*100}% damage).
_zh: 每次「言」同时攻击 2 个目标（第二道 {$second_mult*100}%）

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Perish'. Unlocks Talent 'Lexical Evolution': {$talent_chance*100}% chance to additionally attack a random enemy. Normal attack 'Soul Gouge': 'Requiem' can now stack up to {$rq_max} times, each stack increasing Arts damage taken by +{$rq_per*100}% (replaces the fixed +{$requiem_bonus*100}%).
_zh: 解锁二技能「殁亡」；解锁天赋「语汇演化」：{$talent_chance*100}% 概率额外攻击随机敌人；普攻「剜魂」：「安魂」改为可叠 {$rq_max} 层，每层受到的法术伤害 +{$rq_per*100}%（取代固定 +{$requiem_bonus*100}%）

en: 'Requiem' can stack up to {$rq_max} times: being hit by 'Word' again within {$requiem_dur}s adds a stack and refreshes the duration. Each stack increases Arts damage taken by +{$rq_per*100}% (up to +{$rq_per*$rq_max*100}%, replaces the fixed +{$requiem_bonus*100}%). The rune above the enemy's head displays the stack count.
_zh: 「安魂」可叠 {$rq_max} 层：{$requiem_dur} 秒内再被「言」命中就加一层并刷新时间，每层受到的法术伤害 +{$rq_per*100}%（最多 +{$rq_per*$rq_max*100}%，取代固定 +{$requiem_bonus*100}%）。敌人头顶的符文显示层数

en: When the target locked by 'Synecdoche' dies, switches lock to the nearest enemy for the remaining duration.
_zh: 「提喻」锁定的目标死亡时，转而锁定最近的敌人，持续剩余时间

en: When the target locked by 'Synecdoche' dies, switches lock to the nearest enemy for the remaining duration.
_zh: 「提喻」锁定的目标死亡时，转而锁定最近的敌人，持续剩余时间

en: When 'Perish' executes an enemy, writes a large spell at their location that explodes after {$epitaph_delay}s (radius {$epitaph_r}, {$epitaph_mult*100}% damage).
_zh: 「殁亡」处决敌人时，在其位置写下一枚大咒文，{$epitaph_delay} 秒后爆开（半径 {$epitaph_r}，{$epitaph_mult*100}% 伤害）

en: 'Metonymy' causes 'Synecdoche' to switch lock to the nearest enemy after the target dies; 'Epitaph' leaves an explosive spell when 'Perish' executes an enemy.
_zh: 「转喻」使「提喻」在目标死亡后转而锁定最近的敌人；「墓志铭」使「殁亡」处决时留下爆炸咒文

en: When 'Perish' executes an enemy, writes a large spell at their location that explodes after {$epitaph_delay}s (radius {$epitaph_r}, {$epitaph_mult*100}% damage).
_zh: 「殁亡」处决敌人时，在其位置写下一枚大咒文，{$epitaph_delay} 秒后爆开（半径 {$epitaph_r}，{$epitaph_mult*100}% 伤害）

en: While locked by 'Synecdoche', resonates once every {$meto2_every}s within a radius of {$range*$meto2_r_k:0} centered on himself ({$meto2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% Arts damage).
_zh: 「提喻」锁定期间，每 {$meto2_every} 秒以自身为中心半径 {$range*$meto2_r_k:0} 震荡一次（{$meto2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 法术伤害）

en: Whenever Logos defeats an enemy, writes a small spell at their location that explodes immediately (radius {$epi2_r}, {$epi2_mult*100}% damage).
_zh: 逻各斯每击杀一名敌人，在其位置写下一枚小咒文立即爆开（半径 {$epi2_r}，{$epi2_mult*100}% 伤害）

en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Extended Acuity'. Normal attack enhancement 'Stitch': After 'Word' hits, draws a spell chain from the target to the nearest {$link_n} enemies for {$link_dur}s. When any enemy on the chain takes Arts damage from Logos, the other two each take {$link_share*100}% (excluding the spell domain damage from Skill 3).
_zh: 解锁三技能「延异视阈」；普通攻击强化「连缀」：「言」命中后，从目标向最近 {$link_n} 名敌人拉出咒文链 {$link_dur} 秒；链上任一敌人受到逻各斯的法术伤害时，另外两名各受到 {$link_share*100}%（三技能的咒域伤害除外）

en: After 'Word' hits, creates an incantation chain from the target to the nearest {$link_n} enemies within {$link_r}, lasting {$link_dur}s. When any enemy on the chain takes Arts damage from Logos, the other two each take {$link_share*100}% of this damage. Transferred damage is not transferred again (except for Skill 3's incantation zone damage). Max {$link_cap} chains at a time.
_zh: 「言」命中后，从目标向 {$link_r} 内最近的 {$link_n} 名敌人拉出咒文链，持续 {$link_dur} 秒；链上任一敌人受到逻各斯的法术伤害时，另外两名各受到这次伤害的 {$link_share*100}%，传过去的伤害不再往下传（三技能的咒域伤害除外）。同时最多 {$link_cap} 组

_note: 可能偏长：11 字母 / 中文 3 字

en: Caster Operator. Single-target incantation attacks. Hits inflict 'Requiem', increasing Arts damage taken by the target. After Elite 1, executes non-Elite enemies with low HP. After Elite 2, clears enemy projectiles.
_zh: 术师干员，咒术单体攻击，命中附加「安魂」提升目标所受法术伤害；精英一后处决残血非精英，精英二后清除敌方弹幕

en: The young 'Lady' of the Banshee Valley, organizer of Rhodes Island's stool racing competition.
_zh: 女妖河谷年轻的「女主人」，罗德岛圆凳滑行赛组织创始人
_note: 「圆凳滑行赛」出自档案资料三，en_US handbook_info_table 原文 the stool racing competition…Logos organized that；原作只说组织，不说创始人。「女主人」暂定 'Lady'，保留引号（协调人 11-05 暂定）

en: Perish: Attack Range and ATK permanently increase, executes enemies with low HP
_zh: 殁亡：攻击范围与攻击永久提升，处决残血

en: Whenever the Leader uses a skill, Logos immediately fires an additional 'Word' at the 2 nearest enemies (damage and effects same as normal attacks).
_zh: 队长每次释放技能，逻各斯立刻向最近的两名敌人各追加一枚「言」（伤害与效果同普攻）

en: Restores {$heal_pct*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP to the Leader every {$heal_cd}s. Prioritizes cleansing if the Leader has Corrosion / Nervous Impairment (clears Corrosion, Nervous Impairment -{$nerve_cut}). Fires a light bolt at the nearest enemy within {$bolt_range} range every {$bolt_cd}s (Arts damage, splashes 60% damage in a small area upon hit). Hit targets are Illuminated for 3s (treated as within Light Radius, damage taken +25%).
_zh: 每 {$heal_cd} 秒为队长回复 {$heal_pct*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命；队长带侵蚀 / 神经损伤时优先驱散（侵蚀清除、神经损伤 -{$nerve_cut}）；每 {$bolt_cd} 秒向射程 {$bolt_range} 内最近的敌人射出一束光弹（法术伤害，命中处小范围溅射 60%），命中者被「照亮」3 秒（视为在照亮范围内，受到的伤害 +25%）

en: Restores {$s1_heal*$k_atk*$k_pow*100:2}% Max HP to the Leader, clears Corrosion and Nervous Impairment, grants immunity to Nervous Impairment for {$s1_immune}s, and Light +{$s1_lamp}.
_zh: 回复队长 {$s1_heal*$k_atk*$k_pow*100:2}% 最大生命，清除侵蚀、神经损伤，{$s1_immune} 秒免疫神经损伤，灯火 +{$s1_lamp}

en: Permanently active after 1 charge: Leader's Light Radius +{$light_mult*100-100}%, Light loss when attacked -{(1-$lamp_decay)*100}%. 'Fluorescence' instead restores {$heal_pct*$guide_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP to the Leader each time.
_zh: 充能一次后永久生效：队长照亮范围 +{$light_mult*100-100}%，受击时灯火损失 -{(1-$lamp_decay)*100}%，「荧光」改为每次为队长回复 {$heal_pct*$guide_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命

en: Lighthouse Follow for {$s3_dur}s: Expands a Lighthouse Zone centered on the Leader (radius {$s3_r}, moves with the Leader). Within the zone, the Leader restores {$s3_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP per second, is immune to Corrosion and Nervous Impairment, and penalties from Nethersea Brand and being outside the Black Tide are nullified. Light +{$s3_lamp} per second. Upon ending, triggers a light explosion around the Leader: deals {$s3_burst_mult} times light bolt damage (Arts damage) to enemies within range and Stuns them for {$s3_burst_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses immune).
_zh: 灯塔随行 {$s3_dur} 秒：以队长为中心展开灯塔光圈（半径 {$s3_r}，随队长移动），区内队长每秒回复 {$s3_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命、免疫侵蚀与神经损伤，溟痕与黑潮圈外惩罚失效，每秒灯火 +{$s3_lamp}；结束时在队长身边光爆：对范围内敌人造成 {$s3_burst_mult} 倍光弹伤害（法术）并眩晕 {$s3_burst_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 免疫）
_note: 校对：“Boss 免疫”应翻译为“Bosses immune”；“溟痕与黑潮圈外惩罚失效”原意为“溟痕的惩罚以及处于黑潮圈外的惩罚失效”，原翻译改变了句意。

en: Each time HP is restored or a status is cleansed, Light +{$talent_lamp}. When Light ≥ {$talent_lamp_at} ('Bright'), his own SP Recovery +{$talent_sp*100}%.
_zh: 每次回复或驱散，灯火 +{$talent_lamp}；灯火 ≥ {$talent_lamp_at}（「通明」）时，自身技力回复 +{$talent_sp*100}%

en: A homemade Luminescent Unit floats beside him, firing a light bolt every {$unit_cd}s ({$unit_mult*100}% damage, hit targets are Illuminated).
_zh: 身边浮起一个自制发光单元，每 {$unit_cd} 秒射出光弹（{$unit_mult*100}% 伤害，照亮命中者）

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'In Downpour, Grace'. Unlocks Talent 'An Everyman's Wish': Each time HP is restored or a status is cleansed, Light +{$talent_lamp}; when Light is Bright, his own SP Recovery +{$talent_sp*100}%. Normal attack 'Refraction': When a light bolt hits an already Illuminated enemy, refracts a beam toward the nearest un-Illuminated enemy within {$refract_r} ({$refract_mult*100}% damage, it is Illuminated).
_zh: 解锁二技能「沛霖」；解锁天赋「凡人之愿」：每次回复或驱散，灯火 +{$talent_lamp}；灯火通明时，自身技力回复 +{$talent_sp*100}%；普攻「折光」：光弹命中已被照亮的敌人时，折出一道光射向 {$refract_r} 内最近的未照亮敌人（{$refract_mult*100}% 伤害，照亮它）

en: When a light bolt hits an already Illuminated enemy, refracts a thin beam toward the nearest un-Illuminated enemy within {$refract_r} ({$refract_mult*100}% of light bolt damage, it is Illuminated). Each bolt only refracts once.
_zh: 光弹命中已被照亮的敌人时，折出一道细光射向 {$refract_r} 内最近的未照亮敌人（光弹 {$refract_mult*100}% 伤害，照亮它）；每发只折一次

en: During 'In Drizzle, Privation', Luminescent Units shower light rain within {$rain_r} around the Leader for {$rain_dur}s: enemies in the rain are Illuminated, taking {$rain_mult*100}% damage every {$rain_tick}s.
_zh: 「沐雨」时发光单元在队长周围 {$rain_r} 内洒下光雨 {$rain_dur} 秒：雨中敌人被照亮，每 {$rain_tick} 秒受 {$rain_mult*100}% 伤害

en: During 'In Drizzle, Privation', Luminescent Units shower light rain within {$rain_r} around the Leader for {$rain_dur}s: enemies in the rain are Illuminated, taking {$rain_mult*100}% damage every {$rain_tick}s.
_zh: 「沐雨」时发光单元在队长周围 {$rain_r} 内洒下光雨 {$rain_dur} 秒：雨中敌人被照亮，每 {$rain_tick} 秒受 {$rain_mult*100}% 伤害

en: After 'In Drizzle, Privation', a rotating light beam shines from the Leader for 3s (length {$beam_len}, 1 rotation every {$beam_period}s). Swept enemies take {$beam_mult*100}% damage and are Illuminated. After Elite 2, 'This Lantern Undying' emits the same beam for its entire duration.
_zh: 「沐雨」后，队长身上亮起一道旋转光束 3 秒（长 {$beam_len}，{$beam_period} 秒一圈），扫到的敌人受 {$beam_mult*100}% 伤害并被照亮；精英二后「灯火不灭」全程射出同样的光束

en: 'Light Rain' causes 'In Drizzle, Privation' to Illuminate and damage surrounding enemies; 'Lighthouse Watch' Illuminates and damages enemies with a rotating beam after casting 'In Drizzle, Privation'.
_zh: 「光雨」使「沐雨」照亮并伤害周围敌人；「灯塔守望」在释放「沐雨」后以旋转光束照亮并伤害敌人

en: After 'In Drizzle, Privation', a rotating light beam shines from the Leader for 3s (length {$beam_len}, 1 rotation every {$beam_period}s). Swept enemies take {$beam_mult*100}% damage and are Illuminated. After Elite 2, 'This Lantern Undying' emits the same beam for its entire duration.
_zh: 「沐雨」后，队长身上亮起一道旋转光束 3 秒（长 {$beam_len}，{$beam_period} 秒一圈），扫到的敌人受 {$beam_mult*100}% 伤害并被照亮；精英二后「灯火不灭」全程射出同样的光束

en: During 'In Drizzle, Privation', clears the Leader's Nervous Impairment, Light +{$rain2_lamp}, and restores an additional {$rain2_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP.
_zh: 「沐雨」时清除队长的神经损伤，灯火 +{$rain2_lamp}，再回复 {$rain2_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命

en: During 'In Drizzle, Privation', and every {$watch2_every}s during 'This Lantern Undying', emits a ring of light pulses centered on the Leader with a radius of {$watch2_r} ({$watch2_mult*100}% of light bolt damage, hits Slow for {$watch2_slow}s).
_zh: 「沐雨」时、以及「灯火不灭」期间每 {$watch2_every} 秒，以队长为中心半径 {$watch2_r} 放出一圈光脉冲（光弹 {$watch2_mult*100}% 伤害，命中减速 {$watch2_slow} 秒）

en: Unlocks Skill 3 'This Lantern Undying': Lighthouse Follow for {$s3_dur}s. Within the Lighthouse Zone centered on the Leader, the Leader recovers HP, is immune to Corrosion and Nervous Impairment, and Light recovers; triggers a light burst when it ends. Normal attack enhanced with 'Everlasting': Every {$charge_need} shots fired by Lumen and the Luminescent Unit grants a charge. The next {$charge_shots} shots become Lighthouse Beams: fired straight ahead, piercing all enemies in a line and leaving them Illuminated. Damage ×{$pillar_mult}. Each shot recovers {$charge_heal*100}% Max HP for the Leader.
_zh: 解锁三技能「灯火不灭」：灯塔随行 {$s3_dur} 秒，以队长为中心的灯塔光圈内，队长回复生命、免疫侵蚀与神经损伤，灯火回升，结束时光爆；普通攻击强化「长明」：流明与发光单元每射 {$charge_need} 发攒满一轮，接下来 {$charge_shots} 发变为灯塔光柱：从身前笔直打出，穿透一线上的全部敌人并照亮它们，伤害 ×{$pillar_mult}，每发为队长回复 {$charge_heal*100}% 最大生命
_note: 校对：“发光单元”应统一使用大写专有名词“Luminescent Unit”；“灯塔随行”应统一为“Lighthouse Follow”。

en: Every {$charge_need} shots fired by Lumen and the Luminescent Unit grants a charge. The next {$charge_shots} shots become short straight light beams (length {$pillar_len}): instantly pierce all enemies in a line and leave them Illuminated. Damage ×{$pillar_mult}. Each shot recovers {$charge_heal*100}% Max HP for the Leader.
_zh: 流明与发光单元每射 {$charge_need} 发攒满一轮，接下来 {$charge_shots} 发变为直线短光柱（长 {$pillar_len}）：瞬间穿透一线上的全部敌人并照亮，伤害 ×{$pillar_mult}，每发为队长回复 {$charge_heal*100}% 最大生命
_note: 校对：“发光单元”应统一为“Luminescent Unit”；主语“shots”为复数，动词“pierces/leaves”应改为复数形式“pierce/leave
可能偏长：12 字母 / 中文 3 字

en: Medic Operator. Continuously recovers HP for the Leader, cleanses Corrosion and Nervous Impairment, and replenishes Light. Unlocks Lighthouse after Elite 2.
_zh: 医疗干员，持续为队长回复生命、驱散侵蚀与神经损伤并补充灯火；精英二后解锁灯塔

en: Whatever his title, he simply does all he can to support and aid his companions.
_zh: 无论是什么身份，他始终只是竭尽自己所能，为同伴提供支持和援助
_note: 候选2：No matter who he is meant to be, he always does his utmost to support his companions.

_zh: 沛霖：照亮范围永久扩大
_note: 校对：“沛霖”是流明二技能的中文名，英文官方译名为 Grace，原翻译误将其字面意思 Downpour 也加了进去。

en: When the Leader is stationary, 'Fluorescence' recovery amount increases by 50%, and each recovery or cleanse grants an additional +3 Light; reverts when the Leader moves.
_zh: 队长站定不动时，「荧光」的回复量提高 50%，每次回复或驱散灯火另 +3；队长移动就恢复

en: Slashes enemies ahead in a fan-shaped area with his umbrella (Physical, {$half_base*2}°), and uses tentacles to pursue the enemy with the lowest HP among them (Arts).
_zh: 持伞扇形挥砍前方的敌人（物理，{$half_base*2}°），并用触手追击其中生命最低的敌人（法术）

en: When charged, the next Umbrella Strike is enhanced: damage ×{$s1_mult}, range ×{$s1_radius}. Triggers an area shockwave upon hit (Arts); tentacle pursuit is also enhanced.
_zh: 充能后下一次伞击强化：伤害 ×{$s1_mult}、范围 ×{$s1_radius}，命中处引发范围冲击（法术），触手追击同样强化
_note: 校对：冒号后 damage 不应大写（除非作为独立句子开头）。

en: High-speed state for {$s2_dur}s: Umbrella Strike interval ×{$s2_interval}, tentacle pursuit targets +1 and inflicts Bind for {$s2_bind}s.
_zh: {$s2_dur} 秒高速状态：挥伞间隔 ×{$s2_interval}，触手追击目标 +1 并附带 {$s2_bind} 秒束缚
_note: 校对：修正标点符号以符合原文结构。

en: For {$s3_dur}s, attacks cover the entire area around himself, range ×{$s3_radius}, damage ×{$s3_mult}; tentacles attack +2 additional targets, prioritize the enemy with the lowest HP, and inflict Stun for {$s3_stun}s.
_zh: {$s3_dur} 秒内攻击覆盖自身周围全范围，范围 ×{$s3_radius}、伤害 ×{$s3_mult}；触手额外攻击目标 +2，优先命中生命最低的敌人，并眩晕 {$s3_stun} 秒
_note: 校对：修正标点符号以符合原文结构。

en: When there are enemies with less than half HP nearby, own damage +{$talent_mult*100-100}%. Defeating a normal enemy recovers {$kill_heal*$k_kill*100}% Max HP for the Leader (Elite / Boss {$kill_heal*100}%; capped per second).
_zh: 附近有半血敌人时自身伤害 +{$talent_mult*100-100}%；每击杀一名普通敌人为队长回复 {$kill_heal*$k_kill*100}% 最大生命（精英 / Boss {$kill_heal*100}%；每秒有上限）

en: Tentacles entangle upon second hit: inflicts Bind for {$rep_bind}s and deals additional damage.
_zh: 触手二次命中即缠绕：束缚 {$rep_bind} 秒并追加伤害

en: When tentacles pursue the same enemy and hit a second time within {$rep_window}s, they entangle the target: inflicts Bind for {$rep_bind}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted) and deals another instance of {$rep_mult*100}% tentacle damage.
_zh: 触手追击同一名敌人，{$rep_window} 秒内第二次命中时，触手缠绕它：束缚 {$rep_bind} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），并再受一次 {$rep_mult*100}% 触手伤害

en: When an Umbrella Strike hits {$hyst_hits} or more enemies, tentacle pursuit changes to an all-target pursuit: each struck enemy with less than {$hyst_below*100}% HP is hit by one tentacle (up to {$hyst_max} tentacles).
_zh: 挥伞一次命中 {$hyst_hits} 名以上敌人时，触手追击改为全体追击：每名生命低于 {$hyst_below*100}% 的被伞击敌人各挨一根（至多 {$hyst_max} 根）

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Prisoner's Dilemma'. Unlocks Talent 'Countertransference': When there are enemies with less than half HP nearby, own damage +{$talent_mult*100-100}%. Defeating a normal enemy recovers {$kill_heal*$k_kill*100}% Max HP for the Leader (Elite / Boss {$kill_heal*100}%; capped per second). Normal attack 'Drag': Tentacle pursuit drags the target toward Mizuki by {$drag_dist} upon hit (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).
_zh: 解锁二技能「囚徒困境」；解锁天赋「反移情」：附近有半血敌人时自身伤害 +{$talent_mult*100-100}%；每击杀一名普通敌人为队长回复 {$kill_heal*$k_kill*100}% 最大生命（精英 / Boss {$kill_heal*100}%；每秒有上限）；普攻「拖拽」：触手追击命中后把目标拖向水月 {$drag_dist}（精英减半，Boss 除外）

en: Tentacle pursuit drags the target toward Mizuki by {$drag_dist} upon hit (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).
_zh: 触手追击命中后，把目标拖向水月 {$drag_dist}（精英减半，Boss 除外）

en: The attack enhanced by 'Awaken' spawns 2 additional tentacles around himself to strike nearby enemies.
_zh: 「唤醒」强化的那一击，身边再钻出 2 根触手抽打附近的敌人

en: The attack enhanced by 'Awaken' spawns 2 additional tentacles around himself to strike nearby enemies.
_zh: 「唤醒」强化的那一击，身边再钻出 2 根触手抽打附近的敌人

en: Enemies dragged to Mizuki by tentacles (Elite 1 'Drag') are entangled for {$cling_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); if Mizuki moves while they are entangled, they move with him.
_zh: 被触手拖到水月身边的敌人（精英一「拖拽」）被缠住 {$cling_dur} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）；缠住期间水月移动，它们跟着移动

en: 'Startle Reflex' causes the enhanced attack of 'Awaken' to deal an additional tentacle attack; 'Pathological Attachment' causes enemies dragged to him by tentacles to be entangled.
_zh: 「惊跳反射」使「唤醒」的强化攻击追加触手攻击；「病理性依恋」使被触手拖到身边的敌人被缠住

en: Enemies dragged to Mizuki by tentacles (Elite 1 'Drag') are entangled for {$cling_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); if Mizuki moves while they are entangled, they move with him.
_zh: 被触手拖到水月身边的敌人（精英一「拖拽」）被缠住 {$cling_dur} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）；缠住期间水月移动，它们跟着移动

en: {$awk2_delay}s after 'Awaken', surrounding tentacles strike again in a circle (radius {$s1_burst_r*$awk2_r_k:0}, {$awk2_mult*100}% Umbrella Strike damage, knockback).
_zh: 「唤醒」{$awk2_delay} 秒后，身边触手再抽打一圈（半径 {$s1_burst_r*$awk2_r_k:0}，伞击 {$awk2_mult*100}% 伤害，击退）
_note: 校对：Umbrella Strike 作为特定攻击名称应大写。

en: Entangled enemies take ×{$smash_mult} damage from the next Umbrella Strike within {$smash_window}s (consumed only once); tentacles emerge from beneath them.
_zh: 被缠住的敌人，{$smash_window} 秒内受到的下一次伞击伤害 ×{$smash_mult}（只消耗一次），触手从其脚下钻出
_note: 校对：Umbrella Strike 作为特定攻击名称应大写。

en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Moon in the Water': For {$s3_dur}s, attacks cover the entire surrounding area, attack range ×{$s3_radius}, damage ×{$s3_mult}; tentacles attack +2 additional targets, prioritize enemies with the lowest HP, and Stun them for {$s3_stun}s. Normal attacks are enhanced with 'Seed of the Deep': Small jellyfish behind him (amount equal to tentacle pursuit count) each fly toward a nearby enemy every {$jelly_every}s, dealing {$jelly_mult*100}% Umbrella Strike Arts damage and inflicting Bind on them for {$jelly_bind}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); interval halved during 'Moon in the Water'.
_zh: 解锁三技能「镜花水月」：{$s3_dur} 秒内攻击覆盖自身周围全范围，范围 ×{$s3_radius}、伤害 ×{$s3_mult}；触手额外攻击目标 +2，优先命中生命最低的敌人，并眩晕 {$s3_stun} 秒；普通攻击强化「深蓝之籽」：身后的小水母（数量同触手追击数）每 {$jelly_every} 秒各自飞向附近一名敌人，造成伞击 {$jelly_mult*100}% 的法术伤害并束缚 {$jelly_bind} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）；「镜花水月」期间间隔减半
_note: 校对：Umbrella Strike 应大写；Binding them 改为 inflicting Bind on them 更符合明日方舟状态术语的表达习惯。
