en:
'Texas, employee of Penguin Logistics, will give the squad a tactical advantage with her Originium Arts at the start of every battle.'
Penguin Logistics employee with outstanding individual combat capabilities. During her contract period, she served as the Penguin Logistics liaison to Rhodes Island, assisting in multiple Rhodes Island operations. Multiple documents pointed her identity to the fallen Texas family; Rhodes Island's intelligence network also knew very little about this family.
_zh:
「企鹅物流职员德克萨斯，将使用源石剑为小队取得开局的优势。」
企鹅物流员工，单兵作战能力出众。合约期内担任企鹅物流驻罗德岛联络人员，协助罗德岛的多项行动。多份资料把她的身份指向已经覆灭的德克萨斯家族；关于这个家族，罗德岛的情报网也所知甚少。

en:
'Exusiai, employee of Penguin Logistics, will clear out everything in the way using her guns.'
Citizen of Laterano. Member of Penguin Logistics. Engages in covert communication, armed escort, and other undisclosed activities. Suspected to be a Messenger. Serves as the Penguin Logistics liaison to Rhodes Island during the contract period, assisting in various Rhodes Island operations.
_zh:
「企鹅物流职员能天使，将用铳枪为小队扫平前路。」
拉特兰公民。企鹅物流公司成员，从事秘密联络、武装押运等非公开活动，推测身份为信使。合约期内担任企鹅物流驻罗德岛联络人员，协助罗德岛的多项行动。

en: The Doctor of Rhodes Island. Rescued by a Rhodes Island squad from a classified location in Chernobog. Lost past memories and cannot recall important events. Shortly after the rescue, Reunion attacked Chernobog. The Doctor took over the mobilization and Command of Rhodes Island combat squads during the battle in the city.
_zh: 罗德岛的博士。在切尔诺伯格的一处机密地点被罗德岛的小队救出，失去了过去的记忆，重要的事情都回忆不起来。获救后不久，整合运动袭击切尔诺伯格，博士在城中的战斗里接手调集、指挥罗德岛的作战小队。

keys: 每 {$cd} 秒向最近的敌人（精英优先）射出 {$shots} 发物理弹（射程 {$range}，命中第一名敌人即消失，轻微击退）；每次射击的子弹数可以成长，多发时各自瞄准不同的敌人，最近的是 Boss 时全部打 Boss
en: Fires {$shots} Physical projectiles at the nearest enemy (prioritizes Elites) every {$cd}s (range {$range}, disappears upon hitting the first enemy, slight knockback); the number of projectiles per attack can grow, multiple projectiles aim at different enemies, if the nearest is a Boss, all hit the Boss

keys: 装填 {$s1_ammo} 发强力弹：之后的子弹每发伤害 ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2}、穿透 {$s1_pierce} 名敌人，打完为止（每次射击按子弹数消耗强力弹）
en: Loads {$s1_ammo} enhanced rounds: Subsequent projectiles deal damage ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2} and pierce {$s1_pierce} enemies until depleted (consumes enhanced rounds based on the number of projectiles per attack)

keys: {$s2_dur} 秒：射击间隔 {$cd} → {$s2_cd} 秒，每发伤害 ×{$s2_mult}；结束时枪管过热，{$s2_overheat} 秒不能射击
en: {$s2_dur}s: Attack interval {$cd} -> {$s2_cd}s, projectile damage ×{$s2_mult}; upon ending, the barrel overheats, unable to attack for {$s2_overheat}s

keys: {$s3_dur} 秒：每次射击改为 {$s3_burst} 连射（每发伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}），射程 +{$s3_range*100}%，优先瞄准精英与 Boss；连射与子弹数相乘；每轮最后一发让非精英停顿 {$s3_pause} 秒
en: {$s3_dur}s: Each attack becomes a {$s3_burst}-hit burst (projectile damage ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}), range +{$s3_range*100}%, prioritizes Elites and Bosses; burst hits multiply with the number of projectiles; the last projectile of each burst Halts non-Elites for {$s3_pause}s

keys: 弹匣：她每击杀 1 名敌人弹匣 +1（上限 {$mag_cap}，精英二起 {$e2_mag_cap}），敌人倒在队长照亮范围内时 +{$mag_lit_bonus}；弹匣满时下一次射击改为一次倾泻：{$mag_shots} 发扇形散射（每发伤害 ×{$mag_mult}，穿透 {$mag_pierce} 名敌人），然后清空
en: Cartridge: Cartridge +1 for every 1 enemy she defeats (Limit {$mag_cap}, {$e2_mag_cap} from Elite 2), +{$mag_lit_bonus} if the enemy falls within the Leader's Light Radius; when Cartridge is full, the next attack unloads {$mag_shots} shots in a frontal cone (Damage ×{$mag_mult} per shot, pierces {$mag_pierce} enemies), then empties Cartridge

keys: 每 {$prefer_stun_every} 发子弹中有 1 发眩晕弹，使目标眩晕 {$prefer_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）；子弹优先瞄准受控目标（眩晕、浮空、失重中的敌人）；打中受控目标时命中即停，并使其定身 {$prefer_pin} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外；同一敌人 1 秒内至多一次）；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_twin}
en: 1 in every {$prefer_stun_every} bullets is a Stun bullet, Stunning the target for {$prefer_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); bullets prioritize crowd-controlled targets (enemies that are Stunned, Levitated, or Weightless); when hitting a crowd-controlled target, the bullet stops upon impact and immobilizes them for {$prefer_pin}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted; at most once per second per enemy); damage ×{$grow_dmg_twin}.

keys: 队长身边半径 {$escort_r} 内有 {$escort_n} 名及以上敌人时，子弹改为优先射击离队长最近的敌人，并附带 {$escort_kb} 击退；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_power}
en: When {$escort_n} or more enemies are within a radius of {$escort_r} around the Leader, bullets prioritize the enemy closest to the Leader, and deal {$escort_kb} knockback; Damage ×{$grow_dmg_power}

keys: 解锁二技能「扫射模式」；解锁天赋「快速弹匣」：击杀攒满弹匣后倾泻 {$mag_shots} 发；普攻「穿甲连射」：连续命中同一名敌人时每发伤害 +{$e1_per*100}%（最多 +{$e1_per*$e1_max*100}%），{$e1_decay} 秒未命中该敌人则清零
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Shooting Mode'; unlocks Talent 'Fast Cartridge': Unloads {$mag_shots} shots after filling Cartridge via defeats; Normal attack 'Armor-Piercing Burst': When consecutively hitting the same enemy, Damage +{$e1_per*100}% per shot (up to +{$e1_per*$e1_max*100}%), resets if the enemy is not hit for {$e1_decay}s

keys: 速射连续命中同一名敌人时每发伤害 +{$e1_per*100}%（最多 +{$e1_per*$e1_max*100}%），子弹由白转金，叠满时命中迸出金色火花；{$e1_decay} 秒未命中该敌人则清零
en: When rapid shots consecutively hit the same enemy, Damage +{$e1_per*100}% per shot (up to +{$e1_per*$e1_max*100}%), bullets turn from white to gold, emitting golden sparks upon hit at max stacks; resets if the enemy is not hit for {$e1_decay}s

keys: 每第 {$tracer_every} 发为曳光弹：命中的敌人被标记 {$tracer_secs} 秒，其他干员对标记目标造成的伤害 +{$tracer_bonus*100}%
en: Every {$tracer_every} shot is a Tracer Round: Hitting an enemy marks them for {$tracer_secs}s, other Operators deal +{$tracer_bonus*100}% damage to the marked target

keys: 子弹命中后有 {$ricochet_chance*100}% 概率跳向 {$ricochet_r} 内另一名敌人（伤害 {$ricochet_mult*100}%）
en: Bullets have a {$ricochet_chance*100}% chance to ricochet to another enemy within {$ricochet_r} upon hit (Damage {$ricochet_mult*100}%)

keys: 「曳光弹」标记目标，全队对其增伤；「跳弹」使子弹命中后有概率弹向另一名敌人
en: 'Tracer Rounds' marks targets, the squad deals increased damage to them; 'Ricochet' gives bullets a chance to bounce to another enemy upon hit

keys: 被曳光弹标记的敌人倒下时（无论谁击杀），弹匣额外 +{$reap_mag}；标记同时最多 {$reap_max} 个
en: When an enemy marked by Tracer Rounds falls (regardless of who defeated them), Cartridge +{$reap_mag} additionally; up to {$reap_max} marks can exist simultaneously

keys: 她击杀的敌人处迸出弹片，半径 {$frag_r} 内的敌人受到 {$frag_mult*100}% 伤害
en: Enemies she defeats emit shrapnel, dealing {$frag_mult*100}% damage to enemies within a radius of {$frag_r}

keys: 解锁三技能「过载模式」；普通攻击强化「天使的祝福」：编队中另外两名干员头顶浮现光环，攻击速度 +{$e2_aspd*100}%；弹匣上限 {$mag_cap} → {$e2_mag_cap}
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Overloading Mode'; Normal attack upgrade 'Angel's Blessings': Halos appear above 2 other Operators in the squad, ATK speed +{$e2_aspd*100}%; Cartridge limit {$mag_cap} → {$e2_mag_cap}

keys: 编队中另外两名干员头顶浮现金色光环：攻击速度 +{$e2_aspd*100}%，每次攻击带一道金色闪光；她开火时光环随之一亮。弹匣上限 {$mag_cap} → {$e2_mag_cap}
en: Golden halos appear above 2 other Operators in the squad: ATK speed +{$e2_aspd*100}%, each attack carries a golden flash; the halos light up when she fires. Cartridge limit {$mag_cap} → {$e2_mag_cap}

keys: 狙击干员，双枪连射，每秒三发；弹匣随击杀增长，攒满后倾泻一轮扇形射击
en: Sniper Operator, dual-wielding rapid fire, three shots per second; Cartridge fills upon defeats, unloads a frontal cone barrage when full

keys: 企鹅物流职员能天使，将用铳枪为小队扫平前路
en: Exusiai, employee of Penguin Logistics, will clear out everything in the way using her guns.

keys: 队长每次冲刺起步，她朝队长身后最近的敌人补射一轮（发数同普攻，每发 80% 伤害），掩护队长撤出；补射击倒的敌人照常填充弹匣
en: Whenever the Leader starts a dash, she fires a volley at the nearest enemy behind the Leader (same number of shots as normal attacks, each dealing 80% damage) to cover the Leader's retreat; enemies defeated by this volley fill the Cartridge as usual

keys: 每 {$cd} 秒向射程 {$range} 内最近的敌人投出熔岩弹，落点半径 {$aoe} 爆炸（法术），并小幅击退爆点周围的敌人（精英减弱，Boss 除外）
en: Throws a Magma Orb at the nearest enemy within {$range} range every {$cd}s, exploding in a {$aoe} radius upon landing (Arts) and slightly knocking back enemies around the explosion (reduced on Elites, Bosses excepted)

keys: 接下来 3 发熔岩弹爆炸范围 ×{$s1_aoe}，并点燃命中的敌人：每秒受到这一发 {$burn_dps*100}% 的法术伤害，持续 {$burn_dur} 秒（精英一及以上 {$burn_dur_e1} 秒）
en: The next 3 Magma Orbs have explosion radius ×{$s1_aoe} and ignite targets hit: take {$burn_dps*100}% of this attack's Arts damage per second for {$burn_dur}s ({$burn_dur_e1}s at Elite 1 or above)

keys: 向最近的敌人投出一发 ×{$s2_mult*$k_pow:2} 的熔岩弹（爆炸范围 ×{$s2_aoe}）：点燃命中的敌人（同「二重咏唱」），并让它们 {$s2_weak} 秒内受到的伤害 +10%
en: Throws a Magma Orb dealing ×{$s2_mult*$k_pow:2} damage at the nearest enemy (explosion radius ×{$s2_aoe}): ignites targets hit (same as 'Duetto'), and damage taken by them +10% for {$s2_weak}s

keys: 浮空向敌群投射 {$s3_count} 轮火焰弹（伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}），每处留下 {$lava_dur} 秒熔岩（每 {$lava_every} 秒 {$lava_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 法术伤害）
en: Levitates and throws {$s3_count} volleys of flaming orbs at enemies (damage ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}), leaving magma for {$lava_dur}s at each location ({$lava_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% Arts damage every {$lava_every}s)

keys: 熔岩弹爆炸范围 +{$talent_aoe*100-100}%；「二重咏唱」「点燃」的点燃持续时间 {$burn_dur} → {$burn_dur_e1} 秒
en: Magma Orb explosion radius +{$talent_aoe*100-100}%; ignite duration of 'Duetto' and 'Ignition' {$burn_dur}s → {$burn_dur_e1}s

keys: 普攻投出 2 发熔岩弹，第二发伤害 {$twin_mult*100}%：精英化前打同一名敌人，精英一起打另一名敌人（没有则在旁边偏开）；精英二起由「三重咏唱」取代
en: Normal attacks throw 2 Magma Orbs, the second dealing {$twin_mult*100}% damage: before Promotion, attacks the same enemy; from Elite 1, attacks a different enemy (if none, veers off to the side); from Elite 2, replaced by 'Tercet'.

keys: 熔岩弹爆炸时迸出 {$ember_n} 块熔岩，砸到附近的敌人身上小范围爆炸（这一发 {$ember_mult*100}% 的伤害）
en: When a Magma Orb explodes, it scatters {$ember_n} pieces of magma that hit nearby enemies and explode in a small area ({$ember_mult*100}% damage of this attack)

keys: 解锁二技能「点燃」；解锁天赋「炎息」：熔岩弹爆炸范围 +{$talent_aoe*100-100}%，点燃持续时间 +{$burn_dur_e1-$burn_dur} 秒；普攻「熔蚀」：熔岩弹命中的敌人 {$melt_dur} 秒内受到的法术伤害 +{$melt_v*100}%
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Ignition'; unlocks Talent 'Pyrobreath': Magma Orb explosion radius +{$talent_aoe*100-100}%, ignite duration +{$burn_dur_e1-$burn_dur}s; normal attack 'Melt': enemies hit by Magma Orbs take +{$melt_v*100}% Arts damage for {$melt_dur}s

keys: 熔岩弹命中的敌人 {$melt_dur} 秒内受到的法术伤害 +{$melt_v*100}%（不叠层，再命中刷新时间；Boss 同样生效），脚下留一圈暗红裂纹
en: Enemies hit by Magma Orbs take +{$melt_v*100}% Arts damage for {$melt_dur}s (does not stack, hitting again refreshes duration; also applies to Bosses), leaving a ring of dark red cracks beneath them

keys: 「点燃」的熔岩弹爆炸后向四周抛出 {$blob_n} 团熔岩，落地各自爆炸（普攻熔岩弹的 {$blob_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 伤害）
en: Magma Orbs from 'Ignition' scatter {$blob_n} magma blobs around after exploding, which explode upon landing ({$blob_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% damage of a normal attack Magma Orb)

keys: 「二重咏唱」强化的熔岩弹炸开时，向附近 {$meteor_n} 名随机敌人高抛一颗熔岩弹（这发伤害的 {$meteor_mult*100}%）；精英二后「火山」每轮投弹同样追加
en: When Magma Orbs enhanced by 'Duetto' explode, throws a Magma Orb high at {$meteor_n} random nearby enemies ({$meteor_mult*100}% damage of this attack); after Elite 2, each volley of 'Volcano' also adds this effect

keys: 「星火燎原」使「点燃」的熔岩弹爆炸后向周围抛出熔岩；「熔岩天降」为「二重咏唱」及精英二后的「火山」追加熔岩弹
en: 'Spreading Sparks' causes Magma Orbs from 'Ignition' to scatter magma around after exploding; 'Falling Magma' adds Magma Orbs to 'Duetto' and 'Volcano' after Elite 2

keys: 「点燃」的熔岩弹爆炸时，再向爆炸范围外最近的 {$blob2_n} 名敌人各抛一团熔岩（{$blob2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 伤害）
en: When Magma Orbs from 'Ignition' explode, throws an additional magma blob at the {$blob2_n} nearest enemies outside the explosion radius ({$blob2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% damage)

keys: 「熔岩天降」的熔岩块优先砸向已点燃的敌人；砸中时立刻结算其剩余灼烧伤害的 {$ign_k*100}%，并把点燃扩散给半径 {$ign_r} 内至多 {$ign_n} 名敌人
en: Magma pieces from 'Falling Magma' prioritize ignited enemies; upon hitting, immediately deals {$ign_k*100}% of their remaining burn damage, and spreads the ignite to up to {$ign_n} enemies within a {$ign_r} radius

keys: 解锁三技能「火山」：浮空向敌群投射 {$s3_count} 轮火焰弹（伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}），每处留下 {$lava_dur} 秒熔岩；普通攻击强化「三重咏唱」（取代「复咏」）：熔岩弹改为低弧抛射，每次 3 发在目标周围呈三角落下（后 2 发伤害 ×{$tri_mult}），落地后中心留下熔池 {$pool_dur} 秒，每 {$pool_every} 秒造成第一发 {$pool_mult*100}% 的法术伤害
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Volcano': Levitates and throws {$s3_count} volleys of flaming orbs at enemies (damage ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}), leaving magma for {$lava_dur}s at each location; normal attack enhanced to 'Tercet' (replaces 'Echo'): Magma Orbs are thrown in a low arc, dropping 3 orbs in a triangle around the target each time (last 2 orbs deal ×{$tri_mult} damage), leaving a magma pool in the center for {$pool_dur}s upon landing, dealing {$pool_mult*100}% Arts damage of the first orb every {$pool_every}s

keys: 熔岩弹改为低弧抛射：每次 3 发在目标周围呈三角落下（后 2 发伤害 ×{$tri_mult}），各自爆炸；3 发都落地后，三角中心留下熔池 {$pool_dur} 秒，每 {$pool_every} 秒对池内敌人造成第一发 {$pool_mult*100}% 的法术伤害
en: Magma Orbs are thrown in a low arc: drops 3 orbs in a triangle around the target each time (last 2 orbs deal ×{$tri_mult} damage), each exploding; after all 3 orbs land, leaves a magma pool in the center of the triangle for {$pool_dur}s, dealing {$pool_mult*100}% Arts damage of the first orb to enemies in the pool every {$pool_every}s

keys: 术师干员，普攻熔岩弹清理敌群，技能喷发火山并留下灼烧熔池
en: Caster Operator. Normal attacks throw Magma Orbs to clear enemy groups, skills erupt volcanoes and leave burning magma pools.

keys: 火山学家，天灾信使。在战场上，她的法术是最可靠的决战力量
en: Volcanologist and Catastrophe Messenger. On the battlefield, her Arts are the force you can count on to win.

keys: 队长站定不动时，她的熔岩弹爆炸范围逐渐扩大：站定满 0.6、1.6、2.6 秒各 +15%；队长移动就恢复
en: When Leader is stationary, her Lava Ball explosion range gradually expands: +15% each at 0.6s, 1.6s, and 2.6s stationary; resets when Leader moves

keys: 每 {$cd} 秒把钩索掷向 {$range} 内离她最远的敌人（{$hook_min} 以内的不选）：落地半径 {$hook_r} 内造成物理伤害，随后把钩索与她之间一线的敌人（至多 {$hook_n} 名，Boss 除外）拖到身前 {$hook_front} 处（她当队长时拖到 {$hook_front_leader} 处，精英与自爆怪只拖半程），到位再受 {$hook_back*100}% 伤害并眩晕 {$arrive_stun} 秒（精英减半）
en: Every {$cd}s, throws a Grappling Hook at the furthest enemy within {$range} (ignores enemies within {$hook_min}): deals Physical damage within a radius of {$hook_r} upon landing, then drags enemies in a line between the Grappling Hook and herself (up to {$hook_n}, Bosses excepted) to {$hook_front} in front of her (to {$hook_front_leader} when she is Leader; distance halved for Elites and exploding enemies). Upon arrival, they take {$hook_back*100}% damage and are Stunned for {$arrive_stun}s (halved on Elites)
Waterless Parting of the Great Ocean

keys: 立刻掷出重钩：{$s1_range} 内最远的敌人处半径 {$s1_r} 内 ×{$s1_mult} 伤害，把一线上至多 {$s1_n} 名敌人拖到身前 {$hook_front} 处（她当队长时 {$hook_front_leader} 处，精英与自爆怪只拖半程），到位再受 ×{$s1_back} 伤害并眩晕 {$arrive_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Immediately throws a heavy hook: deals ×{$s1_mult} damage within a radius of {$s1_r} at the furthest enemy within {$s1_range}, and drags up to {$s1_n} enemies in a line to {$hook_front} in front of her (to {$hook_front_leader} when she is Leader; distance halved for Elites and exploding enemies). Upon arrival, they take ×{$s1_back} damage and are Stunned for {$arrive_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
Waterless Grasp of the Raging Seas

keys: {$s2_dur} 秒内伤害 ×{$s2_dmg}、攻击间隔 ×{$s2_interval}、钩索射程 +{$s2_range*100}%；每次掷钩同时把身边 {$s2_pull_r} 内的敌人拉近 {$s2_pull}（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: For {$s2_dur}s, damage ×{$s2_dmg}, attack interval ×{$s2_interval}, Grappling Hook range +{$s2_range*100}%; each hook throw also pulls enemies within {$s2_pull_r} around her closer by {$s2_pull} (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)
Waterless Dance of the Shattered Maelstrom

keys: 在最近一次钩中的敌人处生成半径 {$s3_r} 的漩涡，持续 {$s3_dur} 秒：每 {$s3_every} 秒对涡内敌人造成 {$s3_mult*100}% 法术伤害、减速 {$s3_slow} 秒并拉向中心 {$s3_pull}；结束时把半径 {$s3_end_r} 内的敌人拽向中心 {$s3_end_pull} 并眩晕 {$s3_end_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Generates a radius {$s3_r} whirlpool at the last hooked enemy, lasting {$s3_dur}s: every {$s3_every}s, deals {$s3_mult*100}% Arts damage to enemies inside, Slows them for {$s3_slow}s, and pulls them towards the center by {$s3_pull}; when it ends, pulls enemies within a radius of {$s3_end_r} towards the center by {$s3_end_pull} and Stuns them for {$s3_end_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)

keys: 队长每秒回复 {$heal_pct*100} % 最大生命（入队即生效）；晋升至精英一后，编队里每名其他深海猎人（斯卡蒂、浊心斯卡蒂、乌尔比安、归溟幽灵鲨），队长每秒再回复 {$mate_heal*100} % 最大生命、受到的伤害 -{$mate_dr*100}%（最多 {$mate_cap} 人）
en: Leader recovers {$heal_pct*100}% Max HP per second (effective upon joining the squad); after promotion to Elite 1, for each other Abyssal Hunter in the squad (Skadi, Skadi the Corrupting Heart, Ulpianus, Specter the Unchained), Leader recovers an additional {$mate_heal*100}% Max HP per second and takes -{$mate_dr*100}% damage (up to {$mate_cap} operators)

keys: 被钩索拖拽的敌人，每被拖过 {$barb_per} 距离，受到攻击力 {$barb_pct*100}% 的法术伤害（至多 {$barb_max} 层），拖拽路径上迸出火星
en: Enemies dragged by the Grappling Hook take Arts damage equal to {$barb_pct*100}% of ATK for every {$barb_per} distance dragged (up to {$barb_max} stacks), emitting sparks along the drag path

keys: 钩索把敌人拖到身前的同一刻，她向前挥出一记横扫：前方 {$slash_half*2}° 扇形，半径 {$slash_r}，{$slash_mult*100}% 伤害，击退 {$slash_kb}

en: Against cultists and Seaborn, the rapier in her hand spares no one.

en: When switching to regroup, she kicks up a gust of wind around herself, Levitating nearby enemies for 0.8s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted) to cover the squad's retreat

en: Heals once every {$heal_cd}s: Heals the Leader when they are in danger, otherwise heals the one with a lower HP percentage (the Leader recovers {$heal_pct*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP); the Follow Mon3tr automatically bites enemies around the Leader (Physical), causing about {$m3_aggro_share*100}% of melee enemies within a radius of {$m3_aggro_r} to pursue it instead. It collapses when HP reaches 0, and revives next to the Leader after {$m3_revive_secs}s

keys: 立即为队长回复 {$s1_heal*$k_atk*$k_pow*100:2}% 最大生命并清除神经损伤
en: Immediately restores {$s1_heal*$k_atk*$k_pow*100:2}% Max HP to the Leader and clears Nervous Impairment

en: Permanently takes effect after 1 charge: Mon3tr ATK speed +{$s2_aspd*100-100}%, claw strike range +{$s2_reach*100-100}%, Kal'tsit's healing frequency +{$s2_heal*100-100}%

keys: Mon3tr {$s3_dur} 秒内爪击改为真实伤害且伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}；结束时熔毁：周围 {$melt_r} 内造成 {$melt_mult*$k_pow:2} 倍真实伤害（未选「不毁重构」时另眩晕 {$melt_stun_lo} 秒并击退）
en: Mon3tr's claw strikes deal True damage and damage ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2} for {$s3_dur}s; Meltdown upon ending: Deals {$melt_mult*$k_pow:2} times True damage within a radius of {$melt_r} (if 'Non-Damaging Restructuring' is not selected, additionally Stuns for {$melt_stun_lo}s and causes knockback)
Healing +{$e1_heal*100-100}% (Elite 2 +{$e2_heal*100-100}%); Mon3tr damage +{$e1_dmg*100-100}%, claw strike range +{$e1_reach*100-100}%

keys: Mon3tr 每次爪击挥出两爪：{$claw2_delay} 秒后第二爪交叉划过（{$claw2_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: Mon3tr strikes twice with every claw strike: A second claw slashes across after {$claw2_delay}s (deals {$claw2_mult*100}% damage)

keys: Mon3tr 的爪击在同一名敌人身上累积 {$clear_n} 次后，该敌人身上爆开一圈（半径 {$clear_r}，Mon3tr 攻击 {$clear_mult*100}% 的真实伤害）并清空累积；{$clear_win} 秒内没有再被爪击则清空
en: After Mon3tr's claw attacks hit the same enemy {$clear_n} times, an explosion occurs on that enemy (radius {$clear_r}, deals True damage equal to {$clear_mult*100}% of Mon3tr's ATK) and clears the hit count; the count is cleared if the enemy is not hit by a claw attack again within {$clear_win}s.

keys: 解锁二技能「指令：战术协同」；解锁天赋「指挥」：治疗量 +{$e1_heal*100-100}%；Mon3tr 伤害 +{$e1_dmg*100-100}%，爪击范围 +{$e1_reach*100-100}%；普攻「扑击」：Mon3tr 的目标在爪击范围外（且远于 {$lunge_min}）时先扑过去，落地造成 {$lunge_mult*100}% 伤害（每 {$lunge_cd} 秒至多一次）
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Command: Tactical Coordination'; unlocks Talent 'Command': Healing +{$e1_heal*100-100}%; Mon3tr damage +{$e1_dmg*100-100}%, claw strike range +{$e1_reach*100-100}%; Normal attack 'Pounce': When Mon3tr's target is outside its claw strike range (and further than {$lunge_min}), it pounces first, dealing {$lunge_mult*100}% damage upon landing (at most once every {$lunge_cd}s).

keys: Mon3tr 盯上的目标在爪击范围外（且远于 {$lunge_min}）时先扑过去，落地对半径 {$lunge_r} 内的敌人造成 {$lunge_mult*100}% 伤害，再出爪（每 {$lunge_cd} 秒至多一次）
en: When Mon3tr's target is outside its claw strike range (and further than {$lunge_min}), it pounces first, dealing {$lunge_mult*100}% damage to enemies within a radius of {$lunge_r} upon landing, then attacks with its claws (at most once every {$lunge_cd}s).

keys: 「指令：结构加固」同时使队长受到的伤害 -{$shell_red*100}%，持续 {$shell_dur} 秒

en: When 'Command: Structural Fortification' is used, Mon3tr restructures its outer shell on the spot: explodes 3 times consecutively (radius expands each time, deals True damage equal to {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% / {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*50:1}% / {$rebuild_mult*$k_pow*50:1}% of Mon3tr's ATK) and Stuns for {$rebuild_stun}s; after Elite 2, when 'Command: Meltdown' ends, it also explodes 3 times consecutively (interval of {$melt_echo_gap}s, the last 2 times deal {$melt_echo_mult*100}% damage) and Stuns for {$melt_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses immune).

keys: 「结构加固」使一技能同时保护队长；「不毁重构」使 Mon3tr 在一技能释放时及精英二后三技能结束时连续爆炸三次
en: 'Structural Fortification' makes Skill 1 also protect the Leader; 'Non-Damaging Restructuring' makes Mon3tr explode 3 times consecutively when Skill 1 is used and when Skill 3 ends after Elite 2.

keys: 「指令：结构加固」施放时，队长回复 {$shell2_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命并清除神经损伤
en: When 'Command: Structural Fortification' is used, restores {$shell2_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP to the Leader and clears Nervous Impairment.

keys: 「指令：结构加固」施放时 Mon3tr 重构后的三连爆之后，爆心留下 {$melt4_dur} 秒熔渣：每 {$melt4_every} 秒对半径 {$rebuild_r*1.5:0} 内的敌人造成 Mon3tr 攻击 {$melt4_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 真实伤害；精英二后「指令：熔毁」三连爆之后同样留下熔渣（半径 {$melt_r}）
en: After the 3 consecutive explosions from Mon3tr's restructuring when 'Command: Structural Fortification' is used, leaves slag at the explosion center for {$melt4_dur}s: deals True damage equal to {$melt4_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% of Mon3tr's ATK to enemies within a radius of {$rebuild_r*1.5:0} every {$melt4_every}s; after Elite 2, the 3 consecutive explosions from 'Command: Meltdown' also leave slag (radius {$melt_r}).

keys: 天赋「指挥」治疗量提升至 +{$e2_heal*100-100}%；解锁三技能「指令：熔毁」：Mon3tr {$s3_dur} 秒内爪击改为真实伤害且伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}；结束时熔毁：周围 {$melt_r} 内造成 {$melt_mult*$k_pow:2} 倍真实伤害；普通攻击强化「八面展开」：Mon3tr 前后同时出爪（身后一爪 {$m_back_mult*100}%）；「回防」：队长受到攻击时，Mon3tr 跃回队长身边，对周围半径 {$leap_r} 内的敌人造成 ×{$leap_mult} 伤害并击退（每 {$guard_cd} 秒至多一次）；「不毁重构」：Mon3tr 倒下时就地爆炸，对周围半径 {$rebuild_r} 内的敌人造成 ×{$rebuild_mult} 倍真实伤害并眩晕 {$rebuild_stun} 秒
en: Talent 'Command' healing increased to +{$e2_heal*100-100}%; unlocks Skill 3 'Command: Meltdown': Mon3tr's claw attacks deal True damage and damage is multiplied by {$s3_mult*$k_pow:2} for {$s3_dur}s; upon ending, melts down: deals True damage equal to {$melt_mult*$k_pow:2} times ATK to enemies within a radius of {$melt_r}; Normal attack enhancement 'Omnidirectional Deployment': Mon3tr attacks with claws to the front and back simultaneously (the backward claw deals {$m_back_mult*100}% damage); 'Fall Back': When the Leader is attacked, Mon3tr leaps back to the Leader, dealing {$leap_mult} times damage to enemies within a radius of {$leap_r} and causing knockback (at most once every {$guard_cd}s); 'Non-Damaging Restructuring': When Mon3tr falls, it explodes on the spot, dealing True damage equal to {$rebuild_mult} times ATK to enemies within a radius of {$rebuild_r} and Stuns them for {$rebuild_stun}s.

keys: 队长受到攻击时，Mon3tr 跃回队长身边，落地对周围半径 {$leap_r} 内的敌人造成 ×{$leap_mult} 伤害并击退（每 {$guard_cd} 秒至多一次）；「八面展开」前后同时出爪照旧（身后一爪 {$m_back_mult*100}%）
en: When the Leader is attacked, Mon3tr leaps back to the Leader, dealing {$leap_mult} times damage to enemies within a radius of {$leap_r} upon landing and causing knockback (at most once every {$guard_cd}s); 'Omnidirectional Deployment' continues to attack with claws to the front and back simultaneously (the backward claw deals {$m_back_mult*100}% damage).

keys: 医疗干员，罗德岛医疗项目负责人，为队长与 Mon3tr 回复生命；随行的 Mon3tr 撕碎靠近的敌人并替队长引走一部分近战敌人，倒下后 {$m3_revive_secs} 秒复活
en: Medic Operator, head of the Rhodes Island medical project, restores HP to the Leader and Mon3tr; the Follow Mon3tr tears apart approaching enemies and draws away some melee enemies for the Leader, reviving {$m3_revive_secs}s after falling.

en: Every time the Leader uses a skill, Mon3tr leaps back to the Leader, pouncing on surrounding enemies upon landing and causing knockback (at most once every 3s).

en: Every {$cd}s, swings twin blades around the Leader (Physical, approx. 150° fan, radius {$reach}); Guard - Lord trait: When enemies are far away (outside swing reach), instead throws a sword aura at the nearest enemy within {$blade_aim} every {$far_every}s, dealing {$far_mult*100}% of ATK as damage, traveling {$blade_dist} and disappearing upon hitting the first enemy; Ranged attacks no longer deal reduced damage during 'Wolf Spirit'.

keys: 充能一次后永久生效：攻击 +{$s1_atk*100-100}%；队长受到的攻击有 {$s1_resist*100}% 概率被她格挡（完全抵消这一下）
en: Permanent effect after 1 charge: ATK +{$s1_atk*100-100}%; Attacks taken by the Leader have a {$s1_resist*100}% chance to be blocked by her (completely negating the hit).

Every hit inflicts 1 stack of 'Observation' on the enemy; when the same enemy reaches {$s3_mark_n} stacks within {$s3_keep}s, lockdown is complete: performs a cross slash dealing {$s3_cut_mult*100}% of ATK as damage, seals them for {$s3_seal}s (halved on Elites, {$s3_seal*$seal_boss:2}s on Bosses), Stuns them for {$s3_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), and increases damage taken by 10% for {$s3_fragile}s.

en: Sword auras now track targets: prioritizes the enemy with the lowest HP percentage within {$blade_aim} (instead of the nearest), turning along an arc ({$far_turn} rad/s).

en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Wolf Spirit'; unlocks Talent 'Spiritual Destruction': Enemies hit by swings are sealed for {$seal_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses only have their moves delayed by {$seal_dur*$seal_boss:2}s); Normal attack 'Wolf Dance': Every {$dance_n}th swing becomes a spinning slash: deals ×{$dance_mult} damage within a radius of {$dance_r} around herself, inflicts knockback and seals for {$dance_seal}s.

keys: 每第 {$dance_n} 次横扫改为旋身斩：以自身为中心半径 {$dance_r} 内 ×{$dance_mult} 伤害，击退，命中的敌人封印 {$dance_seal} 秒
en: Every {$dance_n}th swing becomes a spinning slash: deals ×{$dance_mult} damage within a radius of {$dance_r} around herself, inflicts knockback, and seals hit enemies for {$dance_seal}s.

en: Every {$bark_n}th swing releases a shockwave: deals {$bark_mult*100}% of swing damage within a radius of {$bark_r}, inflicts knockback and seals for {$bark_seal}s.

en: After a successful 'Sundial' block, the next sword aura becomes a large sword aura: width ×{$dial_w_mult}, pierces all enemies; if the next swing has no sword aura, additionally throws one ({$dial_mult*100}% damage); Damage ×{$grow_dmg_rage}.

keys: 「断喝」每 {$bark_n} 次横扫触发封印冲击；「日晷·反斩」格挡成功后下一道剑气变为大剑气
en: 'Bark' triggers a sealing shockwave every {$bark_n}th swing; 'Sundial - Counter Slash' turns the next sword aura into a large sword aura after a successful block.

en: When an enemy sealed by her dies, the seal spreads along a radius of {$spread_r}: up to {$spread_n} surrounding enemies are sealed for {$spread_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), erupting a sealing ring at the location of death.

keys: 每次横扫都掷出两道交叉剑气（各横扫 {$twin_blade_mult*100}% 伤害，±{$twin_fan}°，飞出 {$blade_dist}，命中第一名敌人即消失；每名敌人每轮只受一道）

Deals Arts damage upon hit (single target, splashes {$aoe_mult*100}% in a small area around the target) and inflicts 'Requiem' for {$requiem_dur}s: Arts damage taken +{$requiem_bonus*100}% (benefits all allied Arts damage).

keys: {$s1_dur} 秒内锁定一名敌人（优先精英 / Boss），每 {$s1_tick} 秒造成法术伤害，对同一目标伤害逐步升到 ×{$s1_max}、减速加深
en: Locks onto an enemy for {$s1_dur}s (prioritizes Elites / Bosses), dealing Arts damage every {$s1_tick}s. Damage against the same target gradually increases up to ×{$s1_max}, and Slow effect deepens.

keys: 充能一次后永久生效：攻击范围 +{$s2_range*100}%、攻击 +{$s2_atk*100}%；普攻直接处决生命低于其攻击 ×{$s2_exec} 的非精英敌人，溢出伤害转给随机另一名敌人
en: Activates permanently after 1 charge: Attack Range +{$s2_range*100}%, ATK +{$s2_atk*100}%. Normal attacks instantly execute non-Elite enemies with HP lower than ATK ×{$s2_exec}; excess damage is transferred to another random enemy.

keys: 展开 {$s3_fan_deg}° 扇形咒域 {$s3_dur} 秒（自动朝向敌人最多的方向并缓慢转动）：区域内敌人每 {$s3_tick} 秒受到法术伤害并附加「安魂」，敌方弹幕速度 -{(1-$s3_bullet_slow)*100}%，结束时区域内弹幕全部消失；期间普攻只打区域内的敌人
en: Expands a {$s3_fan_deg}° fan-shaped spell domain for {$s3_dur}s (automatically faces the direction with the most enemies and rotates slowly): Enemies within the area take Arts damage every {$s3_tick}s and are inflicted with 'Requiem'. Enemy projectile speed -{(1-$s3_bullet_slow)*100}%. All projectiles within the area disappear when the skill ends. During this time, normal attacks only target enemies within the area.

keys: {$talent_chance*100}% 概率额外攻击随机一名敌人（{$talent_mult*100}% 伤害）并减速 {$talent_slow} 秒
en: {$talent_chance*100}% chance to additionally attack a random enemy (deals {$talent_mult*100}% damage) and Slow them for {$talent_slow}s.

keys: 「言」命中处留下一枚发光咒文 {$glyph_dur} 秒，每 {$glyph_tick} 秒对 {$glyph_r} 内敌人造成 {$glyph_mult*100}% 伤害（最多 {$glyph_max} 枚）
en: Leaves a glowing spell at the hit location of 'Word' for {$glyph_dur}s, dealing {$glyph_mult*100}% damage to enemies within {$glyph_r} every {$glyph_tick}s (max {$glyph_max} spells).

keys: 每次「言」同时攻击 2 个目标（第二道 {$second_mult*100}%）
en: Each 'Word' attacks 2 targets simultaneously (the second deals {$second_mult*100}% damage).

keys: 解锁二技能「殁亡」；解锁天赋「语汇演化」：{$talent_chance*100}% 概率额外攻击随机敌人；普攻「剜魂」：「安魂」改为可叠 {$rq_max} 层，每层受到的法术伤害 +{$rq_per*100}%（取代固定 +{$requiem_bonus*100}%）
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Perish'. Unlocks Talent 'Lexical Evolution': {$talent_chance*100}% chance to additionally attack a random enemy. Normal attack 'Soul Gouge': 'Requiem' can now stack up to {$rq_max} times, each stack increasing Arts damage taken by +{$rq_per*100}% (replaces the fixed +{$requiem_bonus*100}%).

keys: 「安魂」可叠 {$rq_max} 层：{$requiem_dur} 秒内再被「言」命中就加一层并刷新时间，每层受到的法术伤害 +{$rq_per*100}%（最多 +{$rq_per*$rq_max*100}%，取代固定 +{$requiem_bonus*100}%）。敌人头顶的符文显示层数
en: 'Requiem' can stack up to {$rq_max} times: being hit by 'Word' again within {$requiem_dur}s adds a stack and refreshes the duration. Each stack increases Arts damage taken by +{$rq_per*100}% (up to +{$rq_per*$rq_max*100}%, replaces the fixed +{$requiem_bonus*100}%). The rune above the enemy's head displays the stack count.

keys: 「提喻」锁定的目标死亡时，转而锁定最近的敌人，持续剩余时间
en: When the target locked by 'Synecdoche' dies, switches lock to the nearest enemy for the remaining duration.

keys: 「殁亡」处决敌人时，在其位置写下一枚大咒文，{$epitaph_delay} 秒后爆开（半径 {$epitaph_r}，{$epitaph_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: When 'Perish' executes an enemy, writes a large spell at their location that explodes after {$epitaph_delay}s (radius {$epitaph_r}, {$epitaph_mult*100}% damage).

keys: 「转喻」使「提喻」在目标死亡后转而锁定最近的敌人；「墓志铭」使「殁亡」处决时留下爆炸咒文
en: 'Metonymy' causes 'Synecdoche' to switch lock to the nearest enemy after the target dies; 'Epitaph' leaves an explosive spell when 'Perish' executes an enemy.

keys: 「提喻」锁定期间，每 {$meto2_every} 秒以自身为中心半径 {$range*$meto2_r_k:0} 震荡一次（{$meto2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 法术伤害）
en: While locked by 'Synecdoche', resonates once every {$meto2_every}s within a radius of {$range*$meto2_r_k:0} centered on himself ({$meto2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% Arts damage).

keys: 逻各斯每击杀一名敌人，在其位置写下一枚小咒文立即爆开（半径 {$epi2_r}，{$epi2_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: Whenever Logos defeats an enemy, writes a small spell at their location that explodes immediately (radius {$epi2_r}, {$epi2_mult*100}% damage).

keys: 解锁三技能「延异视阈」；普通攻击强化「连缀」：「言」命中后，从目标向最近 {$link_n} 名敌人拉出咒文链 {$link_dur} 秒；链上任一敌人受到逻各斯的法术伤害时，另外两名各受到 {$link_share*100}%（三技能的咒域伤害除外）
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Extended Acuity'. Normal attack enhancement 'Stitch': After 'Word' hits, draws a spell chain from the target to the nearest {$link_n} enemies for {$link_dur}s. When any enemy on the chain takes Arts damage from Logos, the other two each take {$link_share*100}% (excluding the spell domain damage from Skill 3).

keys: 「言」命中后，从目标向 {$link_r} 内最近的 {$link_n} 名敌人拉出咒文链，持续 {$link_dur} 秒；链上任一敌人受到逻各斯的法术伤害时，另外两名各受到这次伤害的 {$link_share*100}%，传过去的伤害不再往下传（三技能的咒域伤害除外）。同时最多 {$link_cap} 组
en: After 'Word' hits, creates an incantation chain from the target to the nearest {$link_n} enemies within {$link_r}, lasting {$link_dur}s. When any enemy on the chain takes Arts damage from Logos, the other two each take {$link_share*100}% of this damage. Transferred damage is not transferred again (except for Skill 3's incantation zone damage). Max {$link_cap} chains at a time.

keys: 术师干员，咒术单体攻击，命中附加「安魂」提升目标所受法术伤害；精英一后处决残血非精英，精英二后清除敌方弹幕
en: Caster Operator. Single-target incantation attacks. Hits inflict 'Requiem', increasing Arts damage taken by the target. After Elite 1, executes non-Elite enemies with low HP. After Elite 2, clears enemy projectiles.

keys: 女妖河谷年轻的「女主人」，罗德岛圆凳滑行赛组织创始人
en: The young 'Lady' of the Banshee Valley, organizer of Rhodes Island's stool racing competition.

keys: 殁亡：攻击范围与攻击永久提升，处决残血
en: Perish: Attack Range and ATK permanently increase, executes enemies with low HP

keys: 队长每次释放技能，逻各斯立刻向最近的两名敌人各追加一枚「言」（伤害与效果同普攻）
en: Whenever the Leader uses a skill, Logos immediately fires an additional 'Word' at the 2 nearest enemies (damage and effects same as normal attacks).

keys: 每 {$heal_cd} 秒为队长回复 {$heal_pct*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命；队长带侵蚀 / 神经损伤时优先驱散（侵蚀清除、神经损伤 -{$nerve_cut}）；每 {$bolt_cd} 秒向射程 {$bolt_range} 内最近的敌人射出一束光弹（法术伤害，命中处小范围溅射 60%），命中者被「照亮」3 秒（视为在照亮范围内，受到的伤害 +25%）
en: Restores {$heal_pct*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP to the Leader every {$heal_cd}s. Prioritizes cleansing if the Leader has Corrosion / Nervous Impairment (clears Corrosion, Nervous Impairment -{$nerve_cut}). Fires a light bolt at the nearest enemy within {$bolt_range} range every {$bolt_cd}s (Arts damage, splashes 60% damage in a small area upon hit). Hit targets are Illuminated for 3s (treated as within Light Radius, damage taken +25%).

keys: 回复队长 {$s1_heal*$k_atk*$k_pow*100:2}% 最大生命，清除侵蚀、神经损伤，{$s1_immune} 秒免疫神经损伤，灯火 +{$s1_lamp}
en: Restores {$s1_heal*$k_atk*$k_pow*100:2}% Max HP to the Leader, clears Corrosion and Nervous Impairment, grants immunity to Nervous Impairment for {$s1_immune}s, and Light +{$s1_lamp}.

keys: 充能一次后永久生效：队长照亮范围 +{$light_mult*100-100}%，受击时灯火损失 -{(1-$lamp_decay)*100}%，「荧光」改为每次为队长回复 {$heal_pct*$guide_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命
en: Permanently active after 1 charge: Leader's Light Radius +{$light_mult*100-100}%, Light loss when attacked -{(1-$lamp_decay)*100}%. 'Fluorescence' instead restores {$heal_pct*$guide_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP to the Leader each time.

keys: 灯塔随行 {$s3_dur} 秒：以队长为中心展开灯塔光圈（半径 {$s3_r}，随队长移动），区内队长每秒回复 {$s3_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命、免疫侵蚀与神经损伤，溟痕与黑潮圈外惩罚失效，每秒灯火 +{$s3_lamp}；结束时在队长身边光爆：对范围内敌人造成 {$s3_burst_mult} 倍光弹伤害（法术）并眩晕 {$s3_burst_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 免疫）
en: Lighthouse Follow for {$s3_dur}s: Expands a Lighthouse Zone centered on the Leader (radius {$s3_r}, moves with the Leader). Within the zone, the Leader restores {$s3_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP per second, is immune to Corrosion and Nervous Impairment, and penalties from Nethersea Brand and being outside the Black Tide are nullified. Light +{$s3_lamp} per second. Upon ending, triggers a light explosion around the Leader: deals {$s3_burst_mult} times light bolt damage (Arts damage) to enemies within range and Stuns them for {$s3_burst_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses immune).

keys: 每次回复或驱散，灯火 +{$talent_lamp}；灯火 ≥ {$talent_lamp_at}（「通明」）时，自身技力回复 +{$talent_sp*100}%
en: Each time HP is restored or a status is cleansed, Light +{$talent_lamp}. When Light ≥ {$talent_lamp_at} ('Bright'), his own SP Recovery +{$talent_sp*100}%.

keys: 身边浮起一个自制发光单元，每 {$unit_cd} 秒射出光弹（{$unit_mult*100}% 伤害，照亮命中者）
en: A homemade Luminescent Unit floats beside him, firing a light bolt every {$unit_cd}s ({$unit_mult*100}% damage, hit targets are Illuminated).

keys: 解锁二技能「沛霖」；解锁天赋「凡人之愿」：每次回复或驱散，灯火 +{$talent_lamp}；灯火通明时，自身技力回复 +{$talent_sp*100}%；普攻「折光」：光弹命中已被照亮的敌人时，折出一道光射向 {$refract_r} 内最近的未照亮敌人（{$refract_mult*100}% 伤害，照亮它）
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'In Downpour, Grace'. Unlocks Talent 'An Everyman's Wish': Each time HP is restored or a status is cleansed, Light +{$talent_lamp}; when Light is Bright, his own SP Recovery +{$talent_sp*100}%. Normal attack 'Refraction': When a light bolt hits an already Illuminated enemy, refracts a beam toward the nearest un-Illuminated enemy within {$refract_r} ({$refract_mult*100}% damage, it is Illuminated).

keys: 光弹命中已被照亮的敌人时，折出一道细光射向 {$refract_r} 内最近的未照亮敌人（光弹 {$refract_mult*100}% 伤害，照亮它）；每发只折一次
en: When a light bolt hits an already Illuminated enemy, refracts a thin beam toward the nearest un-Illuminated enemy within {$refract_r} ({$refract_mult*100}% of light bolt damage, it is Illuminated). Each bolt only refracts once.

keys: 「沐雨」时发光单元在队长周围 {$rain_r} 内洒下光雨 {$rain_dur} 秒：雨中敌人被照亮，每 {$rain_tick} 秒受 {$rain_mult*100}% 伤害
en: During 'In Drizzle, Privation', Luminescent Units shower light rain within {$rain_r} around the Leader for {$rain_dur}s: enemies in the rain are Illuminated, taking {$rain_mult*100}% damage every {$rain_tick}s.

keys: 「沐雨」后，队长身上亮起一道旋转光束 3 秒（长 {$beam_len}，{$beam_period} 秒一圈），扫到的敌人受 {$beam_mult*100}% 伤害并被照亮；精英二后「灯火不灭」全程射出同样的光束
en: After 'In Drizzle, Privation', a rotating light beam shines from the Leader for 3s (length {$beam_len}, 1 rotation every {$beam_period}s). Swept enemies take {$beam_mult*100}% damage and are Illuminated. After Elite 2, 'This Lantern Undying' emits the same beam for its entire duration.

keys: 「光雨」使「沐雨」照亮并伤害周围敌人；「灯塔守望」在释放「沐雨」后以旋转光束照亮并伤害敌人
en: 'Light Rain' causes 'In Drizzle, Privation' to Illuminate and damage surrounding enemies; 'Lighthouse Watch' Illuminates and damages enemies with a rotating beam after casting 'In Drizzle, Privation'.

keys: 「沐雨」时清除队长的神经损伤，灯火 +{$rain2_lamp}，再回复 {$rain2_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% 最大生命
en: During 'In Drizzle, Privation', clears the Leader's Nervous Impairment, Light +{$rain2_lamp}, and restores an additional {$rain2_heal*$k_atk*100:2}% Max HP.

keys: 「沐雨」时、以及「灯火不灭」期间每 {$watch2_every} 秒，以队长为中心半径 {$watch2_r} 放出一圈光脉冲（光弹 {$watch2_mult*100}% 伤害，命中减速 {$watch2_slow} 秒）
en: During 'In Drizzle, Privation', and every {$watch2_every}s during 'This Lantern Undying', emits a ring of light pulses centered on the Leader with a radius of {$watch2_r} ({$watch2_mult*100}% of light bolt damage, hits Slow for {$watch2_slow}s).

keys: 解锁三技能「灯火不灭」：灯塔随行 {$s3_dur} 秒，以队长为中心的灯塔光圈内，队长回复生命、免疫侵蚀与神经损伤，灯火回升，结束时光爆；普通攻击强化「长明」：流明与发光单元每射 {$charge_need} 发攒满一轮，接下来 {$charge_shots} 发变为灯塔光柱：从身前笔直打出，穿透一线上的全部敌人并照亮它们，伤害 ×{$pillar_mult}，每发为队长回复 {$charge_heal*100}% 最大生命
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'This Lantern Undying': Lighthouse Follow for {$s3_dur}s. Within the Lighthouse Zone centered on the Leader, the Leader recovers HP, is immune to Corrosion and Nervous Impairment, and Light recovers; triggers a light burst when it ends. Normal attack enhanced with 'Everlasting': Every {$charge_need} shots fired by Lumen and the Luminescent Unit grants a charge. The next {$charge_shots} shots become Lighthouse Beams: fired straight ahead, piercing all enemies in a line and leaving them Illuminated. Damage ×{$pillar_mult}. Each shot recovers {$charge_heal*100}% Max HP for the Leader.

keys: 流明与发光单元每射 {$charge_need} 发攒满一轮，接下来 {$charge_shots} 发变为直线短光柱（长 {$pillar_len}）：瞬间穿透一线上的全部敌人并照亮，伤害 ×{$pillar_mult}，每发为队长回复 {$charge_heal*100}% 最大生命
en: Every {$charge_need} shots fired by Lumen and the Luminescent Unit grants a charge. The next {$charge_shots} shots become short straight light beams (length {$pillar_len}): instantly pierce all enemies in a line and leave them Illuminated. Damage ×{$pillar_mult}. Each shot recovers {$charge_heal*100}% Max HP for the Leader.

keys: 医疗干员，持续为队长回复生命、驱散侵蚀与神经损伤并补充灯火；精英二后解锁灯塔
en: Medic Operator. Continuously recovers HP for the Leader, cleanses Corrosion and Nervous Impairment, and replenishes Light. Unlocks Lighthouse after Elite 2.

keys: 无论是什么身份，他始终只是竭尽自己所能，为同伴提供支持和援助
en: Whatever his title, he simply does all he can to support and aid his companions.

keys: 沛霖：照亮范围永久扩大
队长站定不动时，「荧光」的回复量提高 50%，每次回复或驱散灯火另 +3；队长移动就恢复
en: When the Leader is stationary, 'Fluorescence' recovery amount increases by 50%, and each recovery or cleanse grants an additional +3 Light; reverts when the Leader moves.

keys: 持伞扇形挥砍前方的敌人（物理，{$half_base*2}°），并用触手追击其中生命最低的敌人（法术）
en: Slashes enemies ahead in a fan-shaped area with his umbrella (Physical, {$half_base*2}°), and uses tentacles to pursue the enemy with the lowest HP among them (Arts).

keys: 充能后下一次伞击强化：伤害 ×{$s1_mult}、范围 ×{$s1_radius}，命中处引发范围冲击（法术），触手追击同样强化
en: When charged, the next Umbrella Strike is enhanced: damage ×{$s1_mult}, range ×{$s1_radius}. Triggers an area shockwave upon hit (Arts); tentacle pursuit is also enhanced.

keys: {$s2_dur} 秒高速状态：挥伞间隔 ×{$s2_interval}，触手追击目标 +1 并附带 {$s2_bind} 秒束缚
en: High-speed state for {$s2_dur}s: Umbrella Strike interval ×{$s2_interval}, tentacle pursuit targets +1 and inflicts Bind for {$s2_bind}s.

keys: {$s3_dur} 秒内攻击覆盖自身周围全范围，范围 ×{$s3_radius}、伤害 ×{$s3_mult}；触手额外攻击目标 +2，优先命中生命最低的敌人，并眩晕 {$s3_stun} 秒
en: For {$s3_dur}s, attacks cover the entire area around himself, range ×{$s3_radius}, damage ×{$s3_mult}; tentacles attack +2 additional targets, prioritize the enemy with the lowest HP, and inflict Stun for {$s3_stun}s.

keys: 附近有半血敌人时自身伤害 +{$talent_mult*100-100}%；每击杀一名普通敌人为队长回复 {$kill_heal*$k_kill*100}% 最大生命（精英 / Boss {$kill_heal*100}%；每秒有上限）
en: When there are enemies with less than half HP nearby, own damage +{$talent_mult*100-100}%. Defeating a normal enemy recovers {$kill_heal*$k_kill*100}% Max HP for the Leader (Elite / Boss {$kill_heal*100}%; capped per second).

keys: 触手二次命中即缠绕：束缚 {$rep_bind} 秒并追加伤害
en: Tentacles entangle upon second hit: inflicts Bind for {$rep_bind}s and deals additional damage.

keys: 触手追击同一名敌人，{$rep_window} 秒内第二次命中时，触手缠绕它：束缚 {$rep_bind} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），并再受一次 {$rep_mult*100}% 触手伤害
en: When tentacles pursue the same enemy and hit a second time within {$rep_window}s, they entangle the target: inflicts Bind for {$rep_bind}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted) and deals another instance of {$rep_mult*100}% tentacle damage.

keys: 挥伞一次命中 {$hyst_hits} 名以上敌人时，触手追击改为全体追击：每名生命低于 {$hyst_below*100}% 的被伞击敌人各挨一根（至多 {$hyst_max} 根）
en: When an Umbrella Strike hits {$hyst_hits} or more enemies, tentacle pursuit changes to an all-target pursuit: each struck enemy with less than {$hyst_below*100}% HP is hit by one tentacle (up to {$hyst_max} tentacles).

keys: 解锁二技能「囚徒困境」；解锁天赋「反移情」：附近有半血敌人时自身伤害 +{$talent_mult*100-100}%；每击杀一名普通敌人为队长回复 {$kill_heal*$k_kill*100}% 最大生命（精英 / Boss {$kill_heal*100}%；每秒有上限）；普攻「拖拽」：触手追击命中后把目标拖向水月 {$drag_dist}（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Prisoner's Dilemma'. Unlocks Talent 'Countertransference': When there are enemies with less than half HP nearby, own damage +{$talent_mult*100-100}%. Defeating a normal enemy recovers {$kill_heal*$k_kill*100}% Max HP for the Leader (Elite / Boss {$kill_heal*100}%; capped per second). Normal attack 'Drag': Tentacle pursuit drags the target toward Mizuki by {$drag_dist} upon hit (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).

keys: 触手追击命中后，把目标拖向水月 {$drag_dist}（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Tentacle pursuit drags the target toward Mizuki by {$drag_dist} upon hit (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).

keys: 「唤醒」强化的那一击，身边再钻出 2 根触手抽打附近的敌人
en: The attack enhanced by 'Awaken' spawns 2 additional tentacles around himself to strike nearby enemies.

keys: 被触手拖到水月身边的敌人（精英一「拖拽」）被缠住 {$cling_dur} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）；缠住期间水月移动，它们跟着移动
en: Enemies dragged to Mizuki by tentacles (Elite 1 'Drag') are entangled for {$cling_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); if Mizuki moves while they are entangled, they move with him.

keys: 「惊跳反射」使「唤醒」的强化攻击追加触手攻击；「病理性依恋」使被触手拖到身边的敌人被缠住
en: 'Startle Reflex' causes the enhanced attack of 'Awaken' to deal an additional tentacle attack; 'Pathological Attachment' causes enemies dragged to him by tentacles to be entangled.

keys: 「唤醒」{$awk2_delay} 秒后，身边触手再抽打一圈（半径 {$s1_burst_r*$awk2_r_k:0}，伞击 {$awk2_mult*100}% 伤害，击退）
en: {$awk2_delay}s after 'Awaken', surrounding tentacles strike again in a circle (radius {$s1_burst_r*$awk2_r_k:0}, {$awk2_mult*100}% Umbrella Strike damage, knockback).

keys: 被缠住的敌人，{$smash_window} 秒内受到的下一次伞击伤害 ×{$smash_mult}（只消耗一次），触手从其脚下钻出
en: Entangled enemies take ×{$smash_mult} damage from the next Umbrella Strike within {$smash_window}s (consumed only once); tentacles emerge from beneath them.

keys: 解锁三技能「镜花水月」：{$s3_dur} 秒内攻击覆盖自身周围全范围，范围 ×{$s3_radius}、伤害 ×{$s3_mult}；触手额外攻击目标 +2，优先命中生命最低的敌人，并眩晕 {$s3_stun} 秒；普通攻击强化「深蓝之籽」：身后的小水母（数量同触手追击数）每 {$jelly_every} 秒各自飞向附近一名敌人，造成伞击 {$jelly_mult*100}% 的法术伤害并束缚 {$jelly_bind} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）；「镜花水月」期间间隔减半
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Moon in the Water': For {$s3_dur}s, attacks cover the entire surrounding area, attack range ×{$s3_radius}, damage ×{$s3_mult}; tentacles attack +2 additional targets, prioritize enemies with the lowest HP, and Stun them for {$s3_stun}s. Normal attacks are enhanced with 'Seed of the Deep': Small jellyfish behind him (amount equal to tentacle pursuit count) each fly toward a nearby enemy every {$jelly_every}s, dealing {$jelly_mult*100}% Umbrella Strike Arts damage and inflicting Bind on them for {$jelly_bind}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted); interval halved during 'Moon in the Water'.

keys: 身后的小水母（数量同触手追击数）离身游猎：每 {$jelly_every} 秒各自飞向 {$jelly_r} 内一名敌人（优先被触手打过的），造成伞击 {$jelly_mult*100}% 的法术伤害并束缚 {$jelly_bind} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），再飘回身后；「镜花水月」期间间隔减半
en: Small jellyfish behind him (amount equal to tentacle pursuit count) detach and hunt: Every {$jelly_every}s, they each fly toward an enemy within {$jelly_r} (prioritizing those hit by tentacles), deal {$jelly_mult*100}% Umbrella Strike Arts damage and inflict Bind on them for {$jelly_bind}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted), then float back; interval halved during 'Moon in the Water'.

keys: 特种干员，持伞作战，触手随同出击；挥伞攻击前方敌人，触手追击生命最低的目标
en: Specialist Operator. Fights with an umbrella, accompanied by tentacles; swings the umbrella to attack enemies ahead, while tentacles pursue the target with the lowest HP.

keys: 这就是你的选择吗？他或许想要一个锚点来固定住自己，他会紧紧抓牢你
en: So this is your choice? He may want an anchor with which to fix himself, and he'll have you tight in his clutches when he does.

keys: 挥伞间隔倍率（越小越快）
en: Umbrella Strike Interval Multiplier (Lower is faster)

keys: 切换至突击后 3 秒内，水月的伞击范围扩大 50%，触手多追击 1 名敌人
en: Within 3s after switching to Assault, Mizuki's umbrella strike range expands by 50%, and tentacles pursue 1 additional enemy.

keys: 阻挡圈：贴近队长的敌人被推开并减速；持盾出拳击退身前的敌人（物理）
en: Block Ring: Enemies close to the Leader are pushed away and Slowed; punches with her shield, causing knockback to enemies ahead (Physical).

keys: 为队长回复 {$s1_heal*$k_pow*100:2}% 最大生命；队长生命低于一半时翻倍；同时清除寒冷、束缚
en: Restores HP to the Leader equal to {$s1_heal*$k_pow*100:2}% of their Max HP; doubled if the Leader's HP is below half; also cleanses Cold and Bind.

keys: 立即为队长回复 {$s2_heal*$k_pow*100:2}% 最大生命，之后 {$hot_dur} 秒内每秒再回复 {$hot_heal*100}%
en: Immediately restores HP to the Leader equal to {$s2_heal*$k_pow*100:2}% of their Max HP, then restores {$hot_heal*100}% HP per second for {$hot_dur}s.

keys: 队长周围升起 {$slot_n} 根琥珀晶柱（敌人一碰即碎并被击退，{$slot_regrow} 秒后原位重新长出）并展开 {$s3_dur} 秒钙质化区域（半径 {$s3_r}），区域内敌人减速、受到的伤害 +10%，队长每秒回复 {$s3_heal*100}% 最大生命，并持续清除寒冷、束缚
en: Raises {$slot_n} amber crystal pillars around the Leader (shatter upon enemy contact and cause knockback, regrowing in place after {$slot_regrow}s) and expands a Calcification area (radius {$s3_r}) for {$s3_dur}s. Enemies within the area are Slowed and take +10% damage. The Leader restores {$s3_heal*100}% Max HP per second, and continuously cleanses Cold and Bind.

keys: {$orb_n1} 枚钙质晶体环绕塞雷娅，撞到的敌人受到拳击 {$orb_mult*100}% 伤害（同一敌人 {$orb_cd} 秒一次）
en: {$orb_n1} calcic crystals orbit Saria; enemies hit take {$orb_mult*100}% punch damage (once every {$orb_cd}s per enemy)

keys: 环绕的钙质晶体撞到敌人时，在其身上留下钙晶碎片 {$mark_dur} 秒；被留下碎片的敌人再被拳击命中时，碎片爆开（半径 {$mark_r}，拳击 {$mark_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: When orbiting calcic crystals hit an enemy, leaves a calcic fragment on them for {$mark_dur}s; when an enemy with a fragment is hit by a punch, the fragment explodes ({$mark_r} radius, {$mark_mult*100}% punch damage)

keys: 解锁二技能「药物配置」；解锁天赋「坚守」：队长受到的伤害 -12%；普攻「钙化拳」：拳击命中的敌人移速 -{$calc_slow*100}%，持续 {$calc_dur} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Medicine Dispensing'; unlocks Talent 'Steadfast': Leader takes -12% damage; Basic Attack 'Calcifying Punch': Enemies hit by punches have movement speed -{$calc_slow*100}% for {$calc_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)

keys: 拳击命中的敌人移速 -{$calc_slow*100}%，持续 {$calc_dur} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），身上浮现琥珀斑
en: Enemies hit by punches have movement speed -{$calc_slow*100}% for {$calc_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted) and develop amber spots

keys: 「急救」同时朝附近 {$syringe_n} 名敌人掷出注射器：拳击 {$syringe_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 伤害并减速 {$syringe_slow} 秒
en: 'First Aid' also throws syringes at {$syringe_n} nearby enemies: deals {$syringe_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% punch damage and Slows for {$syringe_slow}s

keys: 每 {$orb_shatter_every} 秒击碎一枚环绕钙晶，碎片飞向附近至多 {$orb_shatter_n} 名敌人（各拳击 {$orb_shatter_mult*100}% 伤害），{$orb_regrow} 秒后重新长出；精英二后「钙质化」期间改为每 {$shatter_every} 秒击碎一根琥珀晶柱，碎片飞向区域内至多 {$shatter_n} 名敌人（各拳击 {$shatter_mult*$k_pow*100:1}%）
en: Shatters an orbiting calcic crystal every {$orb_shatter_every}s, sending fragments at up to {$orb_shatter_n} nearby enemies (each taking {$orb_shatter_mult*100}% punch damage), regrows after {$orb_regrow}s; after Elite 2, during 'Calcification', instead shatters an amber pillar every {$shatter_every}s, sending fragments at up to {$shatter_n} enemies within range (each taking {$shatter_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% punch damage)

keys: 「急救针剂」使「急救」同时向敌人投掷注射器；「碎晶」定期击碎钙晶，以碎片攻击敌人
en: 'First Aid Syringe' makes 'First Aid' also throw syringes at enemies; 'Shattered Crystal' periodically shatters calcic crystals to attack enemies with fragments

keys: 被急救针剂命中的敌人，{$flow_dur} 秒内受到伤害的 {$flow_pct*100:0}% 转为队长的回复（每次「急救」至多 {$flow_cap*100:1}% 最大生命）
en: For enemies hit by First Aid Syringe, {$flow_pct*100:0}% of damage taken within {$flow_dur}s is converted into HP recovery for the Leader (up to {$flow_cap*100:1}% Max HP per 'First Aid')

keys: 每第 {$shatter2_n} 拳震碎环绕的钙晶向四周崩落：自身周围半径 {$orb_r*$shatter2_r_k:0} 内的敌人受拳击 {$shatter2_mult*100}% 伤害并被击退
en: Every {$shatter2_n}th punch shatters orbiting calcic crystals, collapsing outwards: enemies within a {$orb_r*$shatter2_r_k:0} radius around herself take {$shatter2_mult*100}% punch damage and suffer knockback

keys: 解锁三技能「钙质化」：队长周围升起 {$slot_n} 根琥珀晶柱（敌人一碰即碎并被击退，{$slot_regrow} 秒后原位重新长出）并展开 {$s3_dur} 秒钙质化区域（半径 {$s3_r}），区域内敌人减速、受到的伤害 +10%，队长每秒回复 {$s3_heal*100}% 最大生命；普通攻击强化「莱茵充能护服」：护服每 {$suit_seg_t} 秒充满一格（脚下 4 格琥珀），满格后下一次拳击变为以自身为中心的环形冲击（半径 {$suit_r}、拳击 ×{$suit_mult}、强力击退），并在周围升起 {$pillar_n} 根琥珀晶柱 {$pillar_life} 秒：敌人无法穿过，碰到晶柱的敌人受到拳击 {$pillar_mult*100}% 伤害（精英可挤过，Boss 除外）
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Calcification': Raises {$slot_n} amber pillars around the Leader (shatter and cause knockback when touched by enemies, regrow in place after {$slot_regrow}s) and expands a Calcification area ({$s3_r} radius) for {$s3_dur}s; enemies within the area are Slowed and take +10% damage, Leader recovers {$s3_heal*100}% Max HP per second; Basic Attack enhancement 'Rhine Charged Suit': Suit charges one segment every {$suit_seg_t}s (4 amber segments underfoot), when fully charged, the next punch becomes a ring-shaped shockwave centered on herself ({$suit_r} radius, punch ×{$suit_mult}, strong knockback), and raises {$pillar_n} amber pillars around herself for {$pillar_life}s: enemies cannot pass through, enemies touching pillars take {$pillar_mult*100}% punch damage (Elites can squeeze through, Bosses excepted)

keys: 护服每 {$suit_seg_t} 秒充满一格，4 格满后下一次拳击变为以自身为中心的环形冲击（半径 {$suit_r}、拳击 ×{$suit_mult}、强力击退），并在周围升起 {$pillar_n} 根琥珀晶柱 {$pillar_life} 秒：敌人无法穿过，碰到晶柱的敌人受到拳击 {$pillar_mult*100}% 伤害（精英可挤过，Boss 除外）
en: Suit charges one segment every {$suit_seg_t}s; when 4 segments are fully charged, the next punch becomes a ring-shaped shockwave centered on herself ({$suit_r} radius, punch ×{$suit_mult}, strong knockback), and raises {$pillar_n} amber pillars around herself for {$pillar_life}s: enemies cannot pass through, enemies touching pillars take {$pillar_mult*100}% punch damage (Elites can squeeze through, Bosses excepted)

keys: 重装干员，兼任医疗：阻挡圈推开贴身敌人，拳击命中击退；技能全部用于回复队长生命
en: Defender Operator, doubles as Medic: block radius pushes away close enemies, punches cause knockback on hit; all skills are used to recover Leader HP

keys: 所有人都知道塞雷娅站在战场上意味着什么，把后背交给她，然后，向前进吧。
en: Everyone knows what it means when Saria takes the field. Leave your back to her, and move forward.

keys: 队长站定不动时，她在队长身边升起一圈琥珀晶柱（持续 3 秒，挡住敌人并造成少量伤害）；站满 4 秒再升一次
en: When the Leader stands still, she raises a ring of amber pillars around the Leader (lasts 3s, blocks enemies and deals minor damage); raises again after standing still for 4s

keys: 冲到队长身边的敌人面前抡锤（物理，扇形）；每次命中，其他干员技力 +{$hit_sp} 秒（即 {$hit_sp} 秒的自然回复量）
en: Rushes to enemies near the Leader and swings hammer (Physical, fan-shaped); each hit grants +{$hit_sp}s of SP to other Operators (equal to {$hit_sp}s of natural recovery)

keys: 全队立即回复所需技力的 {$s1_sp*100}%；下一次锤击伤害 ×{$s1_mult}
en: Entire squad immediately recovers {$s1_sp*100}% of SP cost; next hammer strike deals ×{$s1_mult} damage

keys: 原地跃起、空中抡锤转一圈后砸地：周围 {$s2_r} 内 {$s2_mult} 倍伤害并眩晕 0.6 秒，全队（不含自身）技力 +{$s2_sp*100}%
en: Leaps in place, swings hammer in mid-air, and smashes the ground: deals ×{$s2_mult} damage to enemies within {$s2_r} and Stuns them for 0.6s, entire squad (excluding herself) gains +{$s2_sp*100}% SP

keys: {$s3_dur} 秒内锤击伤害 ×{$s3_mult}、每次命中 50% 眩晕 0.8 秒（精英减半），攻击速度 -25%
en: For {$s3_dur}s, hammer strike deals ×{$s3_mult} damage, each hit has a 50% chance to Stun for 0.8s (halved on Elites), ATK speed -25%

keys: 锤击命中时为其他干员回复的技力翻倍
en: Doubles SP restored to other Operators when hammer strikes hit

keys: 每一锤落地打出一圈贴地冲击环（半径 {$quake_r}，锤击 {$quake_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: Each hammer strike creates a ground-level shockwave upon landing (radius {$quake_r}, {$quake_mult*100}% of hammer strike damage)

keys: 冲击环击退敌人；被击退的敌人撞上其他敌人时，双方各受锤击 {$roar_col_mult*100}% 伤害，撞上障碍物时受 {$roar_wall_mult*100}%（Boss 除外）
en: Shockwaves cause knockback; when knocked back enemies collide with other enemies, both take {$roar_col_mult*100}% of hammer strike damage; when colliding with obstacles, they take {$roar_wall_mult*100}% (Bosses excepted)

keys: 解锁二技能「跃空锤」；解锁天赋「鼓舞」：锤击命中时为其他干员回复的技力翻倍；普攻「粉碎」：锤击击倒敌人时迸出碎石，对半径 {$crush_r} 内的敌人造成锤击 {$crush_mult*100}% 伤害（每次锤击至多 {$crush_cap} 处）
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Aerial Hammer'; Unlocks Talent 'Rally': Doubles SP restored to other Operators when hammer strikes hit; Normal attack 'Crushing': When a hammer strike defeats an enemy, debris bursts forth, dealing {$crush_mult*100}% of hammer strike damage to enemies within a radius of {$crush_r} (up to {$crush_cap} bursts per hammer strike)

keys: 锤击击倒敌人时，倒下处迸出一圈碎石，对半径 {$crush_r} 内的敌人造成锤击 {$crush_mult*100}% 伤害（每次锤击至多 {$crush_cap} 处）
en: When a hammer strike defeats an enemy, debris bursts forth from the location, dealing {$crush_mult*100}% of hammer strike damage to enemies within a radius of {$crush_r} (up to {$crush_cap} bursts per hammer strike)

keys: 「跃空锤」落地后立刻再跃向下一群敌人砸第二下（{$leap2_mult*100}% 伤害）；她当队长时不再跃，改为原地朝那群敌人砸出一道地裂（同样伤害）
en: After 'Aerial Hammer' lands, immediately leaps toward the next group of enemies for a second strike ({$leap2_mult*100}% damage); when she is the Leader, does not leap again, but instead strikes the ground to create a fissure toward that group of enemies (same damage)

keys: 「冲锋号令·γ型」放出一圈向外扩张的金色号令波（半径 {$cmd_r}，锤击 {$cmd_mult*100}% 伤害），推开小怪
en: 'Charge γ' releases an expanding golden command wave (radius {$cmd_r}, {$cmd_mult*100}% of hammer strike damage), causing knockback to minor enemies

keys: 「再跃」使「跃空锤」追加一次跃击；「万兽之王」使「冲锋号令·γ型」释放冲击波
en: 'Second Leap' causes 'Aerial Hammer' to perform an additional leap strike; 'King of Beasts' causes 'Charge γ' to release a shockwave

keys: 「跃空锤」两次落地后 {$leap3_delay} 秒，以自身为中心半径 {$leap3_r} 震出一圈（锤击 {$leap3_mult*100}% 伤害，击退）
en: {$leap3_delay}s after 'Aerial Hammer' lands twice, releases a shockwave centered on herself with a radius of {$leap3_r} ({$leap3_mult*100}% of hammer strike damage, knockback)

keys: 「冲锋号令·γ型」的金色号令波扫过队长和队友时，清除其一个负面状态（束缚、寒冷、减速、神经损伤之一）；每道号令波对每名干员一次
en: When the golden command wave of 'Charge γ' sweeps past the Leader and allies, removes one negative status from them (one of Bind, Cold, Slow, or Nervous Impairment); once per Operator per command wave

keys: 解锁三技能「碎颅击」：{$s3_dur} 秒内锤击伤害 ×{$s3_mult}、每次命中 50% 眩晕 0.8 秒（精英减半），攻击速度 -25%；普通攻击强化「破阵」：每一锤向前砸出一道长 {$crack_len} 的直线金色地裂，沿途敌人受到锤击 {$crack_mult*100}% 伤害
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Skull Breaker': For {$s3_dur}s, hammer strike damage ×{$s3_mult}, each hit has a 50% chance to Stun for 0.8s (halved on Elites), ATK speed -25%; Normal attack enhancement 'Linebreaker': Each hammer strike creates a straight golden fissure of length {$crack_len} forward, dealing {$crack_mult*100}% of hammer strike damage to enemies along the path

keys: 每一锤向前砸出一道长 {$crack_len} 的金色地裂，沿途敌人受到锤击 {$crack_mult*100}% 伤害；地裂上冒出金色岩刺
en: Each hammer strike creates a golden fissure of length {$crack_len} forward, dealing {$crack_mult*100}% of hammer strike damage to enemies along the path; golden rock spikes emerge from the fissure

keys: 先锋干员，持锤冲阵，锤击命中为全队回复技力
en: Vanguard Operator. Charges into battle with a hammer, restoring SP to the squad when hammer strikes hit

keys: “举起大锤，领着大伙，毫不畏惧地冲锋”，对她来说，这些一直都是理所当然的事情。
en: 'Lead from the front, charging fearlessly into the fray with the hammer.' To her, it has always been her nature.

keys: 每 {$cd} 秒在队长身边横扫大剑（物理，扇形 160°，半径 {$reach}）
en: Sweeps the greatsword around the Leader every {$cd}s (Physical, 160° sector, radius {$reach})

keys: 立即一次 ×{$s1_mult} 伤害的宽幅横扫（前方 200°）
en: Immediately performs a wide sweep dealing ×{$s1_mult} damage (200° forward)

keys: 高举大剑下劈：前方 220° 半径 {$s2_r} 内 {$s2_mult} 倍伤害并击退
en: Raises the greatsword and slashes downward: deals {$s2_mult} times damage to enemies within a 220° forward sector and radius of {$s2_r}, and causes knockback

keys: {$s3_dur} 秒内横扫改为全方向，半径 {$reach} → {$reach_skill*$s3_reach:0}、伤害 ×{$s3_mult}
en: For {$s3_dur}s, sweeps become omnidirectional, radius {$reach} → {$reach_skill*$s3_reach:0}, damage ×{$s3_mult}

keys: 每第 3 次横扫追加一次反手斩（{$back_mult*100}%；「涌潮悲歌」期间不触发）
en: Every 3rd sweep is followed by an additional backhand slash ({$back_mult*100}% damage; does not trigger during 'Tidal Elegy')

keys: 每次横扫变为两连斩：{$combo2_delay} 秒后反向回挥一刀（{$combo2_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: Each sweep becomes a double slash: slashes back in the opposite direction after {$combo2_delay}s ({$combo2_mult*100}% damage)

keys: 连斩变为 3 段：第三下旋身斩一整圈（{$combo3_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: Combo attacks become 3 hits: the third hit is a spinning slash hitting a full circle ({$combo3_mult*100}% damage)

keys: 解锁二技能「跃浪击」；解锁天赋「深海掠食者」：每第 3 次横扫追加一次反手斩（{$back_mult*100}%）；普攻「破浪下劈」：每第 {$leap_n} 次横扫改为跃起下劈：前方扇形 ×{$leap_mult} 伤害并击退
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Wave Strike'; unlocks Talent 'Abyssal Predator': every 3rd sweep is followed by a backhand slash ({$back_mult*100}% damage); normal attack 'Wave-Breaking Cleave': every {$leap_n}th sweep becomes a leaping cleave: deals ×{$leap_mult} damage in a frontal fan area and causes knockback

keys: 每第 {$leap_n} 次横扫改为跃起下劈：前方 120° 扇形（半径 {$leap_r}）×{$leap_mult} 伤害，落点溅起水花，击退更远（「涌潮悲歌」期间不换）
en: Every {$leap_n}th sweep becomes a leaping cleave: deals ×{$leap_mult} damage in a frontal 120° fan area (radius {$leap_r}), splashing water at the impact point and causing further knockback (does not change during 'Tidal Elegy')

keys: 「跃浪击」落点掀起一道向前推进约 {$wave_dist} 的海浪墙，击退并伤害沿途敌人（跃浪击 {$wave_mult*100}% 伤害，每名敌人一次）
en: The impact point of 'Wave Strike' creates a wave wall that advances about {$wave_dist}, causing knockback and dealing damage to enemies along the path ({$wave_mult*100}% of Wave Strike damage, once per enemy)

keys: 「迅捷打击·γ型」挥出时脚下涌出一圈水环（半径 {$pulse_r}，{$s3_mult*$pulse_mult*100}% 伤害，击退）；精英二后「涌潮悲歌」期间每 {$pulse_every} 秒涌出一圈
en: When 'Swift Strike γ' is used, a water ring surges beneath her (radius {$pulse_r}, {$s3_mult*$pulse_mult*100}% damage, causes knockback); after Elite 2, a ring surges every {$pulse_every}s during 'Tidal Elegy'

keys: 「跃浪」在「跃浪击」落点形成向前推进的海浪；「涌潮」在「迅捷打击·γ型」释放时及精英二后的「涌潮悲歌」期间产生水环
en: 'Leaping Wave' creates an advancing wave at the impact point of 'Wave Strike'; 'Surging Tide' generates water rings when 'Swift Strike γ' is used and during 'Tidal Elegy' after Elite 2.

keys: 「跃浪击」{$wave2_delay} 秒后海水回卷，自身周围半径 {$wave2_r} 内的敌人再受跃浪击 {$wave2_mult*100}% 伤害并被击退
en: {$wave2_delay}s after 'Wave Strike', the seawater rolls back, dealing {$wave2_mult*100}% of Wave Strike damage to enemies within a radius of {$wave2_r} around herself and causing knockback.

keys: 「迅捷打击·γ型」的水环 {$surge2_delay} 秒后再涌一圈（{$surge2_mult*100}% 伤害）；「涌潮悲歌」结束时以自身为中心掀一记大浪（半径 {$pulse_r*$surge2_end_r:0}，{$surge2_end_mult*100}% 伤害，击退）
en: The water ring of 'Swift Strike γ' surges again after {$surge2_delay}s ({$surge2_mult*100}% damage); when 'Tidal Elegy' ends, creates a large wave centered on herself (radius {$pulse_r*$surge2_end_r:0}, {$surge2_end_mult*100}% damage, causes knockback).

keys: 解锁三技能「涌潮悲歌」：{$s3_dur} 秒内横扫改为全方向，半径 {$reach} → {$reach_skill*$s3_reach:0}、伤害 ×{$s3_mult}；普通攻击强化「涌潮」：每轮连斩收尾，朝最近的敌人放出一道潮刃，飞出 {$blade_dist}，穿透沿途全部敌人，造成横扫 {$blade_mult*100}% 伤害并推开；「涌潮悲歌」期间每轮放 3 道
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Tidal Elegy': for {$s3_dur}s, sweeps become omnidirectional, radius {$reach} → {$reach_skill*$s3_reach:0}, damage ×{$s3_mult}; normal attack enhances 'Surging Tide': at the end of each combo, releases a tide blade toward the nearest enemy that travels {$blade_dist}, penetrates all enemies along the path, deals {$blade_mult*100}% of sweep damage and pushes them away; releases 3 blades per combo during 'Tidal Elegy'.

keys: 每轮连斩收尾，朝最近的敌人放出一道潮刃：飞出 {$blade_dist}，穿透沿途全部敌人，造成横扫 {$blade_mult*100}% 的伤害并推开；「涌潮悲歌」期间每轮放 3 道（扇形 ±25°）
en: At the end of each combo, releases a tide blade toward the nearest enemy: travels {$blade_dist}, penetrates all enemies along the path, deals {$blade_mult*100}% of sweep damage and pushes them away; releases 3 blades per combo during 'Tidal Elegy' (±25° fan area).

keys: 近卫干员，赏金猎人、深海猎人成员，贴身高频横扫；技能展开大范围重斩
en: Guard Operator, Bounty Hunter and Abyssal Hunter member. Performs close-range rapid sweeps; skills execute wide-range heavy slashes.

keys: 前阿戈尔传奇电工，能够以一己之力维护一整座城市的海底灯光阵列
en: Former legendary Ægir electrician, able to maintain an entire city's undersea lighting array single-handedly.

keys: 队长每次冲刺结束，她以队长的落点为中心横扫一周（大剑 120% 伤害并击退）
en: At the end of each of the Leader's dashes, she performs a full-circle sweep centered on the Leader's impact point (120% greatsword damage and causes knockback).

keys: 每 {$cd} 秒以队长为中心放出一圈声浪（半径 {$aura}），打圈内最近的 {$wave_n} 个敌人（Boss / 精英优先）造成法术伤害；歌域内干员攻击 +{$song_atk*100}%；队长在歌域内时每 {$heal_cd} 秒回复 {$heal_pct*100}% 最大生命。她自己当队长时另有一圈「领唱」打圈内全部敌人（{$lead_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: Every {$cd}s, releases a sound wave centered on the Leader (radius {$aura}), dealing Arts damage to the nearest {$wave_n} enemies within the ring (prioritizes Bosses / Elite enemies); Operators within the song domain gain +{$song_atk*100}% ATK; when the Leader is within the domain, restores {$heal_pct*100}% Max HP every {$heal_cd}s. When she is the Leader, an additional 'Lead Vocal' ring hits all enemies within range ({$lead_mult*100}% damage).
Chant of Returning by Varied Paths

keys: {$s1_dur} 秒：歌域 ×{$s1_aura}、歌域内干员攻击速度 +{$s1_aspd*$k_pow*100:1}%、队长每秒回复 {$s1_heal*$k_pow*100:2}% 最大生命，期间受击灯火流失 ×{$s1_lamp_loss}
en: {$s1_dur}s: Song domain ×{$s1_aura}, Operators within the song domain gain +{$s1_aspd*$k_pow*100:1}% ATK speed, Leader restores {$s1_heal*$k_pow*100:2}% Max HP per second. Light loss from taking damage is ×{$s1_lamp_loss} during this time.
Wish of Burial Beyond the Light

keys: 充能一次后永久生效：歌域 +{$s2_aura*100}%；歌域内干员攻击 +{$s2_atk*$k_pow*100:1}%、攻击速度 +{$s2_aspd*$k_pow*100:1}%，深海猎人（斯卡蒂、乌尔比安、归溟幽灵鲨）再 +{$s2_hunter_atk*$k_pow*100:1}% 攻击
en: Permanent effect after one charge: Song domain +{$s2_aura*100}%; Operators within the song domain gain +{$s2_atk*$k_pow*100:1}% ATK and +{$s2_aspd*$k_pow*100:1}% ATK speed. Abyssal Hunter Operators (Skadi, Ulpianus, Specter the Unchained) gain an additional +{$s2_hunter_atk*$k_pow*100:1}% ATK.
The Tide Surges, The Tide Recedes

keys: {$s3_dur} 秒：歌域 ×{$s3_aura}、全队攻击 +{$s3_atk*$k_pow*100:1}%、队长每秒回复 {$s3_heal*$k_pow*100:2}% 最大生命；灯火每秒 -{$s3_lamp_drain}。灯火暗淡（< {$talent_dark}）时不再扣灯火，改为全队攻击再 +{$s3_dark_atk*$k_pow*100:1}%
en: {$s3_dur}s: Song domain ×{$s3_aura}, squad ATK +{$s3_atk*$k_pow*100:1}%, Leader restores {$s3_heal*$k_pow*100:2}% Max HP per second; Light -{$s3_lamp_drain} per second. When Light is Dim (< {$talent_dark}), no longer drains Light, and squad ATK gains an additional +{$s3_dark_atk*$k_pow*100:1}% instead.

keys: 灯火通明（≥ {$talent_bright}）：歌域 +{$bright_aura*100}%、回复 ×{$bright_heal}；暗淡（< {$talent_dark}）：歌域内干员攻击 +{$dark_atk*100}%、歌域内敌人移速 -{$dark_slow*100}%（不算减速状态）；编队里每名其他深海猎人，歌域内干员攻击 +{$talent_hunter*100}%（最多 {$talent_hunter_cap} 人）
en: When Light is Bright (≥ {$talent_bright}): Song domain +{$bright_aura*100}%, HP recovery ×{$bright_heal}; when Dim (< {$talent_dark}): Operators within the song domain gain +{$dark_atk*100}% ATK, enemies within the song domain have -{$dark_slow*100}% movement speed (does not count as Slow); for every other Abyssal Hunter in the squad, Operators within the song domain gain +{$talent_hunter*100}% ATK (up to {$talent_hunter_cap} Operators).

keys: 歌域内的干员每击杀一名敌人，击杀处发出一道小声浪（半径 {$res_r}，{$res_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: Whenever an Operator within the song's range defeats an enemy, a small sound wave is emitted from the location of the defeat (radius {$res_r}, {$res_mult*100}% damage)

keys: 队长每连续 {$tide_every} 秒未受击，歌域内干员叠一层潮声（至多 {$tide_max} 层），每层攻击速度 +{$tide_aspd*100}%；队长受击时清零
en: For every {$tide_every}s the Leader is not attacked, Operators within the song's range gain 1 stack of Tide (up to {$tide_max} stacks). Each stack grants +{$tide_aspd*100}% ATK speed; stacks are cleared when the Leader is attacked

keys: 解锁二技能「同葬无光之愿」；解锁天赋「捕食习性」：歌域效果随灯火档位变化；普攻追加「余音」：每圈声浪扩散完，歌域外圈留下一道回声，对外圈的敌人造成 {$ring_mult*100}% 伤害
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Wish of Burial Beyond the Light'; unlocks Talent 'Predatory Habits': song's range effects change based on Light level; normal attacks gain 'Echo': after each sound wave finishes spreading, an echo is left in the outer ring of the song's range, dealing {$ring_mult*100}% damage to enemies in the outer ring

keys: 每圈声浪扩散完，歌域外圈留下一道回声：这圈声浪打中的敌人里，位于外圈（半径 {$ring_in*100}% 以外）的再受到 {$ring_mult*100}% 伤害
en: After each sound wave finishes spreading, an echo is left in the outer ring of the song's range: among the enemies hit by this sound wave, those in the outer ring (beyond {$ring_in*100}% radius) take an additional {$ring_mult*100}% damage

keys: 每第 {$echo_every} 次声浪后追加一次回声（{$echo_mult*100}% 伤害，同样打最近 {$wave_n} 个）
en: After every {$echo_every} sound waves, an additional echo is emitted ({$echo_mult*100}% damage, also hits the closest {$wave_n} enemies)

keys: 「同归殊途之吟」期间，歌域内的敌人每被声浪命中一次叠一层共振（至多 {$reso_cap} 层）；满层的敌人在下一次声浪时爆开（半径 {$reso_r}，{$reso_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 法术伤害）并清层
en: During 'Chant of Returning by Varied Paths', enemies within the song's range gain 1 stack of Resonance each time they are hit by a sound wave (up to {$reso_cap} stacks); enemies with max stacks explode upon the next sound wave (radius {$reso_r}, {$reso_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% Arts damage) and their stacks are cleared

keys: 「潮汐和声」每 {$echo_every} 次声浪追加一次回声；「深海的回响」使「同归殊途之吟」期间被声浪命中的敌人叠共振，满层爆开
en: 'Tidal Harmony' emits an additional echo after every {$echo_every} sound waves; 'Echoes of the Deep' causes enemies hit by sound waves during 'Chant of Returning by Varied Paths' to gain Resonance stacks, exploding at max stacks

keys: 追加的回声之后再响第二道（{$echo2_mult*100}% 伤害，同样打最近 {$wave_n} 个）
en: A second echo sounds after the additional echo ({$echo2_mult*100}% damage, also hits the closest {$wave_n} enemies)

keys: 「同归殊途之吟」期间每秒：歌域内的敌人减速 {$reso2_slow} 秒，其他干员技能的技力各 +{$reso2_sp} 秒
en: Every second during 'Chant of Returning by Varied Paths': enemies within the song's range are Slowed for {$reso2_slow}s, and other Operators gain {$reso2_sp} SP

keys: 解锁三技能「潮涌，潮枯」；普通攻击强化「远古血亲」：部署一只海嗣，常驻在队长 {$ishar_leash} 内敌人最密处，以自身为中心展开小歌域（半径 {$ishar_r}）；她每放一圈声浪，海嗣同步放一圈（{$ishar_mult*100}% 伤害，打小歌域内最近的 {$ishar_n} 个敌人）；小歌域内的干员同样获得歌域效果（不叠加）
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'The Tide Surges, The Tide Recedes'; normal attacks are enhanced by 'Ancient Kin': deploys a Seaborn that stays in the densest cluster of enemies within {$ishar_leash} of the Leader, expanding a small song's range centered on itself (radius {$ishar_r}); whenever she emits a sound wave, the Seaborn emits one simultaneously ({$ishar_mult*100}% damage, hits the closest {$ishar_n} enemies within the small song's range); Operators within the small song's range also gain the song's range effects (does not stack)

keys: 海嗣常驻在队长 {$ishar_leash} 内敌人最密处，以自身为中心展开小歌域（半径 {$ishar_r}，歌域扩大时扩大一半，「潮涌，潮枯」除外）。她每放一圈声浪，海嗣同步放一圈：{$ishar_mult*100}% 伤害，打小歌域内最近的 {$ishar_n} 个敌人。小歌域内的干员同样获得歌域效果（不叠加）。海嗣不会受到攻击
en: The Seaborn stays in the densest cluster of enemies within {$ishar_leash} of the Leader, expanding a small song's range centered on itself (radius {$ishar_r}, expands by half when the song's range expands, except during 'The Tide Surges, The Tide Recedes'). Whenever she emits a sound wave, the Seaborn emits one simultaneously: {$ishar_mult*100}% damage, hits the closest {$ishar_n} enemies within the small song's range. Operators within the small song's range also gain the song's range effects (does not stack). The Seaborn cannot be attacked

keys: 辅助干员，歌域随队长移动，提升域内攻击与攻击速度；灯火通明时域 +{$bright_aura*100}%、回复翻倍，暗淡时域内敌人移速 -{$dark_slow*100}%；每有一名深海猎人，域内攻击再 +{$talent_hunter*100}%
en: Supporter Operator. The song's range moves with the Leader, increasing ATK and ATK speed within it; when Light is Bright, the range is +{$bright_aura*100}% and recovery is doubled; when Dim, enemies within the range have movement speed -{$dark_slow*100}%; for each Abyssal Hunter present, ATK within the range is further increased by +{$talent_hunter*100}%

keys:
名为斯卡蒂的深海猎人//名为伊莎玛拉的海嗣
正停留此处
等待你的部署//渴盼你的呼唤
en:
The Abyssal Hunter named Skadi // The Seaborn named Ishar'mla
waits here
for your deployment // for your call

keys: 队长每次开技能，歌域立刻放出一圈声浪；之后 3 秒，歌域内干员攻击速度 +10%
en: Whenever the Leader activates a skill, the song's range immediately emits a sound wave; for 3s afterwards, Operators within the song's range gain ATK speed +10%

keys: 每 {$cd} 秒贴身 360° 环斩（半径 {$reach}）
en: Performs a 360° point-blank circular slash every {$cd}s (radius {$reach})

keys: {$s1_dur} 秒内攻击 +（{$s1_atk*100}% + 队长已损失生命的百分比）
en: ATK +({$s1_atk*100}% + the percentage of the Leader's lost HP) for {$s1_dur}s

keys: {$s2_dur} 秒内攻击速度 +{$s2_aspd*100}%、攻击 +{((1+$s2_atk)*$k_pow-1)*100:1}%，期间队长生命不会低于 1；结束时本体倒下，替身跟随队长 {$doll_dur} 秒后归队
en: ATK speed +{$s2_aspd*100}% and ATK +{((1+$s2_atk)*$k_pow-1)*100:1}% for {$s2_dur}s, during which the Leader's HP cannot fall below 1; when the skill ends, her main body falls, and a Substitute follows the Leader for {$doll_dur}s before returning to the squad

keys: {$s3_dur} 秒内环斩间隔 ×{$s3_cd_mult}，但每斩 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}、范围 +{$s3_reach*100-100}%，对生命低于 50% 的敌人再 ×{$s3_low_mult}
en: For {$s3_dur}s, circular slash interval ×{$s3_cd_mult}, but each slash ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}, range +{$s3_reach*100-100}%, and a further ×{$s3_low_mult} to enemies with less than 50% HP

keys: 替身每秒对周围 {$doll_r} 内敌人造成法术伤害并减速；灯火 < 30（「暗淡」）时她的伤害 +{$dark_bonus*100}%
en: Substitute deals Arts damage to enemies within {$doll_r} and inflicts Slow every second; when Light < 30 ('Dim'), her damage +{$dark_bonus*100}%

keys: 环斩后 {$spin2_delay} 秒反向再转一圈（{$spin2_mult*100}% 伤害）：2 道锯环
en: {$spin2_delay}s after a circular slash, spins again in the reverse direction ({$spin2_mult*100}% damage): 2 saw rings

keys: 环斩在地上留下一圈潮痕 {$ring_dur} 秒，每 {$ring_tick} 秒对圈内敌人造成 {$ring_mult*100}% 伤害（最多 {$ring_max} 圈）
en: Circular slash leaves a tide mark on the ground for {$ring_dur}s, dealing {$ring_mult*100}% damage to enemies within the ring every {$ring_tick}s (max {$ring_max} rings)

keys: 解锁二技能「生存的渴望」；解锁天赋「拥抱自我」：替身光环，灯火暗淡时她的伤害 +{$dark_bonus*100}%；普攻「卷刃」：环斩起手时把 {$curl_r} 内的敌人吸近 {$curl_dist}（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'The Thirst to Survive'; unlocks Talent 'Embraced Self': Substitute aura, her damage +{$dark_bonus*100}% when Light is Dim; normal attack 'Curled Edge': circular slash startup pulls enemies within {$curl_r} closer by {$curl_dist} (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)

keys: 环斩起手时，锯刃外圈一道向内收的水纹，把环斩范围外、{$curl_r} 内的敌人吸近 {$curl_dist}（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: During circular slash startup, an inward water ripple on the outer edge of the saw blade pulls enemies outside the circular slash range but within {$curl_r} closer by {$curl_dist} (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted)

keys: 「生存的技巧」期间，队长每被命中一次，她立即追加一次环斩（{$beast_cd} 秒内至多一次）；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_beast}
en: During 'The Skill to Survive', every time the Leader is hit, she immediately performs an additional circular slash (at most once every {$beast_cd}s); damage ×{$grow_dmg_beast}

keys: 环斩每命中 1 名敌人攒 1 点锯鸣（上限 {$hum_max}）；攒满时下一圈环斩变为旋锯：持续 {$whirl_dur} 秒，每 {$whirl_tick} 秒一次，范围 +{$hum_rk*100-100}%，每次为环斩伤害的 {$whirl_mult*100}%，结束后清零
en: Each enemy hit by circular slash grants 1 point of Saw Resonance (limit {$hum_max}); when full, the next circular slash becomes a whirling saw: lasts {$whirl_dur}s, triggers once every {$whirl_tick}s, range +{$hum_rk*100-100}%, each hit deals {$whirl_mult*100}% of circular slash damage, resets to zero after ending

keys: 「困兽」使「生存的技巧」期间队长受击时追加环斩；「锯鸣」使环斩攒满后变为旋锯
en: 'Trapped Beast' adds an additional circular slash when the Leader is hit during 'The Skill to Survive'; 'Saw Resonance' turns the circular slash into a whirling saw when fully charged

keys: 「生存的技巧」期间每次环斩起手把周围 {$reach_skill*$beast2_r_k:0} 内的敌人拉近 {$beast2_dist}（精英减半，Boss 免疫拉拽）
en: During 'The Skill to Survive', each circular slash startup pulls enemies within {$reach_skill*$beast2_r_k:0} closer by {$beast2_dist} (halved on Elites, Bosses immune to pull)

keys: 旋锯结束时震地一圈（半径 {$res_quake_r}，环斩伤害的 {$res_quake_mult*100}%，击退，Boss 除外）；旋锯期间每命中 {$res_blade_every} 次，锯刃甩出一道水刃（飞出 {$res_blade_len}，穿透，环斩伤害的 {$res_blade_mult*100}%，每次旋锯至多 {$res_blade_max} 道）
en: When whirling saw ends, causes a ground tremor (radius {$res_quake_r}, {$res_quake_mult*100}% of circular slash damage, knockback, Bosses excepted); during whirling saw, every {$res_blade_every} hits, the saw blade flings a water blade (travels {$res_blade_len}, pierces, {$res_blade_mult*100}% of circular slash damage, max {$res_blade_max} blades per whirling saw)

keys: 解锁三技能「生存的重压」：环斩间隔 ×{$s3_cd_mult}、每斩 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}，对生命低于 50% 的敌人再 ×{$s3_low_mult}；普通攻击强化「替身闪现」：每第 3 次环斩，替身在附近敌群最密处现身，释放 {$flash_spins} 次法术脉冲（半径 {$flash_r}，每次命中最近 {$flash_n} 个，{$flash_mult*100}% 伤害）后碎成泡沫消失
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'The Pressure to Survive': circular slash interval ×{$s3_cd_mult}, each slash ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}, and a further ×{$s3_low_mult} to enemies with less than 50% HP; normal attack enhancement 'Substitute Flash': every 3rd circular slash, the Substitute appears in the densest nearby enemy cluster, releasing {$flash_spins} Arts pulses (radius {$flash_r}, each hitting the nearest {$flash_n} targets, {$flash_mult*100}% damage) before shattering into foam and disappearing

keys: 每第 3 次环斩，替身在 {$flash_range} 内敌群最密处从水花里现身，以自身为中心释放 {$flash_spins} 次法术脉冲（半径 {$flash_r}，每次命中最近的 {$flash_n} 个敌人，优先首领与精英，为环斩的 {$flash_mult*100}% 伤害），随后碎成泡沫消失；同时最多 1 个，替身跟随队长期间不出现
en: Every 3rd circular slash, the Substitute appears from water splashes in the densest enemy cluster within {$flash_range}, releasing {$flash_spins} Arts pulses centered on herself (radius {$flash_r}, each hitting the nearest {$flash_n} enemies, prioritizing Bosses and Elites, dealing {$flash_mult*100}% of circular slash damage), then shatters into foam and disappears; max 1 at a time, does not appear while the Substitute is following the Leader

keys: 特种干员，深海猎人成员，贴身环斩周遭敌人；一技能随队长损失生命比例提升自身攻击，灯火暗淡时伤害 +{$dark_bonus*100}%；倒下后留替身牵制敌人
en: Specialist Operator, Abyssal Hunter member, performs close-range circular slashes against surrounding enemies; Skill 1 increases her ATK based on the Leader's lost HP percentage, damage +{$dark_bonus*100}% when Light is Dim; leaves a Substitute to stall enemies after falling

keys: 本名劳伦缇娜，自囚笼里挣脱，从疯狂中苏醒。
en: Born Laurentina, free from her cage, awake from her madness.

keys: 生存的渴望：队长暂不会倒下
en: The Thirst to Survive — Leader temporarily will not fall

keys: 切到突击时，替身立刻在附近敌群最密处现身连斩；归队集合完毕时，她环斩一圈（上一次环斩的 150%）
en: When switching to Assault, the Substitute immediately appears in the densest nearby enemy cluster and slashes continuously; when regrouping is complete, she performs a circular slash (150% of the previous circular slash)

keys: 减速光域：光域内敌人移速 -35%；每 {$cd} 秒向 2 名敌人发射 {$shots} 团追踪狐火，命中时小范围溅射（法术），被命中的敌人 {$fox_slow_dur} 秒内移速 -{$fox_slow*100}%（不叠加，Boss 除外）
en: Slowing Foxfire Field: Movement speed of enemies within the Foxfire Field -35%; fires {$shots} tracking foxfires at 2 enemies every {$cd}s, dealing Arts damage in a small area upon hit. Movement speed of hit enemies -{$fox_slow*100}% for {$fox_slow_dur}s (Does not stack, Bosses excepted).

keys: 下一次普攻改为射出 {$s1_shots} 发狐火（伤害 ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2}）
en: The next attack instead fires {$s1_shots} foxfires (Damage ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2}).

keys: 充能一次后永久生效：光域范围 +60%，其他干员攻击 +{$s2_buff*$k_pow*100:1}%，队长每秒回复 0.4% 最大生命
en: Takes effect permanently after 1 charge: Foxfire Field AoE +60%, other Operators' ATK +{$s2_buff*$k_pow*100:1}%, Leader recovers 0.4% Max HP per second.

keys: 展开 {$s3_dur} 秒大光域（范围 ×2.2），光域内敌人减速、受到的伤害 +10%，其他干员攻击 +{$s3_buff*$k_pow*100:1}%，队长每秒回复 0.8% 最大生命；期间铃兰不再普攻
en: Expands a large Foxfire Field for {$s3_dur}s (AoE ×2.2), enemies within the Foxfire Field are Slowed and take +10% damage, other Operators' ATK +{$s3_buff*$k_pow*100:1}%, Leader recovers 0.8% Max HP per second; Suzuran stops attacking during this time.

keys: 光域内的敌人受到的伤害 +10%；狐火 +1 发
en: Enemies within the Foxfire Field take +10% damage; foxfires +1.

keys: 狐火命中后不消散，附在目标身上 {$att_dur} 秒，每 {$att_every} 秒灼烧周围 {$att_r} 内的敌人（狐火 {$att_mult*100}% 伤害），并向其中一名未被附着的敌人传一次火
en: Foxfires do not dissipate upon hit, attaching to the target for {$att_dur}s, burning enemies within a radius of {$att_r} every {$att_every}s ({$att_mult*100}% foxfire damage), and spreading the fire once to one unattached enemy among them.

keys: 每第 {$merge_every} 次普攻，三团狐火在身前汇成一团大狐火射出：贯穿沿途敌人，伤害为一团狐火的 {$merge_mult} 倍
en: Every {$merge_every} attacks, three foxfires merge into a large foxfire in front of her and are fired, piercing enemies along the path and dealing {$merge_mult} times the damage of a single foxfire.

keys: 解锁二技能「儿时的舞乐」；解锁天赋「祈愿」：光域内的敌人受到的伤害 +10%；狐火 +1 发；普攻「狐火灼印」：狐火命中的敌人 {$brand_dur} 秒内受到的伤害 +{$brand_value*100}%
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Childhood Frolic'; unlocks Talent 'Prayer': Enemies within the Foxfire Field take +10% damage; foxfires +1; normal attack 'Foxfire Brand': Enemies hit by foxfires take +{$brand_value*100}% damage for {$brand_dur}s.

keys: 狐火命中的敌人 {$brand_dur} 秒内受到的伤害 +{$brand_value*100}%，脚下浮现一枚金色小印
en: Enemies hit by foxfires take +{$brand_value*100}% damage for {$brand_dur}s, and a small golden seal appears beneath them.

keys: 「全力以赴」命中的敌人被定身 {$seal_stun} 秒（精英 {$seal_stun_elite} 秒，Boss 免疫），脚下浮现金色封印
en: Enemies hit by 'I'll Do My Best' are Bound for {$seal_stun}s ({$seal_stun_elite}s on Elites, Bosses immune), and a golden seal appears beneath them.

keys: 「儿时的舞乐」生效后，光域边缘的 {$hearth_n} 团狐火会灼伤碰到的敌人（狐火 {$hearth_mult*100}% 伤害，每名敌人 {$hearth_cd} 秒一次）
en: After 'Childhood Frolic' activates, {$hearth_n} foxfires at the edge of the Foxfire Field burn enemies they touch ({$hearth_mult*100}% foxfire damage, once every {$hearth_cd}s per enemy).

keys: 「画地为牢」使「全力以赴」命中的敌人定身；「围炉」使「儿时的舞乐」生效后的狐火灼伤敌人
en: 'Binding Circle' Binds enemies hit by 'I'll Do My Best'; 'Hearth' causes foxfires to burn enemies after 'Childhood Frolic' activates.

keys: 「全力以赴」出手时，自身周围半径 {$aura*$seal2_r_mult:0} 内的敌人定身 {$seal2_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 免疫定身）并减速 {$seal2_slow} 秒
en: When casting 'I'll Do My Best', enemies within a radius of {$aura*$seal2_r_mult:0} around herself are Bound for {$seal2_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses immune to Bind) and Slowed for {$seal2_slow}s.
