keys: 「儿时的舞乐」生效后，每 {$hearth2_every} 秒以自身为中心半径 {$aura*$hearth2_r_mult:0} 爆发一次狐火（{$hearth2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 伤害，命中减速 {$hearth2_slow} 秒）
en: After 'Childhood Frolic' activates, foxfire erupts within a radius of {$aura*$hearth2_r_mult:0} around herself every {$hearth2_every}s ({$hearth2_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% damage, Slows for {$hearth2_slow}s upon hit).

keys: 解锁三技能「狐火渺然」：展开 {$s3_dur} 秒大光域（范围 ×2.2），光域内敌人减速、受到的伤害 +10%，其他干员攻击 +{$s3_buff*$k_pow*100:1}%，队长每秒回复 0.8% 最大生命；期间铃兰不再普攻；普通攻击强化「九尾祈愿」：身后浮现九尾虚影，每一次普攻都三火归一；大狐火飞过的路径留下狐火 {$trail_life} 秒，每 {$trail_every} 秒灼伤踏入的敌人（狐火 {$trail_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Foxfire Haze': Expands a large Foxfire Field for {$s3_dur}s (AoE ×2.2), enemies within the Foxfire Field are Slowed and take +10% damage, other Operators' ATK +{$s3_buff*$k_pow*100:1}%, Leader recovers 0.8% Max HP per second; Suzuran stops attacking during this time; Normal attacks are enhanced to 'Nine-Tailed Prayer': A nine-tailed phantom appears behind her, and every normal attack becomes Three Fires as One; the path of the large Foxfire leaves behind Foxfire for {$trail_life}s, burning enemies that step into it every {$trail_every}s (Foxfire deals {$trail_mult*100}% damage).

keys: 身后浮现九尾虚影，每一次普攻都三团狐火合成一团大狐火贯穿；大狐火飞过的路径留下狐火 {$trail_life} 秒，每 {$trail_every} 秒灼伤踏入的敌人（狐火 {$trail_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: A nine-tailed phantom appears behind her, and every attack merges three foxfires into a large piercing foxfire; the path of the large foxfire leaves behind foxfires for {$trail_life}s, burning enemies who step into them every {$trail_every}s ({$trail_mult*100}% foxfire damage).

keys: 队长每次开技能，她的光域闪一下：光域内的敌人受到少量狐火伤害并减速 2 秒，其他干员技力 +1 秒
en: Every time the Leader activates a skill, her Foxfire Field flashes: enemies within the Foxfire Field take a small amount of foxfire damage and are Slowed for 2s, and SP of other Operators +1s.

keys: 辅助干员，操控狐火与光域。光域减速敌人，狐火追踪命中；技能为全队提升攻击力
en: Supporter Operator, manipulates foxfires and Foxfire Fields. Foxfire Fields Slow enemies, and foxfires track and hit targets; skills increase ATK for the entire squad.

keys: 罗德岛干员铃兰，九倍的温柔与坚强。她是罗德岛的光
en: Suzuran, Rhodes Island Operator, has nine times the strength, and the fluffiness. She is the light of Rhodes Island.

keys: 儿时的舞乐：光域永久扩大
en: Childhood Frolic: Foxfire Field permanently expanded

keys: 原地一刀「拔刀」：每 {$cd} 秒朝最近敌人挥出宽扇形斩（半径 {$slash_r}，物理，{$slash_mult*100}%），命中里离她最近的 {$block_n} 名敌人被「阻挡」，原地定住 {$block_dur} 秒（精英减半，Boss 免疫）；每第 {$storm_every} 次出手改为「骤雨」：{$storm_gap*3} 秒内原地 360° 连斩 4 下（半径 {$storm_r}，每下 {$storm_mult*100}%），没有敌人时照常拔刀；每次出手为全队（不含自身）技力 +{$hit_sp} 秒
en: Stationary slash 'Sword Draw': Every {$cd}s, slashes in a wide fan shape toward the nearest enemy (radius {$slash_r}, Physical damage, {$slash_mult*100}%). Blocks the {$block_n} hit enemies closest to her and immobilizes them for {$block_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses immune). Every {$storm_every} attacks, changes to 'Sudden Storm': Slashes 4 times in a 360° area around herself over {$storm_gap*3}s (radius {$storm_r}, {$storm_mult*100}% each). If no enemies are present, performs Sword Draw as usual. Each attack grants +{$hit_sp}s SP to all squad members (excluding herself).

keys: 以自身为中心半径 {$s1_r} 落下剑雨，×{$s1_mult} 并眩晕 {$s1_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外），全队（不含自身）技力 +{$s1_sp*100}%（自动释放需要射程内有敌人，否则技力保留到有敌人再放）
en: Drops a sword rain within a radius of {$s1_r} around herself, dealing ×{$s1_mult} damage and Stunning for {$s1_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted). Grants +{$s1_sp*100}% SP to all squad members (excluding herself). (Auto-cast requires enemies in range; otherwise, SP is retained until enemies appear.)

keys: 充能一次后永久生效：冲刺距离 +{$s2_len*100}%、伤害 ×{$s2_mult}（本作改写：原作为立即获得部署费用）
en: Activates permanently after 1 charge: Dash distance +{$s2_len*100}%, damage ×{$s2_mult}. (Fan game modification: Original effect immediately grants Deployment Points.)

keys: {$s3_dur} 秒内普攻换成「次元斩」：出手时她从原地隐去，追着附近的敌人连续闪现 {$rift_n} 次，每次贯穿一刀（路径上的敌人 ×{$rift_mult}，眩晕 {$rift_stun} 秒，精英减半，Boss 除外），刀痕细长笔直、留下约 {$rift_scar} 秒后碎成光屑；斩完回到原位（自动释放需要附近有敌人）
en: For {$s3_dur}s, normal attacks change to 'Dimensional Slash': On attack, she disappears from her position and blinks {$rift_n} times to pursue nearby enemies, piercing through with a slash each time (enemies along the path take ×{$rift_mult} damage and are Stunned for {$rift_stun}s, halved on Elites, Bosses excepted). The slash marks are thin and straight, remaining for about {$rift_scar}s before shattering into light particles. Returns to her original position after slashing. (Auto-cast requires nearby enemies.)

keys: 队长每次冲刺，她沿同一方向冲刺一次（她当队长时，冲刺路径上的敌人一同被斩）；穿过敌人时全队（不含自身）技力 +{$talent_sp} 秒；一次冲刺穿过 {$talent_many} 名以上敌人时额外 +{$talent_many_sp} 秒；拔刀每次出手再为全队（不含自身）技力 +{$talent_atk_sp} 秒
en: Whenever the Leader dashes, she dashes once in the same direction (when she is the Leader, enemies along the dash path are slashed). Passing through enemies grants +{$talent_sp}s SP to all squad members (excluding herself); passing through {$talent_many} or more enemies in one dash grants an additional +{$talent_many_sp}s SP. Each Sword Draw attack grants an additional +{$talent_atk_sp}s SP to all squad members (excluding herself).

keys: 拔刀每命中一名敌人，队长的冲刺冷却缩短 {$iai_cut} 秒（每次拔刀至多 {$iai_max} 秒）；一次拔刀命中 {$iai_gold_n} 名及以上时，队长下一次冲刺带金色残影；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_wide}
en: For every enemy hit by Sword Draw, Leader's dash cooldown is reduced by {$iai_cut}s (up to {$iai_max}s per Sword Draw); when a single Sword Draw hits {$iai_gold_n} or more enemies, Leader's next dash leaves a golden afterimage; damage ×{$grow_dmg_wide}.

keys: 拔刀命中正在前摇出招的敌人时，打断其出招并击退 {$flaw_kb}（精英、Boss 除外）；伤害 ×{$grow_dmg_sharp}
en: When Sword Draw hits an enemy winding up an attack, interrupts their attack and causes knockback of {$flaw_kb} (Elites, Bosses excepted); damage ×{$grow_dmg_sharp}.

keys: 解锁二技能「冲锋号令·γ型」；解锁天赋「战术快递」：队长每次冲刺，她同向冲刺一次；穿过敌人时为全队回技力，拔刀每次出手再回一点；普通攻击强化「钉剑」：被阻挡的敌人各插一柄源石剑，定住时间延长到 {$pin_dur} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Charge γ'. Unlocks Talent 'Tactical Delivery': Whenever the Leader dashes, she dashes once in the same direction; passing through enemies restores SP to all squad members, and each Sword Draw attack restores a small amount of SP. Basic attack upgraded to 'Pinning Sword': Enemies Blocked are each pierced by an Originium sword, extending the immobilization time to {$pin_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).

keys: 被拔刀阻挡的敌人各插一柄源石剑，定住时间延长到 {$pin_dur} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Enemies Blocked by Sword Draw are each pierced by an Originium sword, extending the immobilization time to {$pin_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).

keys: 拔刀后 {$back_delay} 秒，身后再斩一圈（{$back_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: {$back_delay}s after Sword Draw, slashes once more in a circle behind herself ({$back_mult*100}% damage).

keys: 「剑雨」{$rain2_delay} 秒后在她脚下再落一次（{$rain2_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: 'Sword Rain' drops a second time at her feet after {$rain2_delay}s ({$rain2_mult*100}% damage).

keys: 「回马剑」在拔刀后追加身后一圈斩；「剑雨·连」使「剑雨」追加一次攻击
en: 'Turnback Blade' adds a circular slash behind herself after Sword Draw; 'Sword Rain: Chain' adds an additional attack to 'Sword Rain'.

keys: 「回马剑」命中敌人时，全队技能（包括自身）的技力各 +{$back2_sp} 秒；命中 {$talent_many} 名及以上时再 +{$back2_many_sp} 秒
en: When 'Turnback Blade' hits an enemy, grants +{$back2_sp}s SP to all squad members' skills (including herself); hitting {$talent_many} or more enemies grants an additional +{$back2_many_sp}s SP.
'Sword Rain' drops a third wave ({$rain3_echo*100}% damage).

keys: 解锁三技能「剑雨滂沱」；普通攻击强化「余像」：骤雨出手时前方留下 {$trail_life} 秒剑气残像，踩进的敌人受 {$trail_mult*100}% 伤害并减速；残像消散时沿路径每 {$rain_step} 落下一柄剑（{$rain_mult*100}% 伤害，眩晕 {$rain_stun} 秒，精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Torrential Sword Rain'. Normal attack upgraded to 'Afterimage': Sudden Storm leaves a sword aura afterimage in front for {$trail_life}s. Enemies stepping into it take {$trail_mult*100}% damage and are Slowed. When the afterimage dissipates, drops a sword every {$rain_step} along the path ({$rain_mult*100}% damage, Stun for {$rain_stun}s, halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).

keys: 骤雨出手时前方留下 {$trail_life} 秒剑气残像（{$trail_mult*100}% 伤害并减速）；残像消散时沿路径每 {$rain_step} 落下一柄源石剑：{$rain_mult*100}% 伤害，眩晕 {$rain_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Sudden Storm leaves a sword aura afterimage in front for {$trail_life}s ({$trail_mult*100}% damage and Slow). When the afterimage dissipates, drops an Originium sword every {$rain_step} along the path: {$rain_mult*100}% damage, Stun for {$rain_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).

keys: 先锋干员，原地拔刀阻挡身前最近的两名敌人，被围时以骤雨一圈清场，并为全队回复技力。晋升至精英一后，随队长同向冲刺。当队长时冲刺自带 2 次充能，每次距离略短
en: Vanguard Operator. Performs a stationary Sword Draw to Block the two nearest enemies in front of her. When surrounded, clears the area with a circular Sudden Storm, and restores SP to all squad members. After promotion to Elite 1, dashes in the same direction as the Leader. When she is the Leader, her dash has 2 charges, with a slightly shorter distance each time.

keys: 企鹅物流员工，虽然平时沉默寡言，但战斗风格却可以用“暴风骤雨”来形容。
en: Penguin Logistics employee. Usually a woman of few words, but her fighting style is best described as a 'torrential storm'.

keys: 她当队长时，自己按冲刺，路径上的敌人受到冲刺斩伤害（精零起）；精英一起改为「同向疾行」：队长每次冲刺她同向冲刺，穿过的敌人受到伤害并为全队回复技力；队友时只在精英一起跟队长冲刺
en: When she is Leader, her dash deals Dash Slash damage to enemies along the path (from Elite 0); from Elite 1, changes to 'Parallel Sprint': whenever the Leader dashes, she dashes in the same direction, dealing damage to enemies passed through and restoring SP to the squad. As a squad member, she only dashes with the Leader from Elite 1.

keys: 每 {$cd} 秒抡锚砸向身前，对半径 {$reach} 内的全部敌人造成 {$slam_mult*100}% 伤害；砸地同时撼地，周围 {$quake_r} 内的敌人受到 {$quake_mult*100}% 伤害并被震退（近卫·撼地者特性）
en: Swings anchor forward every {$cd}s, dealing {$slam_mult*100}% damage to all enemies within a radius of {$reach}; striking the ground causes an earthshake, dealing {$quake_mult*100}% damage and knockback to enemies within {$quake_r} (Guard - Earthshaker Trait).

keys: 向最近的精英（没有则敌群最密处）掷出带锁链的锚，钩住至多 {$s1_pull_n} 名敌人拽到面前打断其动作、眩晕 {$hook_stun} 秒后再沉默 {$hook_silence} 秒（精英 {$hook_silence_elite} 秒；沉默期间不能使用特殊招式与远程攻击、不会自爆），随即重砸身前 {$s1_r} 内 ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2} 伤害（钩中的精英额外 +{$s1_elite_mult*100-100}%）；钩不到人或钩住 Boss 时，锚直接砸在落点
en: Throws a chained anchor at the nearest Elite (or the densest enemy cluster if none), hooking up to {$s1_pull_n} enemies and dragging them to himself, interrupting them, Stunning them for {$hook_stun}s, then Silencing them for {$hook_silence}s ({$hook_silence_elite}s on Elites; Silenced enemies cannot use special moves or ranged attacks, and will not self-destruct). Immediately smashes the area within {$s1_r} in front of himself, dealing ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2} damage (+{$s1_elite_mult*100-100}% to hooked Elites). If no enemies are hooked or a Boss is hooked, the anchor smashes the target location directly.

keys: 充能一次后永久生效：攻击 +{$s2_atk*100}%、锚击半径 {$reach} → {$reach_skill*$s2_reach:0}，天赋层数上限 {$stack_cap} → {$stack_cap+$stack_cap_s2}
en: Activates after 1 charge and remains active for the rest of the battle: ATK +{$s2_atk*100}%, Anchor Strike radius {$reach} -> {$reach_skill*$s2_reach:0}, Talent stack limit {$stack_cap} -> {$stack_cap+$stack_cap_s2}.

keys: 向落点打出一头虎鲸：虎鲸破水直冲，沿途宽 {$s3_orca_w} 内的敌人各受一次 ×{$s3_path_mult*$k_pow:2} 伤害；到落点跃起砸下，半径 {$s3_orca_r} 内 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2} 伤害、击退并眩晕 {$s3_stun} 秒（精英减半、Boss {$s3_stun*$s3_stun_boss:1} 秒）；之后 {$s3_haste} 秒锚击间隔 -{(1-$haste_mult)*100}%。自动瞄准敌群最密处
en: Launches an orca at the target location: the orca charges forward, dealing ×{$s3_path_mult*$k_pow:2} damage to enemies within a width of {$s3_orca_w} along the path; upon reaching the target location, it leaps and crashes down, dealing ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2} damage, knockback, and Stun for {$s3_stun}s to enemies within a radius of {$s3_orca_r} (halved on Elites, {$s3_stun*$s3_stun_boss:1}s on Bosses); Anchor Strike interval -{(1-$haste_mult)*100}% for {$s3_haste}s afterwards. Automatically targets the densest cluster of enemies.

keys: 击杀精英 +1 层、Boss +{$stack_boss} 层，每层攻击 +{$stack_atk*100}%（上限 {$stack_cap} 层）；编队里其他深海猎人获得一半
en: Defeating an Elite grants 1 stack, defeating a Boss grants {$stack_boss} stacks. Each stack grants ATK +{$stack_atk*100}% (stacks up to {$stack_cap} times); other Abyssal Hunter operators in the squad gain half of this effect.

keys: 每次锚击 {$blast2_delay} 秒后同一落点再炸出第二道冲击环（半径 {$blast2_r}、锚击 {$blast2_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: {$blast2_delay}s after each Anchor Strike, a second shockwave erupts at the same location (radius {$blast2_r}, {$blast2_mult*100}% Anchor Strike damage).

keys: 每第 3 次锚击，抡着锁链甩一整圈（半径 {$whirl_r}、锚击 {$whirl_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: Every 3rd Anchor Strike swings the chain in a full circle (radius {$whirl_r}, {$whirl_mult*100}% Anchor Strike damage).

keys: 解锁二技能「必须维系的界限」；解锁天赋「血脉的哺养」：击杀精英叠攻击，其他深海猎人得一半；普攻「收链」：锚击把落点外圈 {$reach*$pull_r:0}（「必须维系的界限」生效后 {$reach_skill*$s2_reach*$pull_r:0}）内的敌人拉向落点 {$pull_dist}（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Boundaries Must Be Kept'; unlocks Talent 'Nourish the Blood': defeating Elites stacks ATK, other Abyssal Hunter operators gain half the effect. Normal attack 'Retract Chain': Anchor Strike pulls enemies in the outer ring within {$reach*$pull_r:0} (within {$reach_skill*$s2_reach*$pull_r:0} after 'Boundaries Must Be Kept' activates) of the target location toward the center by {$pull_dist} (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).

keys: 锚击落点外圈（锚击范围之外、{$reach*$pull_r:0} 以内，「必须维系的界限」生效后 {$reach_skill*$s2_reach*$pull_r:0} 以内）的敌人被拉向落点 {$pull_dist}（精英减半，Boss 除外）
en: Enemies in the outer ring of the Anchor Strike target location (outside the Anchor Strike range, within {$reach*$pull_r:0}, or within {$reach_skill*$s2_reach*$pull_r:0} after 'Boundaries Must Be Kept' activates) are pulled toward the center by {$pull_dist} (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).

keys: 「必须促成的接触」钩回的敌人被锁链拴在他身边 {$chain_dur} 秒，离他不能超过 {$chain_r}（精英时长减半，Boss 除外）
en: Enemies hooked by 'Contact Must Be Made' are tethered to him by chains for {$chain_dur}s, unable to move further than {$chain_r} from him (duration halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).

keys: 「必须促成的接触」锁链绷直时，从乌尔比安到锚点裂开一道通路，沿途敌人被掀飞 {$rift_air} 秒并受到锚击 {$rift_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% 伤害；精英二后「必须开辟的通路」掷锚时同样开路
en: When the chain of 'Contact Must Be Made' goes taut, a path splits open from Ulpianus to the anchor point. Enemies along the path are Levitated for {$rift_air}s and take {$rift_mult*$k_pow*100:1}% Anchor Strike damage. After Elite 2, throwing the anchor in 'Paths Must Be Opened' also opens a path.

keys: 「不容挣脱」把钩回的敌人拴在身边；「通路洞开」沿锁链攻击并浮空敌人
en: 'No Escape' tethers hooked enemies to himself; 'Path Opened' attacks along the chain and Levitates enemies.

keys: 「必须促成的接触」钩回的敌人砸到面前后约 {$drag2_delay} 秒，他身前再抡一锤：半径 {$reach_skill*$drag2_r_k:0} 内锚击 {$drag2_mult*100}% 伤害并击退
en: Approx. {$drag2_delay}s after enemies hooked by 'Contact Must Be Made' are smashed in front of him, he swings another heavy strike in front of himself: deals {$drag2_mult*100}% Anchor Strike damage and knockback within a radius of {$reach_skill*$drag2_r_k:0}.

keys: 被「通路洞开」掀飞的敌人落地时，各自炸出一圈小冲击（半径 {$after_r}，锚击 {$after_mult*100}% 伤害），落点连成一串
en: When enemies Levitated by 'Path Opened' land, they each erupt with a small shockwave (radius {$after_r}, {$after_mult*100}% Anchor Strike damage), chaining the landing points together.

keys: 解锁三技能「必须开辟的通路」：掷锚冲锋，沿途与落点都造成伤害、落点眩晕一片，之后 {$s3_haste} 秒锚击加速；撼地范围扩大到 {$quake_r_e2}、伤害提高到 {$quake_mult_e2*100}%；普通攻击强化「掷锚」：每第 {$throw_n} 次锚击改为把锚掷向 {$throw_min} 外最远的敌人（没有就掷向最近的），落地造成锚击 ×{$throw_mult} 伤害，随后顺锁链把沿线敌人拖回面前，再造成 {$throw_back*100}% 伤害（拖动 Boss 除外）
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Paths Must Be Opened': throws the anchor and dashes, dealing damage along the path and at the target location, Stunning enemies at the target location, then accelerating Anchor Strike for {$s3_haste}s. Earthshake range expands to {$quake_r_e2}, damage increases to {$quake_mult_e2*100}%. Normal attack enhanced to 'Cast Anchor': every {$throw_n}th Anchor Strike instead throws the anchor at the furthest enemy beyond {$throw_min} (or the nearest if none), dealing ×{$throw_mult} Anchor Strike damage upon landing, then dragging enemies along the chain back to himself, dealing an additional {$throw_back*100}% damage (dragging Bosses excepted).

keys: 每第 {$throw_n} 次锚击改为把锚掷向 {$throw_min} 外最远的敌人（没有就掷向最近的）：落地半径 {$throw_r} 造成锚击 ×{$throw_mult} 伤害，锁链绷直后把乌尔比安与锚之间宽 {$throw_w} 的一线敌人拖回面前，再造成 {$throw_back*100}% 伤害（拖动 Boss 除外）。锚在外面时不出锚击
en: Every {$throw_n}th anchor strike throws the anchor at the furthest enemy beyond {$throw_min} (or the closest if none): deals anchor strike damage ×{$throw_mult} in a radius of {$throw_r} upon landing. When the chain tightens, drags enemies in a line of width {$throw_w} between Ulpianus and the anchor to himself, dealing {$throw_back*100}% damage (dragging Bosses excepted). Cannot perform anchor strikes while the anchor is out.

keys: 近卫干员，抡锚砸向身前一片敌人、撼地震退周围敌人，掷锚把精英拖到面前；深海猎人成员；每击杀一名精英攻击 +{$stack_atk*100}%（最多 {$stack_cap} 层）
en: Guard Operator. Swings his anchor to smash enemies in front, shakes the earth to knock back surrounding enemies, and throws his anchor to drag Elites to himself. Abyssal Hunter member. ATK +{$stack_atk*100}% for each Elite killed (stacks up to {$stack_cap} times).

keys: 阿戈尔军事团体“深海猎人”作战指挥官之一。他独行，一如他刚成为深海猎人时那样。
en: One of the field commanders of the Ægir military group, the Abyssal Hunters. He walks alone, just as when he first became an Abyssal Hunter.

keys: 必须维系的界限：攻击与范围永久提升
en: Boundaries Must Be Kept — ATK and range permanently increased

keys: 歌蕾蒂娅的钩索把敌人拖回到位时，乌尔比安在 {$combo_range} 内就朝落点补一次锚击（{$combo_mult*100}% 伤害，每 {$combo_cd} 秒至多一次，不占普攻冷却）
en: When Gladiia's hook drags an enemy into position, if Ulpianus is within {$combo_range}, he performs an additional anchor strike at the landing point (deals {$combo_mult*100}% damage, at most once every {$combo_cd}s, does not consume normal attack cooldown).

keys: 队长每次冲刺结束，他把锚掷向队长的落点，砸中周围的敌人，再把锁链沿线的敌人拖回自己身前，打断并眩晕 {$hook_stun} 秒、再沉默 {$hook_silence} 秒（精英 {$hook_silence_elite} 秒）；锚链掷出后 1.5 秒内的锚击伤害 +30%
en: After the Leader finishes a dash, he throws his anchor at the Leader's landing point, smashing surrounding enemies, then drags enemies along the chain to himself, interrupting and Stunning them for {$hook_stun}s, then Silencing them for {$hook_silence}s ({$hook_silence_elite}s on Elites). Anchor strike damage +30% within 1.5s after throwing the anchor chain.

keys: 每 {$cd} 秒向离队长最近的敌人发射炮弹（最近几个距离相仿时挑敌人最密的落点）：落点半径 {$aoe} 爆炸（物理），0.45 秒后原地余震再炸一次（炮击 {$quake*100}% 伤害）
en: Fires a shell at the enemy closest to the Leader every {$cd}s (if distances are similar, targets the densest enemy cluster): explodes in a radius of {$aoe} upon landing (Physical damage), and after 0.45s, an aftershock explodes at the same spot (deals {$quake*100}% of Bombardment damage).

keys: 接下来 3 发炮击伤害 ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2}、爆炸范围 ×{$s1_size}，落点必定余震
en: The next 3 Bombardments deal damage ×{$s1_mult*$k_pow:2}, have explosion radius ×{$s1_size}, and guarantee an aftershock at the landing point.

keys: 持续 {$s2_dur} 秒，炮击伤害 ×{$s2_mult*$k_pow:2}、爆炸范围 ×{$s2_size}、攻击间隔 ×{$s2_interval}，爆炸范围内的敌人均受到伤害；后半段改为随机索敌的 {$s2_burst} 连发，每发伤害为强化炮击的 {$s2_over_mult*100}%，保留余震
en: Lasts for {$s2_dur}s. Bombardment damage ×{$s2_mult*$k_pow:2}, explosion radius ×{$s2_size}, attack interval ×{$s2_interval}, and all enemies within the explosion radius take damage. The second half changes to a {$s2_burst}-shot burst with random targeting, each shot dealing {$s2_over_mult*100}% of the enhanced Bombardment damage and retaining aftershocks.

keys: 装填 {$s3_ammo} 发巨型炮弹，之后的炮击换成高速巨炮（伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}、爆炸范围 ×{$s3_size}、必定余震，射击间隔 ×{$s3_cd}），打完 {$s3_ammo} 发为止
en: Loads {$s3_ammo} giant shells. Subsequent Bombardments are replaced with high-speed giant shells (damage ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}, explosion radius ×{$s3_size}, guaranteed aftershock, attack interval ×{$s3_cd}) until all {$s3_ammo} shells are fired.

keys: 被炮击或余震击杀的敌人留下残影，0.25 秒后爆炸（{$shade*100}% 伤害）并眩晕 0.6 秒；炮击爆炸范围 +15%，余震伤害 {$quake*100}% → {$quake_e1*100}%
en: Enemies killed by Bombardment or aftershocks leave behind a Revenant Shadow that explodes after 0.25s (deals {$shade*100}% damage) and Stuns for 0.6s. Bombardment explosion radius +15%, aftershock damage {$quake*100}% -> {$quake_e1*100}%.

keys: 每发炮击的余震再来一次：第一次余震后 {$quake2_delay} 秒，同一处再震一次（范围 ×{$quake2_size}）
en: The aftershock of each Bombardment triggers an additional time: {$quake2_delay}s after the first aftershock, another aftershock occurs at the same spot (radius ×{$quake2_size}).

keys: 每次炮击同时向第二个目标再打一发炮弹（{$twin_mult*100}% 伤害，同样余震）
en: Each Bombardment simultaneously fires an additional shell at a second target (deals {$twin_mult*100}% damage, with the same aftershock).

keys: 解锁二技能「饱和复仇」；解锁天赋「好礼」：被炮击或余震击杀的敌人留下残影，0.25 秒后爆炸（{$shade*100}% 伤害）并眩晕 0.6 秒；炮击爆炸范围 +15%，余震伤害 {$quake*100}% → {$quake_e1*100}%；普攻「好礼」：炮击的主目标挂上残影标记 {$mark_dur} 秒，标记期间倒下必定引爆残影
en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Saturated Vengeance'. Unlocks Talent 'Souvenir': Enemies killed by Bombardment or aftershocks leave behind a Revenant Shadow that explodes after 0.25s (deals {$shade*100}% damage) and Stuns for 0.6s; Bombardment explosion radius +15%, aftershock damage {$quake*100}% -> {$quake_e1*100}%. Normal attack 'Souvenir': The main target of Bombardment is marked with a Revenant mark for {$mark_dur}s; falling while marked guarantees a Revenant Shadow detonation.

keys: 炮击的主目标直接挂上残影标记 {$mark_dur} 秒，标记期间倒下必定引爆残影（{$gift_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: The main target of Bombardment is marked with a Revenant mark for {$mark_dur}s; falling while marked guarantees a Revenant Shadow detonation (deals {$gift_mult*100}% damage).

keys: 「定点清算」强化的 3 发炮击，余震变为 3 圈并眩晕 {$ash_stun} 秒（精英减半，Boss 免疫）
en: The 3 Bombardments enhanced by 'Localized Liquidation' have their aftershocks changed to 3 rings and Stun for {$ash_stun}s (halved on Elites, Bosses immune).

keys: 炮击与余震波及的敌人中，生命低于 {$mark_low*100}% 的直接挂上残影标记（{$mark_dur} 秒）：被标记的敌人死亡时必定引爆残影（{$mark_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: Enemies caught in the blast and aftershocks with less than {$mark_low*100}% HP are marked with a Revenant mark for {$mark_dur}s. When a marked enemy is defeated, a Revenant Shadow detonates, dealing {$mark_mult*100}% damage.

keys: 「余烬未冷」使「定点清算」的余震增加至三圈并附加眩晕；「亡者回响」使炮击与余震波及的残血敌人获得残影标记
en: 'Still-Warm Embers' increases the aftershocks of 'Localized Liquidation' to three rings and inflicts Stun; 'Echo of the Dead' marks low HP enemies caught in the blast and aftershocks with a Revenant mark.

keys: 「定点清算」强化的 3 发炮击：击杀处的残影立即引爆（不等 0.25 秒）；下一发炮击的落点吸向 {$ash2_snap_r} 内最近的残影或标记
en: The 3 Bombardments enhanced by 'Localized Liquidation': Revenant Shadows at the location of defeated enemies detonate immediately (no 0.25s delay); the next Bombardment targets the nearest Revenant Shadow or mark within {$ash2_snap_r}.

keys: 一次残影引爆杀死 {$fb_kills} 名以上敌人时，全队技能（包括自身）的技力各 +{$fb_sp} 秒，每 {$fb_cd} 秒至多一次
en: When a Revenant Shadow detonation defeats {$fb_kills} or more enemies, grants +{$fb_sp} SP to all squad members (including herself). Can trigger at most once every {$fb_cd}s.

keys: 解锁三技能「爆裂黎明」：装填 {$s3_ammo} 发巨型炮弹，之后的炮击换成高速巨炮（伤害 ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}、爆炸范围 ×{$s3_size}、必定余震，射击间隔 ×{$s3_cd}），打完 {$s3_ammo} 发为止；普通攻击强化「死魂灵的余息」：2 个魂灵之影悬在维什戴尔身侧，每发炮击时各自朝目标附近的敌人开一炮（{$soul_fire_mult*100}% 伤害，同样余震），命中的敌人挂上残影标记 {$mark_dur} 秒
en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Explosive Dawn': Loads {$s3_ammo} giant shells. Subsequent Bombardments are replaced with high-speed giant shells (damage ×{$s3_mult*$k_pow:2}, explosion radius ×{$s3_size}, guaranteed aftershock, attack interval ×{$s3_cd}) until all {$s3_ammo} shells are fired; Normal attacks are enhanced by 'Revenant's Echo': 2 Revenant Shadows hover beside Wiš'adel, each firing a shot at enemies near the target during every Bombardment (deals {$soul_fire_mult*100}% damage, with the same aftershock), marking hit enemies with a Revenant mark for {$mark_dur}s.

keys: 2 个魂灵之影悬在身侧，每发炮击时各自朝目标附近的敌人开一炮（炮击 {$soul_fire_mult*100}% 伤害，同样余震），优先打没有标记的敌人；命中的敌人挂上残影标记 {$mark_dur} 秒，标记期间倒下必定引爆残影（{$mark_mult*100}% 伤害）
en: 2 Revenant Shadows hover beside her, each firing a shot at enemies near the target during every Bombardment (deals {$soul_fire_mult*100}% of Bombardment damage, with the same aftershock), prioritizing unmarked enemies. Hit enemies are marked with a Revenant mark for {$mark_dur}s; if defeated while marked, a Revenant Shadow detonates, dealing {$mark_mult*100}% damage.

keys: 狙击干员，巫术增幅单元开炮，命中后原地余震并留下残影诱爆：一发炮弹能在敌群里连炸三次
en: Sniper Operator. Fires with an Arts amplification unit, causing aftershocks on hit and leaving a Revenant Shadow that detonates: a single shell can explode three times in a group of enemies.

keys: 我的天哪维什戴尔大人
队长站定不动时，她架稳炮位，攻击间隔缩短约 15%；队长移动就收炮
en: When the Leader stands still, she sets up her cannon, reducing attack interval by approx. 15%; packs up when the Leader moves.

keys: 由队长释放：能量满后按 Q
en: Released by the Leader: Press Q when energy is full.

keys: 由队长释放：能量满后点终结技键
en: Released by the Leader: Tap the Ultimate button when energy is full.

keys: 在队时满足条件即亮起，自动出手
en: When in squad, lights up and triggers automatically when conditions are met.

keys: 在队时满足条件即自动出手
en: When in squad, triggers automatically when conditions are met.

keys: 队长放技能时自动出手（全队每 {gap} 秒最多一次；附近没有敌人时不出手，也不计间隔）。随行时掩护类优先，突击时追击类优先，部署时聚拢类优先；残血撤回中的干员不出手
en: Triggers automatically when the Leader uses a skill (at most once every {gap}s for the squad; does not trigger or count interval if no enemies are nearby). Follow prioritizes Cover, Assault prioritizes Pursuit, Deployment prioritizes Gather; Operators retreating with low HP will not trigger.

keys: 由队长释放：能量满后按住 Q 看范围（落点 / 方向类跟鼠标选），松开释放；轻点 Q 保持，再按一次 Q 或点左键释放
en: Released by the Leader: Hold Q when energy is full to view range (target/direction follows mouse), release to cast; tap Q to hold, press Q again or left-click to cast.

keys: 由队长释放：能量满后按住终结技键看范围（落点 / 方向类拖动选），松手释放
en: Released by the Leader: Hold the Ultimate button when energy is full to view range (drag to select target/direction), release to cast.

keys: 冲进落点一圈内接连斩出刀痕，同时斩开，隔半拍换个角度再斩一次，收刀回到原位
en: Dashes into the target area and releases consecutive slashes, slashing outward simultaneously, then slashes again from a different angle after a short pause, before returning to her original position.

keys: 沿队长冲刺的方向冲刺斩，路径上的敌人都挨一刀，前两名被阻挡
en: Dashes and slashes in the direction of the Leader's dash. Enemies along the path take a slash, and the first two are blocked.

keys: 瞬身穿过连携区域的主目标（精英优先），停在它身后；路径上的敌人受到伤害并眩晕 0.5 秒（精英减半）
en: Instantly passes through the main target in the Link area (prioritizes Elites) and stops behind it; enemies along the path take damage and are Stunned for 0.5s (halved on Elites).

keys: 自动锁定周围敌人，转瞬之间连续倾泻爆裂弹
en: Automatically locks onto surrounding enemies, rapidly unloading a continuous barrage of explosive rounds.

keys: 朝队长身后最近的敌群扫射一轮
en: Fires a volley at the closest enemy group behind the Leader.

keys: 原地朝区域打出 8 发穿透曳光，每发穿过区域后再飞 250
en: Fires 8 piercing tracers toward the area from her current position. Each tracer flies an additional 250 distance after passing through the area.

keys: 海嗣张口聚光，粗吐息追着敌群烧过去、沿途接连爆炸，收尾一次大爆并留下领域
en: The Seaborn gathers light in its mouth, releasing a torrent of breath that tracks and burns enemy groups, causing continuous explosions along the path. Ends with a large explosion, leaving behind a domain.

keys: 声浪扫过敌群，之后 3 秒全队攻击速度提升
en: A sound wave sweeps through enemy groups, increasing the squad's ATK speed for 3s.

keys: 另一名队友的连携命中后
en: After another squad member's Link hits

keys: 歌声覆盖区域 3 秒；队长站在区域里时，全队伤害 +{$link_skalter_atk*100-100:0}%
en: Song covers the area for 3s; when the Leader stands in the area, squad damage +{$link_skalter_atk*100-100:0}%.

keys: Mon3tr 冲到落点，连续三圈熔毁爆发；8 秒后重构归队
en: Mon3tr dashes to the target location, releasing three consecutive meltdown explosions; reconstructs and returns to the squad after 8s.

keys: Mon3tr 扑击击退敌人，队长回复生命并清除神经损伤
en: Mon3tr pounces and deals knockback to enemies. The Leader recovers HP and clears Nervous Impairment.

keys: 队长生命低于 40%，或神经损伤达到 80%
en: Leader's HP below 40%, or Nervous Impairment at 80%

keys: Mon3tr 落到队长前方挡一次伤害（1.2 秒内）并推开身前的敌人，凯尔希为队长回复 {$link_kaltsit_heal*100:0}% 最大生命
en: Mon3tr lands in front of the Leader, blocking one instance of damage (within 1.2s) and pushing away enemies in front of it. Kal'tsit restores {$link_kaltsit_heal*100:0}% Max HP to the Leader.

keys: 掷出铁锚，沿锁链冲过去，落地后四圈裂地
en: Throws his anchor and dashes along the chain. Upon landing, releases four shockwaves.

keys: 砸下铁锚，击退并眩晕周围敌人
en: Smashes down his anchor, dealing knockback and Stun to surrounding enemies.

keys: 另一名队友的连携命中、附近敌人聚成一团时
en: Another squad member's Link hits and nearby enemies are bunched up

keys: 掷锚钉住区域主目标（精英优先）1.5 秒，附近 180 内的普通敌人被拖向它
en: Throws his anchor, pinning the main target in the area (prioritizes Elites) for 1.5s. Normal enemies within 180 range are dragged toward it.

keys: 大剑下劈，身前立起一堵巨浪往前滚压，浪头被一剑劈开、溅起水柱
en: Slashes downward with her greatsword, raising a giant wave in front of her that rolls forward. The wave is cleaved by the sword, splashing pillars of water.

keys: 跃到队长冲刺的落点，大剑横扫一周并击退
en: Leaps to the Leader's dash destination, sweeping the greatsword in a full circle and causing knockback.

keys: 拖着大剑冲过区域，身后留下一道水痕 1.5 秒，踩在水痕上的敌人每 0.5 秒受到一次伤害
en: Dashes through the area dragging the greatsword, leaving a water trail for 1.5s; enemies on the trail take damage every 0.5s.

keys: 掷出长枪，落点卷起海渊漩涡，把大范围的敌人拖向中心，收拢一砸，潮水再从中心爆开
en: Throws a spear, creating an abyssal vortex at the target location that drags enemies in a large area to the center. Crushes them together, then a tidal explosion bursts from the center.

keys: 甩出钩索，把远处的精英或远程敌人拖到身边
en: Throws a grappling hook, dragging distant Elite or ranged enemies to herself.

keys: 屏幕内远离队长处出现精英或远程敌人
en: An Elite or ranged enemy appears on screen far from the Leader

keys: 甩出钩索，把区域外 210 内最近的 6 名敌人拖进区域，眩晕 0.4 秒（精英减半）
en: Throws a grappling hook, dragging the 6 closest enemies within 210 outside the area into the area, and Stuns them for 0.4s (halved on Elites).

keys: 重力奇点把圈内敌人吸起悬空，停顿半拍后全部砸向地面
en: A gravity singularity pulls enemies within range into the air, Levitating them. Halts for half a beat, then smashes them all to the ground.

keys: 重力弹把周围敌人拉向目标，给出手的队友聚怪
en: A gravity projectile pulls surrounding enemies toward the target, gathering them for the attacking teammate.

keys: 另一名队友的连携亮起时（抢在它出手前）
en: Another squad member's Link lights up (acts before it does)

keys: 三枚碎片绕区域外圈往里收，把区域外 180 内的敌人带进区域并减速
en: Three fragments circle the area's outer edge and contract inward, pulling enemies within 180 outside the area into the area and Slowing them.

keys: 地面龟裂、火柱冲起，熔岩块落满一圈，中间留下熔岩地面
en: The ground cracks and fire pillars erupt. Lava blocks fall in a circle, leaving a lava floor in the center.

keys: 投出放大的熔岩弹，落点留下 2 秒熔岩
en: Throws an enlarged magma projectile, leaving a magma floor at the target location for 2s.

keys: 高抛一块熔岩砸进区域，落点溅出碎岩并点燃命中的敌人，之后再灼烧两次
en: Tosses a magma block high into the area. Splashes broken rocks at the target location, triggering Ignition on hit enemies, then burns them 2 more times.

keys: 架炮后仰，朝指定方向一排排炮击，每处炮击后还有余震
en: Sets up the cannon and leans back, firing rows of artillery in the designated direction. Each strike is followed by an aftershock.

keys: 朝敌群补一发炮击，随后余震
en: Fires an additional artillery strike at the enemy group, followed by an aftershock.

keys: 队长这次技能后 1 秒内在区域里被打死的敌人留下暗红残影，0.35 秒后炸开（半径 60）；没有敌人被打死时，在主目标处补一发
en: Enemies defeated in the area within 1s after the Leader's skill leave a dark red afterimage that explodes after 0.35s (radius 60); if no enemies are defeated, fires an additional strike at the main target.

keys: 巨锯放大、绕身旋转，跟着队长移动；放出后 3 秒内不会倒下，受到的伤害降低
en: The greatsaw enlarges and spins around her, moving with the Leader; for 3s after release, she will not fall and takes reduced damage.

keys: 替身连斩三下，之后 2 秒队长生命不会低于 1
en: The substitute slashes 3 times consecutively. For the next 2s, the Leader's HP cannot fall below 1.

keys: 队长一次受到最大生命 10% 以上的伤害
en: Leader takes over 10% Max HP in one hit

keys: 本人不动，分出一个暗红替身冲过区域斩一次
en: She remains stationary, sending a dark red substitute to dash through the area and slash once.

keys: 身后破土一条巨型触手，横扫指定方向的半圆，小触手再抓漏网之敌
en: A giant tentacle emerges from the ground behind him, sweeping a semicircle in the target direction. Smaller tentacles then grab any remaining enemies.

keys: 触手追击附近生命低于一半的敌人并束缚
en: Tentacles pursue nearby enemies with less than 50% HP and Bind them.

keys: 身边多名敌人生命低于一半
区域里 6 名敌人脚下钻出触手，束缚 1 秒（精英减半）
en: Tentacles emerge beneath 6 enemies in the area, Binding them for 1s (halved on Elites).

keys: 举拳蓄力一拳砸地，冲击环向四周打出，脚下裂纹沿途接连爆开
en: Readies a Charged punch and smashes the ground, releasing a shockwave ring in all directions as fissures erupt along the path.

keys: 琥珀晶柱围住队长挡 2 秒，队长回复生命
en: Amber crystal pillars surround and protect the Leader for 2s. The Leader recovers HP.

keys: 给队长一层护盾，挡一次伤害（1.5 秒内没用掉就收回）；区域地面钙化 1.5 秒，踩在上面的敌人减速 40%
en: Grants the Leader 1 Shield, blocking 1 instance of damage (retracted if unused within 1.5s). Calcifies the ground in the area for 1.5s, Slowing enemies on it by 40%.

keys: 忍冬在身旁现身，化作白光瞬身斩出，停顿半拍后斩痕爆裂
en: Honeysuckle appears beside her, transforming into a flash of white light to slash forward. Halts for a half-beat before the slash marks explode.

keys: 狐火追向那批敌人，减速并使其受到的伤害提升
en: Foxfire pursues those enemies, reducing their movement speed and increasing the damage they take.

keys: 4 团狐火绕她转一圈，再各追向区域内一名敌人，命中后减速 30%，持续 1.5 秒
en: 4 wisps of foxfire circle her once, then each pursues an enemy in the area. Upon impact, reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 1.5s.

keys: 面前展开圆形咒域，区域内敌人头顶慢慢浮现咒文，一词念出后咒印一起压缩爆开，并清除区域内弹幕
en: Expands a circular cursed domain in front of him. Incantations slowly appear above enemies in the area. Upon uttering a single word, the curse seals compress and explode simultaneously, clearing all enemy projectiles in the area.

keys: 咒文扩散，处决至多 6 名生命低于 30% 的普通敌人
en: Incantations spread, executing up to 6 normal enemies with less than 30% HP.

keys: 屏幕内多名普通敌人生命低于 30%
en: Several on-screen normal enemies below 30% HP

keys: 区域上空展开一圈咒文，当场消除区域内的敌方弹幕，区域内敌人减速 50%，持续 1 秒；不造成伤害
en: A ring of incantations expands above the area, instantly clearing enemy projectiles within. Reduces enemy movement speed in the area by 50% for 1s. Deals no damage.

keys: 盾「般若」砸地，嘲讽全场并把敌人吸到盾前，硬挡片刻后盾甲反震炸开
en: Smashes the shield 'Hannya' into the ground, Taunting all enemies and drawing them toward the shield. After blocking for a brief moment, the shield rebounds and explodes.

keys: 冲到队长身边举盾推开周围敌人，队长短时间受到的伤害降低
en: Dashes to the Leader, raises her shield to push away surrounding enemies, and reduces damage taken by the Leader for a short duration.

keys: 队长短时间内连续被近战命中，或被敌人围住
en: Leader is hit by melee several times in a row, or is surrounded

keys: 瞬到队长身侧举盾，挡一次伤害（1.5 秒内）；区域内的近战敌人被嘲讽 1 秒
en: Instantly moves to the Leader's side and raises her shield, blocking 1 instance of damage (within 1.5s); Taunts melee enemies in the area for 1s.

keys: 高高跃起，巨锤砸向落点，冲击波横扫、敌人被震上半空
en: Leaps high and smashes her giant hammer into the target location; a shockwave sweeps through, knocking enemies into the air.

keys: 跃向队长落点附近最密的敌群砸锤，眩晕敌人，其他干员技力回复加快
en: Leaps toward the densest cluster of enemies near the Leader's location and smashes her hammer, inflicting Stun; increases SP Recovery for other Operators.

keys: 从队长身边冲进区域，撞开沿途的敌人，到尽头一锤砸地，眩晕 0.5 秒（精英减半）
en: Charges into the area from the Leader's side, knocking away enemies along the path; smashes the ground with her hammer at the end, inflicting Stun for 0.5s (halved on Elites).

keys: 脚下盖下审判纹章，锁链钉住圈内敌人；原地旋身连斩三圈、朝四周连射，被钉住的敌人由近到远连环炸开
en: Stamps a judgment emblem on the ground, pinning enemies in range with chains; spins in place to slash three times and fires in all directions; pinned enemies explode sequentially from near to far.

keys: 连刺两下，对浮空、眩晕中的敌人伤害提升
en: Thrusts twice; deals increased damage to Levitating or Stunned enemies.

keys: 屏幕内多名敌人浮空或眩晕
en: Several on-screen enemies are Levitated or Stunned

keys: 提灯照亮区域，区域内敌人 3 秒内受到的伤害 +{$link_irene_amp*100:0}%，随后补一刺穿过主目标
en: Raises her lantern to make the area Illuminated; enemies in the area take +{$link_irene_amp*100:0}% damage for 3s, followed by a thrust piercing the main target.

keys: 朝前方扇形狂舞乱砍，剑气越砍越快越乱，最后一记横斩收尾，命中沉默
en: Slashes wildly in a frontal fan-shaped area, with sword aura becoming faster and more chaotic; finishes with a horizontal slash that inflicts Silence on hit.

keys: 横扫打断精英这次出招，2 秒内不能再放特殊招式
en: Sweeps to interrupt the Elite's current attack; prevents them from using special abilities for 2s.
An Elite starts winding up an attack

keys: 站到区域边缘，掷出一道月牙剑气横扫过区域，命中的敌人沉默 1 秒
en: Stands at the edge of the area and throws a crescent sword aura that sweeps across the area; inflicts Silence for 1s on enemies hit.

keys: 队长脚下升起灯塔光柱，光圈扩散灼烧，光束扫过周围一圈后熄灭
en: A lighthouse Lamp Pillar rises beneath the Leader, spreading a Beacon Ring that burns; the light beam sweeps the surrounding area once before extinguishing.

keys: 光弹清除队长的神经损伤，灯火回复，并照亮队长身边
en: A light projectile clears the Leader's Nervous Impairment, restores Light, and makes the area around the Leader Illuminated.

keys: 队长神经损伤达到 60%，或灯火暗淡
en: Leader's Nervous Impairment at 60%, or Light is Dim

keys: 队长灯火 +{$link_lumen_lamp:0}，清除神经损伤；区域里飘起灼烧光点 1.2 秒，每 0.3 秒对区域内敌人造成伤害
en: Leader's Light +{$link_lumen_lamp:0}, clears Nervous Impairment; burning light motes float in the area for 1.2s, dealing damage to enemies in the area every 0.3s.

keys:
「留舰观察对象水月，现阶段基本可确认潜在威胁性较低。」
幼时生活的东国海边村落毁于逃兵的劫掠，一位旅行的老者救下了他。后来在玻利瓦尔的多索雷斯接触罗德岛干员，随他们登舰；他学习能力较为优秀，经调查与评估后获准长期留舰。一段加密留言写明，他并非罗德岛干员，只能秘密地作为医疗部的合作观察对象存在。他能扰乱对手的视觉、听觉与触觉，甚至制造幻觉；现阶段推测这是某种生物性的手段，不是源石技艺。
en:
'Landship observation target Mizuki, latent threat principally confirmed low at the present stage.'
The seaside village in Higashi where he lived as a child was destroyed by pillaging deserters, and a traveling old man saved him. Later, he came into contact with Rhodes Island Operators in Dossoles, Bolívar, and boarded the ship with them. His learning ability was excellent, and after investigation and evaluation, he was approved to stay on the ship long-term. An encrypted message stated that he was not a Rhodes Island Operator, and could only exist secretly as a cooperative observation subject of the Medical Department. He could disrupt opponents' vision, hearing, and touch, and even create hallucinations; it was speculated that this was some kind of biological means, not Originium Arts.

keys: 罗德岛的狙击干员。习惯站在队伍后方，用精准的一枪解决最危险的目标。
en: A Rhodes Island Sniper Operator. They stood at the back of the team, eliminating the most dangerous target with a precise shot.

keys: 罗德岛的术师干员。以凝聚的法术团压制成群的敌人，爆散的法术余波能一次波及多个目标。
en: A Rhodes Island Caster Operator. They suppressed groups of enemies with condensed Arts, the explosive aftermath affecting multiple targets at once.

keys: 罗德岛的医疗干员。在深海里也不放下手中的医疗单元，负责维持队伍的生命。
en: A Rhodes Island Medic Operator. They did not put down their medical units even in the deep sea, responsible for maintaining the team's HP.

keys: 罗德岛的辅助干员。以减速力场拖慢潮水，并用追踪法术骚扰试图靠近的海嗣。
en: A Rhodes Island Supporter Operator. They slowed the tide with a Slow force field, and harassed Seaborn attempting to approach with tracking Arts.

keys:
「萨卡兹雇佣兵维什戴尔，战场上最危险的信号。」
萨卡兹雇佣兵领袖 W，现已正式更名为维什戴尔，她很乐意别人用这个新名字称呼她。伦蒂尼姆战争期间，她与罗德岛伦蒂尼姆特别行动队紧密合作，多次阻遏军事委员会。她的武器是一件严重损坏的主炮级巫术增幅单元，里面寄宿着一位死魂灵。临床诊断记录她毫不节制地滥用源石军工制品。
en:
'Sarkaz mercenary Wiš'adel, the most dangerous callsign the battlefield knew.'
Sarkaz mercenary 'The Leader' W officially changed her name to Wiš'adel, and she was happy for others to call her by this new name. During the Londinium war, she worked closely with the Rhodes Island Londinium Special Operations Team, thwarting the Military Commission multiple times. Her weapon was a severely damaged main cannon-level witchcraft amplification unit, which housed a Revenant. Clinical diagnosis recorded her unrestrained abuse of Originium military products.

keys:
「罗德岛术师干员艾雅法拉，一直想要倾尽全力为你做些什么。」
火山学家、天灾信使，在高等源石技艺与高能量法术释放上有卓越天赋。父母生前任职于莱塔尼亚威廉大学，在一次火山考察中罹难，她继承了他们的火山学研究。如今她一边在罗德岛接受矿石病治疗，一边为天灾研究、环境评估与危险地形航行提供支持。总是很努力，总是很认真。
en:
'Eyjafjalla, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, has wanted to devote herself to doing something for you.'
A Volcanologist and Catastrophe Messenger, she had outstanding talent in advanced Originium Arts and high-energy Arts release. Her parents worked at the William University in Leithanien before their deaths in a Volcano expedition, and she inherited their Volcanology research. Now she received Oripathy treatment at Rhodes Island while providing support for Catastrophe research, environmental assessment, and hazardous terrain navigation. Always hardworking, always serious.

keys:
「罗德岛医疗部门负责人，凯尔希。」
罗德岛高层管理人员之一，医疗项目领头人。在冶金工业、社会学、源石技艺、考古学、历史系谱学、经济学、植物学、地质学等领域学识渊博。行动中，她为队伍提供医学理论协助与应急医疗器械，同时也是战略指挥系统的重要成员。
en:
'Rhodes Island Medical Department Officer-in-Charge, Kal'tsit.'
One of Rhodes Island's top management and the leader of the medical project. She was highly knowledgeable in fields such as the metallurgical industry, sociology, Originium Arts, archaeology, historical genealogy, economics, botany, and geology. During operations, she provided medical theoretical assistance and emergency medical equipment to the team, and was also an important member of the strategic Command system.

keys:
「罗德岛干员铃兰，九倍的温柔与坚强。」
本名丽萨，姓氏按监护人的要求隐去。东国的神秘技艺，叙拉古的自由与向往。她的血统赋予了她优秀的源石技艺天赋。在罗德岛接受治疗期间受凯尔希指导，经本人申请，获准在其他干员随行时参加低难度任务。
en:
'Suzuran, Rhodes Island Operator, has nine times the strength, and the fluffiness.'
Her real name was Lisa, and her surname was hidden at the request of her guardian. The mysterious arts of Higashi, the freedom and yearning of Siracusa. Her bloodline granted her excellent Originium Arts talent. She was guided by Kal'tsit while receiving treatment at Rhodes Island, and upon her own application, she was approved to participate in low-difficulty missions when other Operators Follow.

keys:
「格拉斯哥帮头领推进之王，将为你辟开前路。」
本名维娜，维多利亚公民，来自伦蒂尼姆的格拉斯哥帮的头领。她的领导力与生俱来：擅长歼灭战、攻坚战与对抗硬目标，在测试中成绩优异后加入罗德岛，现为先锋干员与某作战小队的队长。
en:
'Siege, leader of the Glasgow Gang, will carve a path for you.'
Her real name was Vina, a Victorian citizen and the leader of the Glasgow Gang from Londinium. Her leadership was innate: she excelled in annihilation warfare, assault warfare, and combating hard targets. She joined Rhodes Island after achieving excellent results in tests, and was now a Vanguard Operator and the Leader of a certain combat squad.

keys:
「赏金猎人斯卡蒂，循着潮汐前来吞没你的敌人。」
受罗德岛雇佣的赏金猎人，擅长对抗大型生物、破坏硬目标、攻坚与歼灭。她的巨剑材质普通，打造方式却很异类，一般人难以使用；她不穿重甲，靠巨剑格挡与自身体格作战。她总是离群索居，并声称与她亲密交往的人最后都会遭遇不测。偶尔有干员见到她坐在甲板边沿，低声哼歌。
en:
'Skadi, bounty hunter, has come with the tide to drown your enemies.'
A bounty hunter hired by Rhodes Island, she excelled in combating large creatures, destroying hard targets, assault, and annihilation. Her greatsword was made of ordinary materials, but its forging method was very unorthodox, making it difficult for ordinary people to use; she did not wear heavy armor, relying on her greatsword to block and her own physique to fight. She always lived in isolation, and claimed that those who interacted closely with her would eventually meet with misfortune. Occasionally, Operators saw her sitting on the edge of the deck, humming softly.

keys:
「前莱茵生命研究员塞雷娅，将是防御与治疗并重的战场核心。」
前莱茵生命防卫科主任，在生命科学、微生物学与源石技艺上都有建树，擅长歼灭战、要员保全与异常事态处理。她的盾牌同时也是法杖，身上还带着医疗器械；她的源石技艺能操控以自身为圆心一定范围内的钙元素及其化合物。现与罗德岛在科研等领域合作。
en:
'Saria, former researcher of Rhine Lab, will serve as a core part of the squad's defense and healing unit on the battlefield.'
Former Director of the Rhine Lab Defense Section, she made achievements in life sciences, microbiology, and Originium Arts. She excelled in annihilation operations, VIP protection, and handling abnormal situations. Her shield also served as a staff, and she carried medical equipment. Her Originium Arts could manipulate calcium and its compounds within a certain radius around herself. She currently collaborated with Rhodes Island in scientific research and other fields.

keys:
「深海猎人乌尔比安，与海洋的阴影融为一体。」
阿戈尔前技术院执政官，深海猎人计划的负责人。他在自己身上进行了尚不成熟的改造手术，成为阿戈尔第一位深海猎人，并战斗到了最后，直到背离阿戈尔而去。歌蕾蒂娅的记录说，那柄四爪巨锚不过是他的手术刀；他节制而精准地倾泻暴力，也常这样教导斯卡蒂。他独行，一如他刚成为深海猎人时那样。
en:
'The Abyssal Hunter Ulpianus blends in with the shadows of the ocean.'
Former Consul of the Ægir Institute of Technology and head of the Abyssal Hunter project. He performed an immature modification surgery on himself, becoming Ægir's first Abyssal Hunter, and fought to the end until he turned his back on Ægir. Gladiia's records stated that the four-pronged giant anchor was merely his scalpel; he dispensed violence with restraint and precision, and often taught Skadi to do the same. He walked alone, just as he did when he first became an Abyssal Hunter.

keys:
「审判庭信使艾丽妮，为守护伊比利亚的海岸线而战。」
前伊比利亚审判官，大审判官达里奥的学生。幼时一场自然灾害席卷了她居住的小镇，她失去了所有家人，是达里奥把她从废墟下救了出来。「愚人号」事件后她辞去审判官一职，由凯尔希推荐，以审判庭信使的身份与罗德岛合作，为应对海洋的威胁做准备。她擅长迅捷的剑术，随身带着审判庭制式的提灯（一种法杖）与手炮。
en:
'Inquisition Messenger Irene, fighting to protect Iberia's coastline.'
Former Iberian Inquisitor and student of High Inquisitor Dario. When a natural disaster swept through her town in her childhood, she lost all her family, and Dario saved her from the ruins. After the 'Stultifera Navis' incident, she resigned as an Inquisitor. Recommended by Kal'tsit, she collaborated with Rhodes Island as an Inquisition Messenger to prepare for the threat of the ocean. She excelled in swift swordsmanship and carried a standard Inquisition lantern (a type of staff) and a hand cannon.

keys:
「归溟幽灵鲨，自囚笼里挣脱，从疯狂中苏醒。」
本名劳伦缇娜，深海猎人成员，擅长对抗大型生物与破坏硬目标。她曾是一名雕塑学徒，希望成为雕塑家；应征后通过改造成为深海猎人，隶属二队。「愚人号」事件后她的记忆恢复，精神与情绪都趋于稳定。战斗时的她总是疯狂的：挥舞着锯子，带头切入敌人的阵线。她是深海猎人里最容易接近、也唯一会向人讲起阿戈尔的一位。
en:
'Specter the Unchained, free from her cage, awake from her madness.'
Real name Laurentina, a member of the Abyssal Hunters, she excelled in combating large creatures and destroying hard targets. She was once a sculpture apprentice who hoped to become a sculptor; after enlisting, she underwent modification to become an Abyssal Hunter in the Second Squad. After the 'Stultifera Navis' incident, her memory recovered, and her mental and emotional states stabilized. In combat, she was always frantic: wielding a saw, she led the charge into the enemy lines. She was the most approachable among the Abyssal Hunters, and the only one who would speak of Ægir to others.

keys:
「干员拉普兰德，迫不及待想要切开眼前的敌人。」
身份不明，履历缺失。在战术攻坚与肃清作战中展现出十足的歼灭能力，现作为近卫干员为罗德岛提供特别行动服务。她使用一对经过特殊设计、带有东方风格的剑，能配合它们释放出带冲击性的法术效果；她极擅长洞察敌人的弱点，只需数次观察就能封锁对方的特殊能力。矿石病感染情况较重，已被列为医疗组监控对象之一。若干未经证实的情报指向叙拉古某个家族，相关调查工作已经终止。
en:
'Operator Lappland can't wait to slash apart the enemies in front of her.'
Identity unknown, resume missing. She demonstrated complete annihilation capabilities in tactical assault and purge operations, and currently provided special operation services for Rhodes Island as a Guard Operator. She used a pair of specially designed, Eastern-style swords, and could coordinate with them to produce impactful Arts effects. She excelled at perceiving enemy weaknesses, able to seal their special abilities with just a few observations. Her Originium infection was severe, and she was listed as a monitoring target by the Medical Department. Several unverified reports pointed to a certain family in Siracusa; related investigations had been terminated.

keys:
「罗德岛阿戈尔事务负责人歌蕾蒂娅，现在会向你透露一些信息。」
阿戈尔人，阿戈尔技术执政官、荣誉军团长，阿戈尔军事团体「深海猎人」的总战争设计师之一，登陆时间与地点俱不明。在对抗大型生物、破坏硬目标、攻坚战、歼灭战、机动战与谍报战等多类行动中展现出非凡实力。现以合作姿态协助罗德岛，在保留阿戈尔国家职能身份的同时兼任罗德岛的阿戈尔事务负责人。她借用罗德岛的设备向海面之下发出的信号，至今无人应答。
en:
'Rhodes Island Ægir Affairs Officer-in-Charge Gladiia, now inclined to divulge some information to you.'
An Ægir, Ægir Consul of Technology, Honorary Legion Commander, and one of the chief war designers of the Ægir military group 'Abyssal Hunters'. Her time and location of landfall were unknown. She demonstrated extraordinary strength in combating large creatures, destroying hard targets, assault operations, annihilation operations, mobile warfare, and espionage. She currently assisted Rhodes Island in a cooperative stance, serving concurrently as Rhodes Island's Ægir Affairs Director while retaining her Ægir state functions. The signals she sent beneath the sea surface using Rhodes Island equipment remained unanswered.

keys:
「罗德岛精英干员逻各斯，萨卡兹众魂的摆渡人。」
咒术大师，女妖河谷年轻的「女主人」。曾以巴别塔核心成员的身份参加卡兹戴尔内战，是罗德岛建立之初的首批精英干员之一，着手制定了干员源石技艺适应性测试的标准及流程。他的身旁悬浮着一支骨笔。他的真名得到了众多女妖的加护，绝对不要在十秒内连续朗读或者书写三遍以上。
en:
'Rhodes Island Elite Operator Logos, ferryman of the Sarkaz's myriad souls.'
Incantation master and the young 'Mistress' of the Banshee Valley. He participated in the Kazdel civil war as a core member of Babel, and was one of the first Elite Operators when Rhodes Island was founded, setting the standards and procedures for the Operator Originium Arts Adaptability test. A bone pen levitated by his side. His true name received the blessing of many Banshees; one must absolutely not read it aloud or write it more than three times within ten seconds.

keys:
「格兰法洛的礼拜堂护工流明，将会抚平你的伤痕。」
本名乔迪·方塔纳罗萨，生于格兰法洛，长期在当地礼拜堂做护工。父母是灯塔工程师，在重建与孤悬海上的灯塔「伊比利亚之眼」之间联系的行动中消失在浓雾里，为此付出了生命；他照着父母留下的笔记，仿制过灯塔的照明单元。他也是审判庭卡门的学徒，但相比审判庭的工作，他对照顾别人更有自信。现由极境和凯尔希引荐，作为罗德岛驻伊比利亚干员协助感染者医疗救护。
en:
'Lumen, chapel caregiver of Gran Faro, here to soothe your wounds.'
Real name Jordi Fontanarossa, born in Gran Faro, he worked as a caretaker at the local chapel for a long time. His parents were lighthouse engineers who disappeared into the thick fog and lost their lives during an operation to reestablish contact with the isolated lighthouse, the 'Eye of Iberia'. Following the notes left by his parents, he replicated the lighthouse's illumination unit. He was also an apprentice to the Inquisition's Carmen, but he was more confident in caring for others than in Inquisition work. Recommended by Elysium and Kal'tsit, he currently assists in Infected medical care as a Rhodes Island Operator stationed in Iberia.

keys:
「浊心斯卡蒂，一位让你熟悉又陌生的访客。」
档案中的代号仍是「斯卡蒂」，出身阿戈尔。凯尔希的记录写道，斯卡蒂被那些生物唤醒了。她以敌方领袖的身份出现时，被称作「伊莎玛拉，腐化之心」。
en:
'Skadi the Corrupting Heart, a visitor familiar yet unbeknownst to you.'
Her codename in the files remained 'Skadi', and she hailed from Ægir. Kal'tsit's records stated that Skadi was Awakened by those creatures. When she appeared as an enemy leader, she was called 'Ishar'mla, Heart of Corruption'.

keys:
「龙门近卫局特别任务组干员星熊准备完毕，等待你的指示。」
龙门近卫局特别任务组精英干员。有数项指控记录，经龙门总督魏彦吾交涉，因能力出众、表现良好，被破格吸纳进近卫局特别督察组。现作为重装干员协助罗德岛行动，为现场提供战术执行与指挥支援。她的盾名为「般若」。
en:
'Hoshiguma, member of the Special Service of Lungmen Guard Department, is awaiting your orders.'
Elite Operator of the Lungmen Guard Department Special Task Force. She had several accusation records, but after negotiations by Lungmen Chief Executive Wei Yenwu, she was exceptionally recruited into the Guard Department Special Inspector Group due to her outstanding abilities and good performance. She currently assists Rhodes Island operations as a Defender Operator, providing tactical execution and Command support on site. Her shield is named 'Hannya'.

keys:
「罗德岛辅助干员、信使安洁莉娜，很想用自己奇妙的源石技艺为你提供协助。」
本名安心院安洁莉娜，感染者。在叙拉古从事情报递送、货物运输等公开活动，推测身份为信使，同时是一名高中生。现作为实习术师干员，为罗德岛提供后勤保障、战场辅助与战术协同。
en:
'Angelina, Supporter Operator and Messenger of Rhodes Island, would like to provide help with her amazing Originium Arts.'
Real name Angelina Ajimu, an Infected. She engaged in public activities such as intelligence delivery and cargo transport in Siracusa, presumed to be a Messenger, and was also a high school student. She currently provides logistical support, battlefield assistance, and tactical coordination for Rhodes Island as an intern Caster Operator.

keys:
「企鹅物流职员德克萨斯，将使用源石剑为小队取得开局的优势。」
企鹅物流员工，单兵作战能力出众。合约期内担任企鹅物流驻罗德岛联络人员，协助罗德岛的多项行动。多份资料把她的身份指向已经覆灭的德克萨斯家族；关于这个家族，罗德岛的情报网也所知甚少。
en:
'Texas, employee of Penguin Logistics, will give the squad a tactical advantage with her Originium Arts at the start of every battle.'
Penguin Logistics employee with outstanding individual combat capabilities. During her contract period, she served as the Penguin Logistics liaison to Rhodes Island, assisting in multiple Rhodes Island operations. Multiple documents pointed her identity to the fallen Texas family; Rhodes Island's intelligence network also knew very little about this family.

keys:
「企鹅物流职员能天使，将用铳枪为小队扫平前路。」
拉特兰公民。企鹅物流公司成员，从事秘密联络、武装押运等非公开活动，推测身份为信使。合约期内担任企鹅物流驻罗德岛联络人员，协助罗德岛的多项行动。
en:
'Exusiai, employee of Penguin Logistics, will clear out everything in the way using her guns.'
Citizen of Laterano. Member of Penguin Logistics. Engages in covert communication, armed escort, and other undisclosed activities. Suspected to be a Messenger. Serves as the Penguin Logistics liaison to Rhodes Island during the contract period, assisting in various Rhodes Island operations.

keys: 罗德岛的博士。在切尔诺伯格的一处机密地点被罗德岛的小队救出，失去了过去的记忆，重要的事情都回忆不起来。获救后不久，整合运动袭击切尔诺伯格，博士在城中的战斗里接手调集、指挥罗德岛的作战小队。
en: The Doctor of Rhodes Island. Rescued by a Rhodes Island squad from a classified location in Chernobog. Lost past memories and cannot recall important events. Shortly after the rescue, Reunion attacked Chernobog. The Doctor took over the mobilization and Command of Rhodes Island combat squads during the battle in the city.
